name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowExtraction.action_on_coordinate_eq_sum
statement:
theorem action_on_coordinate_eq_sum
    (D : CoordinatedSeparatedData.{uK, uV, v} K V)
    (a : ArrowBimodule K V) (i : V)
    (x : PiRingModule.coordinateSubmodule K V D.top i) :
    D.action a x.val.val =
      ∑ j : V, ∑ e : i ⟶ j,
        (fun _ : V ↦ a i j e) •
          D.action (singleArrow K V e) x.val.val
proof:
:= by
  calc
    D.action a x.val.val =
        D.action a
          (PiRingModule.coordinateIdempotent K V i • x.val.val) := by
      rw [PiRingModule.coordinateSubmodule_fixed]
    _ = D.action
        (a <• PiRingModule.coordinateIdempotent K V i) x.val.val :=
      (D.action_right_smul a
        (PiRingModule.coordinateIdempotent K V i) x.val.val).symm
    _ = D.action
        (∑ j : V, ∑ e : i ⟶ j,
          (fun _ : V ↦ a i j e) • singleArrow K V e) x.val.val := by
      rw [sourceSlice_eq_sum]
    _ = ∑ j : V, ∑ e : i ⟶ j,
        (fun _ : V ↦ a i j e) •
          D.action (singleArrow K V e) x.val.val := by
      simp only [map_sum]
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e _
      exact D.action_left_smul (fun _ : V ↦ a i j e)
        (singleArrow K V e) x.val.val

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowExtraction.aggregateAction_coordinate_val
statement:
theorem aggregateAction_coordinate_val
    (D : CoordinatedSeparatedData.{uK, uV, v} K V)
    (a : ArrowBimodule K V)
    (x : PiRingModule.Total K V
      (PiRingModule.coordinateFamily K V D.top)) (j : V) :
    (aggregateAction K V (ofSeparatedData K V D) a x j).val.val =
      ∑ i : V, ∑ e : i ⟶ j,
        (fun _ : V ↦ a i j e) •
          D.action (singleArrow K V e) (x i).val.val
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateInclusion K V D.radical j
      (∑ i : V, ∑ e : i ⟶ j,
        a i j e • coordinateArrowMap K V D e (x i)) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowExtraction.coordinateSum_aggregateAction
statement:
theorem coordinateSum_aggregateAction
    (D : CoordinatedSeparatedData.{uK, uV, v} K V)
    (a : ArrowBimodule K V)
    (x : PiRingModule.Total K V
      (PiRingModule.coordinateFamily K V D.top)) :
    PiRingModule.coordinateSumLinearMap K V D.radical
        (aggregateAction K V (ofSeparatedData K V D) a x) =
      D.action a (PiRingModule.coordinateSumLinearMap K V D.top x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiRingModule.coordinateSumLinearMap_apply,
    PiRingModule.coordinateSumLinearMap_apply]
  apply Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ ↦
    aggregateAction_coordinate_val K V D a x j))
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (action_on_coordinate_eq_sum K V D a i (x i)).symm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.AuslanderEquivalence.CoordinateIdempotent.coordinateSimple_isSimple
statement:
theorem coordinateSimple_isSimple
    (hfinite :
      ∀ i : κ,
        IsFiniteLength
          (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
          (coordinateProjective σ i).obj)
    (i : κ) :
    Simple (coordinateSimple σ i)
proof:
:= by
  let hP :=
    coordinateProjective_isFiniteProjective σ i
  letI : Module.Finite
      (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
      (coordinateProjective σ i).obj :=
    hP.1
  letI : CategoryTheory.Projective
      (coordinateProjective σ i).obj :=
    hP.2
  letI : Module.Projective
      (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
      (coordinateProjective σ i).obj :=
    (IsProjective.iff_projective
      (coordinateProjective σ i).obj).mpr hP.2
  rw [simple_iff_isSimpleModule]
  exact
    simple_top_of_indec_projective
      (hfinite i)
      (coordinateProjective_indecomposable σ i)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.AuslanderEquivalence.CoordinateIdempotent.coordinateSimple_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem coordinateSimple_eq_of_iso
    (hfinite :
      ∀ i : κ,
        IsFiniteLength
          (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
          (coordinateProjective σ i).obj)
    {i j : κ}
    (e : coordinateSimple σ i ≅ coordinateSimple σ j) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  let pIso :
      (coordinateProjectiveCover σ hfinite i).object ≅
        (coordinateProjectiveCover σ hfinite j).object :=
    ProjectiveCover.objectIsoOfTargetIso
      (coordinateProjectiveCover σ hfinite i)
      (coordinateProjectiveCover σ hfinite j)
      e
  let pIsoBase :
      (coordinateProjective σ i).obj ≅
        (coordinateProjective σ j).obj :=
    pIso
  exact
    coordinateProjective_eq_of_iso σ
      ((AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules
        (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ).isoMk pIsoBase)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.AuslanderEquivalence.CoordinateIdempotent.coordinateSimple_complete
statement:
theorem coordinateSimple_complete
    (hfinite :
      ∀ i : κ,
        IsFiniteLength
          (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
          (coordinateProjective σ i).obj)
    (S : ModuleCat.{wR} (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ)
    (hS : Simple S) :
    ∃ i : κ, Nonempty (S ≅ coordinateSimple σ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  letI : Simple S := hS
  letI : IsSimpleModule
      (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ S :=
    isSimpleModule_of_simple S
  letI : Nontrivial S :=
    IsSimpleModule.nontrivial
      (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ S
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_ne (0 : S)
  let q :
      ModuleCat.of
          (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
          (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ ⟶
        S :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom
      (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton
        (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ S s)
  haveI : Epi q := by
    rw [ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    exact
      IsSimpleModule.toSpanSingleton_surjective
        (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ hs
  let F : κ →
      ModuleCat.{wR} (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ :=
    fun i ↦
      ((skeletonAuslanderEquivalence σ).functor.obj
        (σ.obj i)).obj
  let t : (⨁ F) ⟶ S :=
    (auslanderImageBiproductIsoRegular σ).hom ≫ q
  haveI : Epi t := by
    dsimp [t]
    infer_instance
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht
    exact
      Simple.not_isZero S
        (IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero t ht)
  have hcomponent :
      ∃ i : κ, biproduct.ι F i ≫ t ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply ht
    apply biproduct.hom_ext'
    intro i
    exact h i
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcomponent
  let I :=
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules
      (skeletonAuslanderAlgebra σ)ᵐᵒᵖ
  let e :
      F i ≅ (coordinateProjective σ i).obj :=
    I.ι.mapIso (auslanderImageIsoCoordinateProjective σ i)
  let f : (coordinateProjective σ i).obj ⟶ S :=
    e.inv ≫ biproduct.ι F i ≫ t
  have hef :
      e.hom ≫ f = biproduct.ι F i ≫ t := by
    simp [f]
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    apply hi
    rw [← hef, hf, comp_zero]
  exact
    ⟨i, ⟨simpleIsoCoordinateSimpleOfNonzero
      σ hfinite i S hS f hf⟩⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.factorLadderTauTarget_some_injective
statement:
theorem factorLadderTauTarget_some_injective
    (K : Set ι) {x₁ x₂ y : DeletedLabel K}
    (h₁ : factorLadderTauTarget (σ := σ) (D := D) K x₁ = some y)
    (h₂ : factorLadderTauTarget (σ := σ) (D := D) K x₂ = some y) :
    x₁ = x₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp₁ : Projective (σ.obj x₁.1)
  · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₁] at h₁
  · by_cases hm₁ : (arTranslation σ D ⟨x₁.1, hp₁⟩).1 ∈ K
    · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₁, hm₁] at h₁
    · by_cases hθ₁ :
        factorLadderTheta (σ := σ) (D := D) K
          (FactorLadder.basis x₁) = 0
      · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₁, hm₁, hθ₁] at h₁
      · by_cases hp₂ : Projective (σ.obj x₂.1)
        · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₂] at h₂
        · by_cases hm₂ :
            (arTranslation σ D ⟨x₂.1, hp₂⟩).1 ∈ K
          · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₂, hm₂] at h₂
          · by_cases hθ₂ :
              factorLadderTheta (σ := σ) (D := D) K
                (FactorLadder.basis x₂) = 0
            · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₂, hm₂, hθ₂] at h₂
            · have hv₁ :
                  (arTranslation σ D ⟨x₁.1, hp₁⟩).1 = y.1 := by
                have hs := h₁
                simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₁, hm₁, hθ₁] at hs
                exact congrArg Subtype.val hs
              have hv₂ :
                  (arTranslation σ D ⟨x₂.1, hp₂⟩).1 = y.1 := by
                have hs := h₂
                simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hp₂, hm₂, hθ₂] at hs
                exact congrArg Subtype.val hs
              have hnp : (⟨x₁.1, hp₁⟩ : σ.NonprojectiveLabel) =
                  ⟨x₂.1, hp₂⟩ := by
                apply arTranslation_injective σ D
                apply Subtype.ext
                exact hv₁.trans hv₂.symm
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact congrArg (fun q : σ.NonprojectiveLabel ↦ q.1) hnp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.factorLadderTauSource_eq_some_of_target_eq_some
statement:
theorem factorLadderTauSource_eq_some_of_target_eq_some
    (K : Set ι) (x y : DeletedLabel K)
    (hxy : factorLadderTauTarget (σ := σ) (D := D) K x = some y) :
    factorLadderTauSource σ D K y = some x
proof:

  classical
  simp only [factorLadderTauSource]
  split
  next h =>
    apply congrArg some
    exact factorLadderTauTarget_some_injective σ D K
      (Classical.choose_spec h) hxy
  next h => exact (h ⟨x, hxy⟩).elim

proof:

  · exact factorLadderTauSource_eq_some_of_target_eq_some σ D K x y

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.moduleLeftMesh_X₃_eq_obj_of_tauTarget_eq_some
statement:
theorem moduleLeftMesh_X₃_eq_obj_of_tauTarget_eq_some
    (K : Set ι) (x y : DeletedLabel K)
    (hxy : factorLadderTauTarget (σ := σ) (D := D) K x = some y) :
    (moduleLeftMesh (k := k) σ D y.1).X₃ = σ.obj x.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : Projective (σ.obj x.1)
  · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hx] at hxy
  · by_cases htx : (arTranslation σ D ⟨x.1, hx⟩).1 ∈ K
    · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hx, htx] at hxy
    · by_cases hmiddle :
        factorLadderTheta (σ := σ) (D := D) K
          (FactorLadder.basis x) = 0
      · simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hx, htx, hmiddle] at hxy
      · have hxy' := hxy
        simp [factorLadderTauTarget, hx, htx, hmiddle] at hxy'
        have hy : y =
            ⟨(arTranslation σ D ⟨x.1, hx⟩).1, htx⟩ := hxy'.symm
        subst y
        let xNP : σ.NonprojectiveLabel := ⟨x.1, hx⟩
        let yNI : σ.NoninjectiveLabel := arTranslationEquiv σ D xNP
        have hyNI :
            (⟨(arTranslation σ D xNP).1, yNI.2⟩ :
              σ.NoninjectiveLabel) = yNI := Subtype.ext rfl
        rw [moduleLeftMesh_X₃_of_not_injective
          (k := k) σ D (arTranslation σ D xNP).1 yNI.2]
        rw [hyNI, (arTranslationEquiv σ D).symm_apply_apply]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.factorCategoryLeftMesh_X₁
statement:
theorem factorCategoryLeftMesh_X₁
    (K : Set ι) (y : DeletedLabel K) :
    let I
proof:
:= σ.factorThroughAddIdeal Set.univ K
    letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
      I.quotientPreadditive
    (factorCategoryLeftMesh (k := k) σ D K y).X₁ =
      σ.factorObject K y := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let I := σ.factorThroughAddIdeal Set.univ K
  letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
    I.quotientPreadditive
  cases hsource : factorLadderTauSource σ D K y <;>
    simp [factorCategoryLeftMesh, factorCategoryZeroRightLeftMesh,
      hsource, factorCategoryRawLeftMesh_X₁ (k := k) σ D K y]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.factorCategoryLeftMesh_X₃_isZero_iff_tauSource_eq_none
statement:
theorem factorCategoryLeftMesh_X₃_isZero_iff_tauSource_eq_none
    (K : Set ι) (y : DeletedLabel K) :
    let I
proof:
:= σ.factorThroughAddIdeal Set.univ K
    letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
      I.quotientPreadditive
    IsZero (factorCategoryLeftMesh (k := k) σ D K y).X₃ ↔
      factorLadderTauSource σ D K y = none := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let I := σ.factorThroughAddIdeal Set.univ K
  letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
    I.quotientPreadditive
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    cases hsource : factorLadderTauSource σ D K y with
    | none => rfl
    | some x =>
        have hxzero : IsZero (σ.factorObject K x) :=
          IsZero.of_iso hzero
            (factorCategoryLeftMeshRightIso_of_tauSource_eq_some
              (k := k) σ D K y x hsource).symm
        exact ((σ.factorObject_not_isZero K x) hxzero).elim
  · intro hsource
    simpa [factorCategoryLeftMesh, factorCategoryZeroRightLeftMesh, hsource]
      using factorCategoryZeroObject_isZero σ K

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.exists_eq_a_mul_of_mem_jacobsonSquare
statement:
theorem exists_eq_a_mul_of_mem_jacobsonSquare
    {e0 e1 x a b z : B}
    (he1x : e1 * x = 0)
    (he1a : e1 * a = a)
    (he1b : e1 * b = 0)
    (hgen : JacobsonRightGeneratedBy x a b)
    (hz : z ∈ (J B) ^ 2) :
    exists s : B, s ∈ J B ∧ e1 * z * e0 = a * s
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : z ∈ J B * J B := by
    rw [show (2 : Nat) = 1 + 1 by omega, Submodule.pow_succ,
      Submodule.pow_one] at hz
    exact hz
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hz' ?_ ?_
  · intro u hu v hv
    obtain ⟨rx, ra, rb, hu'⟩ := hgen u hu
    refine ⟨ra * v * e0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (J B).mul_mem_right e0 ((J B).mul_mem_left ra hv)
    · calc
        e1 * (u * v) * e0 =
            (e1 * x) * (rx * v * e0) +
              (e1 * a) * (ra * v * e0) +
                (e1 * b) * (rb * v * e0) := by
          rw [hu']
          noncomm_ring
        _ = a * (ra * v * e0) := by rw [he1x, he1a, he1b]; simp
  · intro z w hz hw
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hzs⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hwt⟩ := hw
    refine ⟨s + t, (J B).add_mem hs ht, ?_⟩
    calc
      e1 * (z + w) * e0 = e1 * z * e0 + e1 * w * e0 := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = a * s + a * t := by rw [hzs, hwt]
      _ = a * (s + t) := by noncomm_ring

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
statement:
theorem exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
    {e0 e1 x a b z : B}
    (he0x : e0 * x = x)
    (he0a : e0 * a = 0)
    (he0b : e0 * b = b)
    (he1x : e1 * x = 0)
    (he1a : e1 * a = a)
    (he1b : e1 * b = 0)
    (hbe1 : b * e1 = b)
    (hgen : JacobsonRightGeneratedBy x a b)
    (hz : z ∈ (J B) ^ 3) :
    exists t s : B, s ∈ J B ∧
      e0 * z * e0 = x * t + (b * a) * s
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : z ∈ J B * (J B) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show (3 : Nat) = 2 + 1 by omega,
      Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ] at hz
    exact hz
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hz' ?_ ?_
  · intro u hu v hv
    obtain ⟨rx, ra, rb, hu'⟩ := hgen u hu
    have hrbv : rb * v ∈ (J B) ^ 2 :=
      ((J B) ^ 2).mul_mem_left rb hv
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsEq⟩ :=
      exists_eq_a_mul_of_mem_jacobsonSquare
        (e0 := e0) he1x he1a he1b hgen hrbv
    refine ⟨rx * v * e0, s, hs, ?_⟩
    have hbcorner :
        b * (rb * v * e0) = b * (e1 * (rb * v) * e0) := by
      calc
        b * (rb * v * e0) = b * (rb * v) * e0 := by noncomm_ring
        _ = (b * e1) * (rb * v) * e0 := by rw [hbe1]
        _ = b * (e1 * (rb * v) * e0) := by noncomm_ring
    calc
      e0 * (u * v) * e0 =
          (e0 * x) * (rx * v * e0) +
            (e0 * a) * (ra * v * e0) +
              (e0 * b) * (rb * v * e0) := by
        rw [hu']
        noncomm_ring
      _ = x * (rx * v * e0) + b * (e1 * (rb * v) * e0) := by
        rw [he0x, he0a, he0b]
        simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, hbcorner]
      _ = x * (rx * v * e0) + b * (a * s) := by rw [hsEq]
      _ = x * (rx * v * e0) + (b * a) * s := by noncomm_ring
  · intro z w hz hw
    obtain ⟨tz, sz, hsz, hzEq⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨tw, sw, hsw, hwEq⟩ := hw
    refine ⟨tz + tw, sz + sw, (J B).add_mem hsz hsw, ?_⟩
    calc
      e0 * (z + w) * e0 = e0 * z * e0 + e0 * w * e0 := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = (x * tz + (b * a) * sz) +
          (x * tw + (b * a) * sw) := by rw [hzEq, hwEq]
      _ = x * (tz + tw) + (b * a) * (sz + sw) := by
        noncomm_ring

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_peirce
statement:
theorem relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_peirce
    {e0 e1 x a b : B}
    (he0idem : e0 * e0 = e0)
    (he0x : e0 * x = x)
    (he1a : e1 * a = a) (hae0 : a * e0 = a)
    (he0b : e0 * b = b) (hbe1 : b * e1 = b)
    (he0a : e0 * a = 0) (he1x : e1 * x = 0)
    (he1b : e1 * b = 0)
    (hxJ : x ∈ J B) (haJ : a ∈ J B) (hbJ : b ∈ J B)
    (hgen : JacobsonRightGeneratedBy x a b)
    (hdiag : forall p : B, exists c : K, exists r : B,
      r ∈ J B ∧ e0 * r = r ∧ e0 * p * e0 = c • e0 + r)
    (hoff : forall p : B, e0 * p * e1 ∈ J B)
    (hmem : b * a ∈
      TwoCoordinateData.loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal
        x a b) :
    exists t s : B, s ∈ J B ∧
      b * a = x * t + (b * a) * s
proof:
:= by
  let H : TwoSidedIdeal B :=
    TwoSidedIdeal.span
      (TwoCoordinateData.loopTwoCycleRelationSet x a b)
  have hmem' : b * a ∈ H := by simpa [H,
    TwoCoordinateData.loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal] using hmem
  have hspan : UniversalCornerNormalForm e0 x (b * a) (b * a) := by
    apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction (p := fun z _ =>
      UniversalCornerNormalForm e0 x (b * a) z) (s :=
        TwoCoordinateData.loopTwoCycleRelationSet x a b)
    · intro g hg p q
      rcases hg with hg3 | hg
      · have hpq : p * g * q ∈ (J B) ^ 3 :=
          ((J B) ^ 3).mul_mem_right q (((J B) ^ 3).mul_mem_left p hg3)
        obtain ⟨t, s, hs, hEq⟩ :=
          exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
            he0x he0a he0b he1x he1a he1b hbe1 hgen hpq
        exact ⟨t, s, hs, by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hEq⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
        rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · obtain ⟨c, r, hrJ, he0r, hpr⟩ := hdiag p
          have hcube : r * (x * x) * q ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
            have hxxx : r * (x * x) ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
              rw [show (3 : Nat) = 2 + 1 by omega,
                Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ]
              exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hrJ (by
                rw [show (2 : Nat) = 1 + 1 by omega,
                  Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ, Submodule.pow_one]
                exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hxJ hxJ)
            exact ((J B) ^ 3).mul_mem_right q hxxx
          obtain ⟨tr, sr, hsr, hrEq⟩ :=
            exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
              he0x he0a he0b he1x he1a he1b hbe1 hgen hcube
          refine ⟨(algebraMap K B c) * x * q * e0 + tr, sr, hsr, ?_⟩
          calc
            e0 * p * (x * x) * q * e0 =
                (e0 * p * e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 := by
              calc
                e0 * p * (x * x) * q * e0 =
                    e0 * p * ((e0 * x) * x) * q * e0 := by rw [he0x]
                _ = (e0 * p * e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 := by
                  noncomm_ring
            _ = (c • e0 + r) * (x * x) * q * e0 := by rw [hpr]
            _ = (c • e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 +
                e0 * (r * (x * x) * q) * e0 := by
              calc
                (c • e0 + r) * (x * x) * q * e0 =
                    (c • e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 +
                      r * (x * x) * q * e0 := by noncomm_ring
                _ = (c • e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 +
                    (e0 * r) * (x * x) * q * e0 := by rw [he0r]
                _ = (c • e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 +
                    e0 * (r * (x * x) * q) * e0 := by noncomm_ring
            _ = (c • e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 +
                (x * tr + (b * a) * sr) := by rw [hrEq]
            _ = x * ((algebraMap K B c) * x * q * e0 + tr) +
                (b * a) * sr := by
              have hscalar :
                  (c • e0) * (x * x) * q * e0 =
                    x * ((algebraMap K B c) * x * q * e0) := by
                simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
                calc
                  (algebraMap K B c) * e0 * (x * x) * q * e0 =
                      (algebraMap K B c) * (e0 * x) * x * q * e0 := by
                    noncomm_ring
                  _ = (algebraMap K B c) * x * x * q * e0 := by rw [he0x]
                  _ = x * (algebraMap K B c) * x * q * e0 := by
                    rw [Algebra.commutes c x]
                  _ = x * ((algebraMap K B c) * x * q * e0) := by
                    noncomm_ring
              rw [hscalar]
              noncomm_ring
        · have hoffJ := hoff p
          have hcube : e0 * p * (a * x) * q ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
            have haxa : a * x ∈ (J B) ^ 2 := by
              rw [show (2 : Nat) = 1 + 1 by omega,
                Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ, Submodule.pow_one]
              exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul haJ hxJ
            have hthree : (e0 * p * e1) * (a * x) ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
              rw [show (3 : Nat) = 2 + 1 by omega,
                Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ]
              exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hoffJ haxa
            have hthreeq := ((J B) ^ 3).mul_mem_right q hthree
            convert hthreeq using 1
            calc
              e0 * p * (a * x) * q =
                  e0 * p * ((e1 * a) * x) * q := by rw [he1a]
              _ = (e0 * p * e1) * (a * x) * q := by noncomm_ring
          obtain ⟨t, s, hs, hEq⟩ :=
            exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
              he0x he0a he0b he1x he1a he1b hbe1 hgen hcube
          refine ⟨t, s, hs, ?_⟩
          calc
            e0 * p * (a * x) * q * e0 =
                e0 * (e0 * p * (a * x) * q) * e0 := by
              symm
              calc
                e0 * (e0 * p * (a * x) * q) * e0 =
                    (e0 * e0) * p * (a * x) * q * e0 := by noncomm_ring
                _ = e0 * p * (a * x) * q * e0 := by rw [he0idem]
            _ = x * t + (b * a) * s := hEq
        · obtain ⟨c, r, hrJ, he0r, hpr⟩ := hdiag p
          have hcube : r * (x * b) * q ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
            have hxxb : r * (x * b) ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
              rw [show (3 : Nat) = 2 + 1 by omega,
                Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ]
              have hxb : x * b ∈ (J B) ^ 2 := by
                rw [show (2 : Nat) = 1 + 1 by omega,
                  Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ, Submodule.pow_one]
                exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hxJ hbJ
              exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hrJ hxb
            exact ((J B) ^ 3).mul_mem_right q hxxb
          obtain ⟨tr, sr, hsr, hrEq⟩ :=
            exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
              he0x he0a he0b he1x he1a he1b hbe1 hgen hcube
          refine ⟨(algebraMap K B c) * b * q * e0 + tr, sr, hsr, ?_⟩
          calc
            e0 * p * (x * b) * q * e0 =
                (e0 * p * e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 := by
              calc
                e0 * p * (x * b) * q * e0 =
                    e0 * p * ((e0 * x) * b) * q * e0 := by rw [he0x]
                _ = (e0 * p * e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 := by
                  noncomm_ring
            _ = (c • e0 + r) * (x * b) * q * e0 := by rw [hpr]
            _ = (c • e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 +
                e0 * (r * (x * b) * q) * e0 := by
              calc
                (c • e0 + r) * (x * b) * q * e0 =
                    (c • e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 +
                      r * (x * b) * q * e0 := by noncomm_ring
                _ = (c • e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 +
                    (e0 * r) * (x * b) * q * e0 := by rw [he0r]
                _ = (c • e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 +
                    e0 * (r * (x * b) * q) * e0 := by noncomm_ring
            _ = (c • e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 +
                (x * tr + (b * a) * sr) := by rw [hrEq]
            _ = x * ((algebraMap K B c) * b * q * e0 + tr) +
                (b * a) * sr := by
              have hscalar :
                  (c • e0) * (x * b) * q * e0 =
                    x * ((algebraMap K B c) * b * q * e0) := by
                simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
                calc
                  (algebraMap K B c) * e0 * (x * b) * q * e0 =
                      (algebraMap K B c) * (e0 * x) * b * q * e0 := by
                    noncomm_ring
                  _ = (algebraMap K B c) * x * b * q * e0 := by rw [he0x]
                  _ = x * (algebraMap K B c) * b * q * e0 := by
                    rw [Algebra.commutes c x]
                  _ = x * ((algebraMap K B c) * b * q * e0) := by
                    noncomm_ring
              rw [hscalar]
              noncomm_ring
        · have hoffJ := hoff p
          have hcube : e0 * p * (a * b) * q ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
            have hab2 : a * b ∈ (J B) ^ 2 := by
              rw [show (2 : Nat) = 1 + 1 by omega,
                Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ, Submodule.pow_one]
              exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul haJ hbJ
            have hthree : (e0 * p * e1) * (a * b) ∈ (J B) ^ 3 := by
              rw [show (3 : Nat) = 2 + 1 by omega,
                Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ]
              exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hoffJ hab2
            have hthreeq := ((J B) ^ 3).mul_mem_right q hthree
            convert hthreeq using 1
            calc
              e0 * p * (a * b) * q =
                  e0 * p * ((e1 * a) * b) * q := by rw [he1a]
              _ = (e0 * p * e1) * (a * b) * q := by noncomm_ring
          obtain ⟨t, s, hs, hEq⟩ :=
            exists_corner_normalForm_of_mem_jacobsonCube
              he0x he0a he0b he1x he1a he1b hbe1 hgen hcube
          refine ⟨t, s, hs, ?_⟩
          calc
            e0 * p * (a * b) * q * e0 =
                e0 * (e0 * p * (a * b) * q) * e0 := by
              symm
              calc
                e0 * (e0 * p * (a * b) * q) * e0 =
                    (e0 * e0) * p * (a * b) * q * e0 := by noncomm_ring
                _ = e0 * p * (a * b) * q * e0 := by rw [he0idem]
            _ = x * t + (b * a) * s := hEq
    · intro p q
      exact ⟨0, 0, (J B).zero_mem, by simp⟩
    · intro z w _ _ hz hw p q
      obtain ⟨tz, sz, hsz, hzEq⟩ := hz p q
      obtain ⟨tw, sw, hsw, hwEq⟩ := hw p q
      refine ⟨tz + tw, sz + sw, (J B).add_mem hsz hsw, ?_⟩
      calc
        e0 * p * (z + w) * q * e0 =
            e0 * p * z * q * e0 + e0 * p * w * q * e0 := by
          noncomm_ring
        _ = (x * tz + (b * a) * sz) +
            (x * tw + (b * a) * sw) := by rw [hzEq, hwEq]
        _ = x * (tz + tw) + (b * a) * (sz + sw) := by
          noncomm_ring
    · intro z _ hz p q
      obtain ⟨t, s, hs, hEq⟩ := hz (-p) q
      refine ⟨t, s, hs, ?_⟩
      simpa only [mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg] using hEq
    · intro c z _ hz p q
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using hz (p * c) q
    · intro c z _ hz p q
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using hz p (c * q)
    · exact hmem'
  obtain ⟨t, s, hs, hEq⟩ := hspan 1 1
  refine ⟨t, s, hs, ?_⟩
  have hcorner : e0 * (b * a) * e0 = b * a := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, he0b, mul_assoc, hae0]
  simpa [hcorner] using hEq

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.isRightGeneratedBy_zero
statement:
private theorem isRightGeneratedBy_zero (x a b : B) :
    IsRightGeneratedBy x a b 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨0, 0, 0, by simp⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.IsRightGeneratedBy.add
statement:
private theorem IsRightGeneratedBy.add
    {x a b z w : B}
    (hz : IsRightGeneratedBy x a b z)
    (hw : IsRightGeneratedBy x a b w) :
    IsRightGeneratedBy x a b (z + w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rx, ra, rb, rfl⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨sx, sa, sb, rfl⟩ := hw
  refine ⟨rx + sx, ra + sa, rb + sb, ?_⟩
  noncomm_ring

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.IsRightGeneratedBy.mul_right
statement:
private theorem IsRightGeneratedBy.mul_right
    {x a b z : B}
    (hz : IsRightGeneratedBy x a b z) (w : B) :
    IsRightGeneratedBy x a b (z * w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rx, ra, rb, rfl⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨rx * w, ra * w, rb * w, ?_⟩
  noncomm_ring

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.exists_rightGenerated_add_square_of_cotangentSpanned
statement:
private theorem exists_rightGenerated_add_square_of_cotangentSpanned
    {x a b z : B}
    (hspan : JacobsonCotangentSpannedBy (K := K) x a b)
    (hz : z ∈ J B) :
    exists g r : B,
      IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g ∧ r ∈ (J B) ^ 2 ∧ z = g + r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cx, ca, cb, hr⟩ := hspan z hz
  let g : B := cx • x + ca • a + cb • b
  let r : B := z - g
  have hg : IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g := by
    refine ⟨algebraMap K B cx, algebraMap K B ca,
      algebraMap K B cb, ?_⟩
    dsimp [g]
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
    rw [Algebra.commutes cx x, Algebra.commutes ca a,
      Algebra.commutes cb b]
  refine ⟨g, r, hg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hr
  · dsimp [r]
    abel

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.exists_rightGenerated_add_nextPower
statement:
private theorem exists_rightGenerated_add_nextPower
    {x a b z : B}
    (hstep : forall u : B, u ∈ J B ->
      exists g r : B,
        IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g ∧
          r ∈ (J B) ^ 2 ∧ u = g + r)
    (n : Nat) (hz : z ∈ (J B) ^ (n + 1)) :
    exists g r : B,
      IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g ∧
        r ∈ (J B) ^ (n + 2) ∧ z = g + r
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : z ∈ J B * (J B) ^ n := by
    rw [Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ] at hz
    exact hz
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hz' ?_ ?_
  · intro u hu v hv
    obtain ⟨g, r, hg, hr2, huEq⟩ := hstep u hu
    have hgr : IsRightGeneratedBy x a b (g * v) := hg.mul_right v
    have hrnext : r * v ∈ (J B) ^ (n + 2) := by
      have hprod : r * v ∈ (J B) ^ 2 * (J B) ^ n :=
        Ideal.mul_mem_mul hr2 hv
      have hp : r * v ∈ (J B) ^ (2 + n) := by
        rw [Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_add]
        exact hprod
      simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hp
    refine ⟨g * v, r * v, hgr, hrnext, ?_⟩
    rw [huEq]
    noncomm_ring
  · intro z w hz hw
    obtain ⟨gz, rz, hgz, hrz, hzEq⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨gw, rw, hgw, hrw, hwEq⟩ := hw
    refine ⟨gz + gw, rz + rw, hgz.add hgw,
      ((J B) ^ (n + 2)).add_mem hrz hrw, ?_⟩
    rw [hzEq, hwEq]
    abel

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.exists_rightGenerated_add_power
statement:
private theorem exists_rightGenerated_add_power
    {x a b z : B}
    (hstep : forall u : B, u ∈ J B ->
      exists g r : B,
        IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g ∧
          r ∈ (J B) ^ 2 ∧ u = g + r)
    (hz : z ∈ J B) (n : Nat) :
    exists g r : B,
      IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g ∧
        r ∈ (J B) ^ (n + 1) ∧ z = g + r
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, z, isRightGeneratedBy_zero x a b, ?_, by simp⟩
      simpa [Submodule.pow_one] using hz
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨g, r, hg, hr, hzEq⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨g', r', hg', hr', hrEq⟩ :=
        exists_rightGenerated_add_nextPower hstep n hr
      refine ⟨g + g', r', hg.add hg', ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hr'
      · rw [hzEq, hrEq]
        abel

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.jacobsonRightGeneratedBy_of_cotangentSpanned
statement:
theorem jacobsonRightGeneratedBy_of_cotangentSpanned
    {x a b : B}
    (hspan : JacobsonCotangentSpannedBy (K := K) x a b) :
    JacobsonRightGeneratedBy x a b
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hstep : forall u : B, u ∈ J B ->
      exists g r : B,
        IsRightGeneratedBy x a b g ∧
          r ∈ (J B) ^ 2 ∧ u = g + r := by
    intro u hu
    exact exists_rightGenerated_add_square_of_cotangentSpanned hspan hu
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    (IsArtinianRing.isNilpotent_jacobson_bot (R := B))
  have hn' : (J B) ^ n = 0 := by
    simpa only [J, Ideal.jacobson_bot] using hn
  obtain ⟨g, r, hg, hr, hzEq⟩ :=
    exists_rightGenerated_add_power hstep hz n
  have hrn : r ∈ (J B) ^ n :=
    Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n) hr
  have hrzero : r = 0 := by
    rw [hn'] at hrn
    exact Ideal.mem_bot.mp hrn
  obtain ⟨rx, ra, rb, hgEq⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨rx, ra, rb, ?_⟩
  rw [hzEq, hrzero, add_zero, hgEq]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.TwoCoordinateData.relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_jacobsonRightGenerated
statement:
theorem relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_jacobsonRightGenerated
    {x a b : B}
    (hxJ : x ∈ J B) (haJ : a ∈ J B) (hbJ : b ∈ J B)
    (hxleft : D.liftedCoordinate 0 * x = x)
    (haleft : D.liftedCoordinate 1 * a = a)
    (haright : a * D.liftedCoordinate 0 = a)
    (hbleft : D.liftedCoordinate 0 * b = b)
    (hbright : b * D.liftedCoordinate 1 = b)
    (hgen : JacobsonRightGeneratedBy x a b)
    (hmem : b * a ∈ loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal x a b) :
    exists t s : B, s ∈ J B ∧
      b * a = x * t + (b * a) * s
proof:
:= by
  let e0 := D.liftedCoordinate 0
  let e1 := D.liftedCoordinate 1
  have he0idem : e0 * e0 = e0 :=
    D.liftedCoordinate_complete.idem 0
  have he0a : e0 * a = 0 := by
    calc
      e0 * a = e0 * (e1 * a) := by rw [haleft]
      _ = (e0 * e1) * a := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [D.liftedCoordinate_complete.ortho (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)]
        simp
  have he1x : e1 * x = 0 := by
    calc
      e1 * x = e1 * (e0 * x) := by rw [hxleft]
      _ = (e1 * e0) * x := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [D.liftedCoordinate_complete.ortho (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)]
        simp
  have he1b : e1 * b = 0 := by
    calc
      e1 * b = e1 * (e0 * b) := by rw [hbleft]
      _ = (e1 * e0) * b := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [D.liftedCoordinate_complete.ortho (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)]
        simp
  have hdiag : forall p : B, exists c : K, exists r : B,
      r ∈ J B ∧ e0 * r = r ∧ e0 * p * e0 = c • e0 + r := by
    intro p
    let c : K :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.coordinateCharacter D 0 p
    let C : B := algebraMap K B c
    let r : B := e0 * p * e0 - c • e0
    have hscalar : e0 * C * e0 = C * e0 := by
      calc
        e0 * C * e0 = (C * e0) * e0 := by
          rw [← Algebra.commutes c e0]
        _ = C * (e0 * e0) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = C * e0 := by rw [he0idem]
    have hbase : p * e0 - C * e0 ∈ J B := by
      simpa [e0, c, C] using
        QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.mul_liftedCoordinate_sub_coordinate_mem_jacobson
          D 0 p
    have hleft : e0 * (p * e0 - C * e0) ∈ J B :=
      (J B).mul_mem_left e0 hbase
    have hrJ : r ∈ J B := by
      have heq : e0 * (p * e0 - C * e0) = r := by
        dsimp [r, C]
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
        calc
          e0 * (p * e0 - C * e0) =
              e0 * p * e0 - e0 * C * e0 := by noncomm_ring
          _ = e0 * p * e0 - C * e0 := by rw [hscalar]
      rw [heq] at hleft
      exact hleft
    have he0r : e0 * r = r := by
      dsimp [r, C]
      simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
      calc
        e0 * (e0 * p * e0 - C * e0) =
            (e0 * e0) * p * e0 - e0 * C * e0 := by noncomm_ring
        _ = e0 * p * e0 - C * e0 := by rw [he0idem, hscalar]
    refine ⟨c, r, hrJ, he0r, ?_⟩
    dsimp [r]
    abel
  have hoff : forall p : B, e0 * p * e1 ∈ J B := by
    intro p
    exact D.offDiagonal_mem_jacobson (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) p
  exact relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_peirce
    he0idem hxleft haleft haright hbleft hbright he0a he1x he1b
      hxJ haJ hbJ hgen hdiag hoff hmem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.TwoCoordinateData.relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_cotangentSpanned
statement:
theorem relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_cotangentSpanned
    {x a b : B}
    (hxJ : x ∈ J B) (haJ : a ∈ J B) (hbJ : b ∈ J B)
    (hxleft : D.liftedCoordinate 0 * x = x)
    (haleft : D.liftedCoordinate 1 * a = a)
    (haright : a * D.liftedCoordinate 0 = a)
    (hbleft : D.liftedCoordinate 0 * b = b)
    (hbright : b * D.liftedCoordinate 1 = b)
    (hspan : JacobsonCotangentSpannedBy (K := K) x a b)
    (hmem : b * a ∈ loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal x a b) :
    exists t s : B, s ∈ J B ∧
      b * a = x * t + (b * a) * s
proof:
:=
  D.relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_jacobsonRightGenerated
    hxJ haJ hbJ hxleft haleft haright hbleft hbright
      (jacobsonRightGeneratedBy_of_cotangentSpanned hspan) hmem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.QuotientSurvival.TwoCoordinateData.six_relationQuotientClasses_linearIndependent_of_cotangentSpanned
statement:
theorem six_relationQuotientClasses_linearIndependent_of_cotangentSpanned
    [FiniteDimensional K B]
    {x a b : B}
    (hxJ : x ∈ J B) (haJ : a ∈ J B) (hbJ : b ∈ J B)
    (hxleft : D.liftedCoordinate 0 * x = x)
    (hxright : x * D.liftedCoordinate 0 = x)
    (haleft : D.liftedCoordinate 1 * a = a)
    (haright : a * D.liftedCoordinate 0 = a)
    (hbleft : D.liftedCoordinate 0 * b = b)
    (hbright : b * D.liftedCoordinate 1 = b)
    (hx2 : x ∉ (J B) ^ 2)
    (ha2 : a ∉ (J B) ^ 2)
    (hb2 : b ∉ (J B) ^ 2)
    (hcyclic : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.cyclicRightIdealFG (b * a) ≅
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.cyclicRightIdealFG x)
    (hspan : JacobsonCotangentSpannedBy (K := K) x a b) :
    LinearIndependent K
      (fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal x a b)
        (D.sixPeirceElements x a b i))
proof:
:= by
  apply D.six_quotientClasses_linearIndependent_of_peirceCotangent_of_normalForm
    hxJ haJ hbJ hxleft hxright haleft haright hbleft hbright
      hx2 ha2 hb2 hcyclic (loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal x a b)
      (loopTwoCycleRelationIdeal_le_jacobsonSquare hxJ haJ hbJ)
  intro hmem
  exact D.relationIdeal_membership_normalForm_of_cotangentSpanned
    hxJ haJ hbJ hxleft haleft haright hbleft hbright hspan hmem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TwoSimpleCoreThreeBasicization.support_trichotomy
statement:
theorem support_trichotomy
    (B : AlgebraNode K)
    (hConnected : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BlockDecomposition.Node.IsBlockConnected K B)
    (hProjective : projectiveCount K B = 2)
    (hCore : coreSize K B = 3) :
    letI : IsArtinianRing B.Carrier
proof:
:=
      IsArtinianRing.of_finite K B.Carrier
    let P := chosenBasicModel (K := K) B.Carrier
    letI : Ring P.Carrier := P.ring
    letI : Algebra K P.Carrier := P.algebra
    letI : FiniteDimensional K P.Carrier := P.finiteDimensional
    letI : IsNoetherianRing P.Carrier :=
      IsNoetherianRing.of_finite K P.Carrier
    letI : IsNoetherianRing P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K P.Carrier
    letI : IsArtinianRing P.Carrier :=
      IsArtinianRing.of_finite K P.Carrier
    letI : IsArtinianRing P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isArtinianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K P.Carrier
    let rho :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BlockDecomposition.Node.canonicalLeftSkeleton K P.Carrier
    let E := MoritaEquivalence.alignedFgEquivalence
      P.morita B.skeleton rho
    letI : Finite
        (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u} P.Carrier) :=
      E.labelEquiv.finite_iff.mp inferInstance
    let tau :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.rightIndecomposableSkeleton.{u, u, u} K P.Carrier
    let dual :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Contragredient.alignedBiduality K P.Carrier rho tau
    letI : Finite
        (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u} P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ) :=
      dual.forward.labelEquiv.finite_iff.mp inferInstance
    let hRank : projectiveRank tau = 2 := by
      have hTwoB : Nat.card B.skeleton.SimpleIndex = 2 :=
        (ncard_projectiveLabels_eq_natCard_simpleIndex B.skeleton).symm.trans
          hProjective
      have hTwoP : Nat.card rho.SimpleIndex = 2 :=
        (Nat.card_congr
          (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.HereditaryTwoSimpleBoundary.simpleIndexEquiv
            B.skeleton rho E)).symm.trans hTwoB
      have hTwoTau : Nat.card tau.SimpleIndex = 2 := by
        calc
          Nat.card tau.SimpleIndex = Nat.card rho.SimpleIndex :=
            Nat.card_congr
              (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.ExtDualTransport.AlignedAntiEquivalence.simpleIndexEquiv
                rho tau dual.forward).symm
          _ = 2 := hTwoP
      exact (ncard_projectiveLabels_eq_natCard_simpleIndex tau).trans hTwoTau
    let D :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BasicTwoCoordinateData.twoCoordinateDataOfIsBasicAlgebra
        tau P.basic hRank
    let G :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CoordinateGabrielRealization.ExtArrowCotangentRepresentativeData.automaticSplitBasicGabrielArrowRealization
        (K := K) (B := P.Carrier) (I := Fin 2)
        (kappa := QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u}
          P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ)
        (D := D) (tau := tau)
    let e :=
      (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.coordinateSimpleIndexEquiv
        D tau).symm
    let S := SplitBasicExtGabrielArrowRealization.twoVertexSupport
      tau G e
        (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.FiniteDimensionalNoParallelExt.noParallelExtSupport tau)
    S.NoLoops ∨
      (∃ i j, S.IsOneWayLollipopAt i j) ∨
      ∃ i j, S.IsLoopTwoCycleAt i j := by
  dsimp only
  letI : IsArtinianRing B.Carrier :=
    IsArtinianRing.of_finite K B.Carrier
  let P := chosenBasicModel (K := K) B.Carrier
  letI : Ring P.Carrier := P.ring
  letI : Algebra K P.Carrier := P.algebra
  letI : FiniteDimensional K P.Carrier := P.finiteDimensional
  letI : IsNoetherianRing P.Carrier :=
    IsNoetherianRing.of_finite K P.Carrier
  letI : IsNoetherianRing P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K P.Carrier
  letI : IsArtinianRing P.Carrier :=
    IsArtinianRing.of_finite K P.Carrier
  letI : IsArtinianRing P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isArtinianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K P.Carrier
  let rho :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BlockDecomposition.Node.canonicalLeftSkeleton K P.Carrier
  let E := MoritaEquivalence.alignedFgEquivalence
    P.morita B.skeleton rho
  letI : Finite
      (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u} P.Carrier) :=
    E.labelEquiv.finite_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hTwoB : Nat.card B.skeleton.SimpleIndex = 2 :=
    (ncard_projectiveLabels_eq_natCard_simpleIndex B.skeleton).symm.trans
      hProjective
  have hTwoP : Nat.card rho.SimpleIndex = 2 :=
    (Nat.card_congr
      (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.HereditaryTwoSimpleBoundary.simpleIndexEquiv
        B.skeleton rho E)).symm.trans hTwoB
  have hCoreB :
      (quotientCore B.skeleton : Set B.Index).ncard = 3 := by
    simpa [coreSize, AlgebraNode.quotientCoreData,
      concreteQuotientCoreData] using hCore
  have hCoreRho :
      (quotientCore rho : Set
        (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u} P.Carrier)).ncard =
          3 :=
    (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.AlignedEquivalence.quotientCore_ncard_eq
      B.skeleton rho E).symm.trans hCoreB
  let tau :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.rightIndecomposableSkeleton.{u, u, u} K P.Carrier
  let dual :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Contragredient.alignedBiduality K P.Carrier rho tau
  letI : Finite
      (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u} P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ) :=
    dual.forward.labelEquiv.finite_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hTwoTau : Nat.card tau.SimpleIndex = 2 := by
    calc
      Nat.card tau.SimpleIndex = Nat.card rho.SimpleIndex :=
        Nat.card_congr
          (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.ExtDualTransport.AlignedAntiEquivalence.simpleIndexEquiv
            rho tau dual.forward).symm
      _ = 2 := hTwoP
  have hRank : projectiveRank tau = 2 :=
    (ncard_projectiveLabels_eq_natCard_simpleIndex tau).trans hTwoTau
  have hRingelRho : RingelCoreCardinality rho :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RingelStable.FaithfulCoreAdapter.ringelCoreCardinality_of_ringelEtaStableEquivalence
      rho K
  letI : IsNoetherianRing P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ
  have hCoreTau :
      (quotientCore tau : Set
        (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u}
          P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ)).ncard = 3 := by
    calc
      (quotientCore tau : Set
          (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u}
            P.Carrierᵐᵒᵖ)).ncard =
          (submoduleCore rho : Set
            (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u}
              P.Carrier)).ncard :=
        (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.AlignedBiduality.submoduleCore_ncard_eq_quotientCore
          rho tau dual).symm
      _ = (quotientCore rho : Set
          (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CanonicalIndecomposableIndex.{u, u}
            P.Carrier)).ncard := hRingelRho.symm
      _ = 3 := hCoreRho
  have hRingelTau : RingelCoreCardinality tau :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RingelStable.FaithfulCoreAdapter.ringelCoreCardinality_of_ringelEtaStableEquivalence
      tau K
  have hNoParallel : NoParallelExtSupport (K := K) tau :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.FiniteDimensionalNoParallelExt.noParallelExtSupport tau
  have hBasicConnected :
      ∀ z : P.Carrier, IsIdempotentElem z → IsMulCentral z →
        z = 0 ∨ z = 1 :=
    chosenBasicModel_isBlockConnected (K := K) B.Carrier hConnected
  exact
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CoordinateTwoVertexTrichotomy.trichotomy_of_basic_of_blockConnected
      tau P.basic hRingelTau hRank hCoreTau hNoParallel hBasicConnected

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.finiteAddClosure_op
statement:
private theorem finiteAddClosure_op
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    {G X : C}
    (h : AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure G X) :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
      (Opposite.op G) (Opposite.op X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h
  let E : Fin P.n → C := fun _ ↦ G
  let Eop : Fin P.n → Cᵒᵖ :=
    fun j ↦ Opposite.op (E j)
  let biproductOpIso :
      Opposite.op (biproduct E) ≅ biproduct Eop :=
    (biproduct.isoCoproduct E).op.symm ≪≫
      opCoproductIsoProduct E ≪≫
      (biproduct.isoProduct Eop).symm
  exact ⟨{
    n := P.n
    retract :=
      P.retract.op.trans
        (Retract.ofIso biproductOpIso) }⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.finiteAddClosure_unop
statement:
private theorem finiteAddClosure_unop
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    {G X : C}
    (h :
      AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (Opposite.op G) (Opposite.op X)) :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure G X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h
  let E : Fin P.n → C := fun _ ↦ G
  let Eop : Fin P.n → Cᵒᵖ :=
    fun j ↦ Opposite.op (E j)
  let biproductOpIso :
      Opposite.op (biproduct E) ≅ biproduct Eop :=
    (biproduct.isoCoproduct E).op.symm ≪≫
      opCoproductIsoProduct E ≪≫
      (biproduct.isoProduct Eop).symm
  exact ⟨{
    n := P.n
    retract :=
      (P.retract.op.map (unopUnop C)).trans
        (Retract.ofIso biproductOpIso.unop) }⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.finiteAddClosure_op_iff
statement:
private theorem finiteAddClosure_op_iff
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    {G X : C} :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (Opposite.op G) (Opposite.op X) ↔
      AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure G X
proof:
:=
  ⟨finiteAddClosure_unop, finiteAddClosure_op⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.finiteAddClosure_map_functor
statement:
private theorem finiteAddClosure_map_functor
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    [Category.{vC} C] [Preadditive C]
    [Category.{vD} D] [Preadditive D]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts D]
    (E : C ≌ D)
    {G X : C}
    (h : AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure G X) :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
      (E.functor.obj G) (E.functor.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h
  letI :
      PreservesBiproduct
        (fun _ : Fin P.n ↦ G) E.functor :=
    preservesBiproduct_of_preservesProduct E.functor
  exact ⟨{
    n := P.n
    retract :=
      (P.retract.map E.functor).trans
        (Retract.ofIso
          (E.functor.mapBiproduct
            (fun _ : Fin P.n ↦ G))) }⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.finiteAddClosure_map_equivalence_iff
statement:
private theorem finiteAddClosure_map_equivalence_iff
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    [Category.{vC} C] [Preadditive C]
    [Category.{vD} D] [Preadditive D]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    [HasFiniteBiproducts D]
    (E : C ≌ D)
    {G X : C} :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (E.functor.obj G) (E.functor.obj X) ↔
      AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure G X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' :=
      finiteAddClosure_map_functor E.symm h
    have h'' :
        AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          G (E.inverse.obj (E.functor.obj X)) :=
      (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure_iff_of_iso
        (E.unitIso.app G)).mpr h'
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := h''
    exact ⟨{
      n := P.n
      retract :=
        (Retract.ofIso (E.unitIso.app X)).trans
          P.retract }⟩
  · exact finiteAddClosure_map_functor E

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.isLeftRejective_of_isRightRejective_op
statement:
private theorem isLeftRejective_of_isRightRejective_op
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C]
    (P : ObjectProperty C)
    [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (h : CategoricalRejective.IsRightRejective P.op) :
    CategoricalRejective.IsLeftRejective P
proof:
:= by
  have hOpOp :
      CategoricalRejective.IsLeftRejective P.op.op :=
    CategoricalRejective.isLeftRejective_op_of_isRightRejective h
  have hImage :=
    CategoricalRejective.Equivalence.isLeftRejective_image
      (opOpEquivalence C) P.op.op hOpOp
  have hProperty :
      CategoricalRejective.imageProperty
          (opOpEquivalence C) P.op.op =
        P := by
    funext X
    rfl
  rw [hProperty] at hImage
  exact hImage

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.finiteProjective_restrictScalars_inverseImage
statement:
private theorem finiteProjective_restrictScalars_inverseImage
    {R S : Type u} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (e : R ≃+* S) :
    (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules R).inverseImage
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv e).functor =
      AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules S
proof:
:= by
  funext M
  apply propext
  let E :=
    ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv e
  let i :
      E.functor.obj (ModuleCat.of S S) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R R :=
    ModuleCat.restrictScalarsIsoOfEquiv e
  calc
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules R
          (E.functor.obj M) ↔
        AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (ModuleCat.of R R) (E.functor.obj M) :=
      (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure_regular_iff
        R (E.functor.obj M)).symm
    _ ↔
        AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (E.functor.obj (ModuleCat.of S S))
          (E.functor.obj M) :=
      (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure_iff_of_iso
        i).symm
    _ ↔
        AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (ModuleCat.of S S) M :=
      finiteAddClosure_map_equivalence_iff E
    _ ↔
        AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules S M :=
      AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure_regular_iff S M

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.oppositeFiniteProjective_eq_finiteAddClosure
statement:
private theorem oppositeFiniteProjective_eq_finiteAddClosure :
    (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules Aᵐᵒᵖ).op =
      AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (Opposite.op (regularRightModule A))
proof:
:= by
  funext X
  apply propext
  induction X with
  | op X =>
      exact
        (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure_regular_iff
          Aᵐᵒᵖ X).symm.trans
          finiteAddClosure_op_iff.symm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal_op
statement:
private theorem principalTwoSidedIdeal_op
    (e : A) :
    principalTwoSidedIdeal (op e) =
      (principalTwoSidedIdeal e).op
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_le.mpr
    rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.mem_op_iff.mpr <|
      TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span
        (Set.mem_singleton e)
  · let J := principalTwoSidedIdeal (op e)
    have hJ : J.unop.op = J := by
      apply SetLike.ext
      intro x
      simp
    change
      (principalTwoSidedIdeal e).op ≤ J
    rw [← hJ]
    exact
      (TwoSidedIdeal.opOrderIso (R := A)).monotone <| by
        apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_le.mpr
        rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact TwoSidedIdeal.mem_unop_iff.mpr <|
          TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span
            (Set.mem_singleton (op e))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.rightProjective_op_of_leftProjective
statement:
private theorem rightProjective_op_of_leftProjective
    (e : A)
    (h :
      IsLeftProjectiveIdeal
        (principalTwoSidedIdeal e)) :
    IsRightProjectiveIdeal
      (principalTwoSidedIdeal (op e))
proof:
:= by
  letI :
      Module.Projective A
        (principalTwoSidedIdeal e) := h
  let σ := doubleOpRingEquiv (A := A)
  letI : RingHomInvPair σ.toRingHom σ.symm.toRingHom :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv σ
  letI : RingHomInvPair σ.symm.toRingHom σ.toRingHom :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv σ.symm
  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv
    (principalIdealOpSemilinearEquiv e)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.idempotent_op
statement:
private theorem idempotent_op
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    IsIdempotentElem (op e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isIdempotentElem_iff]
  apply unop_injective
  simpa using he.eq

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.internalPrincipalAdd_iff_literal
statement:
private theorem internalPrincipalAdd_iff_literal
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (X : FiniteProjectives A) :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (principalFiniteProjective he) X ↔
      addPrincipalRightModule e X.obj
proof:
:= by
  exact
    IndecomposableSkeleton.LegalQuotientDeletionChain.finiteAddClosure_fullSubcategory_iff
        (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteProjectiveModules Aᵐᵒᵖ)
        (principalFiniteProjective he) X

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.internalPrincipalAdd_eq_literal
statement:
private theorem internalPrincipalAdd_eq_literal
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (principalFiniteProjective he) =
      (fun X : FiniteProjectives A ↦
        addPrincipalRightModule e X.obj)
proof:
:= by
  funext X
  exact propext (internalPrincipalAdd_iff_literal he X)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.duality_imageProperty_principal
statement:
private theorem duality_imageProperty_principal
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    CategoricalRejective.imageProperty
        (oppositeRingProjectiveDualityEquivalence (A := A))
      (fun X : FiniteProjectives Aᵐᵒᵖ ↦
          addPrincipalRightModule (op e) X.obj) =
      ObjectProperty.op
        (fun X : FiniteProjectives A ↦
          addPrincipalRightModule e X.obj)
proof:
:= by
  funext X
  apply propext
  induction X with
  | op X =>
      let E :=
        oppositeRingProjectiveDualityEquivalence (A := A)
      let G : FiniteProjectives Aᵐᵒᵖ :=
        principalFiniteProjective (idempotent_op he)
      let H : FiniteProjectives A :=
        principalFiniteProjective he
      change
        addPrincipalRightModule (op e)
            (E.inverse.obj (Opposite.op X)).obj ↔
          addPrincipalRightModule e X.obj
      rw [← internalPrincipalAdd_iff_literal
          (idempotent_op he)
          (E.inverse.obj (Opposite.op X)),
        ← internalPrincipalAdd_iff_literal he X]
      exact
        (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure_iff_of_iso
            (principalDualIso he).symm).trans <|
          (finiteAddClosure_map_equivalence_iff E.symm).trans <|
            finiteAddClosure_op_iff

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal_leftRejective_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem principalTwoSidedIdeal_leftRejective_of_finiteDimensional
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Algebra k A]
    [FiniteDimensional k A]
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hprojective :
      IsLeftProjectiveIdeal
        (principalTwoSidedIdeal e)) :
    CategoricalRejective.IsLeftRejective
      (fun X : FiniteProjectives A ↦
        addPrincipalRightModule e X.obj)
proof:
:= by
  let E :=
    oppositeRingProjectiveDualityEquivalence (A := A)
  have hRightProjective :
      IsRightProjectiveIdeal
        (principalTwoSidedIdeal (op e)) :=
    rightProjective_op_of_leftProjective e hprojective
  have hRight :
      CategoricalRejective.IsRightRejective
        (fun X : FiniteProjectives Aᵐᵒᵖ ↦
          addPrincipalRightModule (op e) X.obj) :=
    principalTwoSidedIdeal_rightRejective_of_finiteDimensional
      (A := Aᵐᵒᵖ) (k := k)
      (idempotent_op he) hRightProjective
  have hRightInternal :
      CategoricalRejective.IsRightRejective
        (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (principalFiniteProjective (idempotent_op he))) := by
    rw [internalPrincipalAdd_eq_literal
      (A := Aᵐᵒᵖ) (idempotent_op he)]
    exact hRight
  have hImage :=
    CategoricalRejective.Equivalence.isRightRejective_image
      E
      (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (principalFiniteProjective (idempotent_op he)))
      hRightInternal
  rw [internalPrincipalAdd_eq_literal
    (A := Aᵐᵒᵖ) (idempotent_op he)] at hImage
  rw [duality_imageProperty_principal he] at hImage
  have hInternalOp :
      CategoricalRejective.IsRightRejective
        (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (principalFiniteProjective he)).op := by
    rw [internalPrincipalAdd_eq_literal he]
    exact hImage
  have hLeft :
      CategoricalRejective.IsLeftRejective
        (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (principalFiniteProjective he)) :=
    isLeftRejective_of_isRightRejective_op
      (AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
        (principalFiniteProjective he))
      hInternalOp
  rw [internalPrincipalAdd_eq_literal he] at hLeft
  exact hLeft

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.addPrincipalRightModule_leftRejective_iff_leftProjectiveIdeal
statement:
theorem addPrincipalRightModule_leftRejective_iff_leftProjectiveIdeal
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Algebra k A]
    [FiniteDimensional k A]
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    CategoricalRejective.IsLeftRejective
        (fun X : FiniteProjectives A ↦
          addPrincipalRightModule e X.obj) ↔
      IsLeftProjectiveIdeal
        (principalTwoSidedIdeal e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact
      _root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.LeftBridge.principalTwoSidedIdeal_leftProjective_of_literal_leftRejective
        he
  · exact
      principalTwoSidedIdeal_leftRejective_of_finiteDimensional
        (k := k) he

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.IdempotentIdealChain.principalLeftTermsAreRejective_iff_leftProjective
statement:
theorem principalLeftTermsAreRejective_iff_leftProjective
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Algebra k A]
    [FiniteDimensional k A]
    (P : H.IdempotentPresentation) :
    H.PrincipalLeftTermsAreRejective P ↔
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        IsLeftProjectiveIdeal (H.ideal i.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hi :=
      (addPrincipalRightModule_leftRejective_iff_leftProjectiveIdeal
        (k := k) (P.isIdempotent i.castSucc)).mp
        (h i)
    rw [P.span_eq i.castSucc] at hi
    exact hi
  · intro h i
    apply
      (addPrincipalRightModule_leftRejective_iff_leftProjectiveIdeal
        (k := k) (P.isIdempotent i.castSucc)).mpr
    rw [P.span_eq i.castSucc]
    exact h i

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution_iff_levelCounts
statement:
theorem quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution_iff_levelCounts :
    σ.HasQuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        σ.qClosure.levelCount n = σ.sClosure.levelCount n
proof:

    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.levelPolynomial_eq_iff

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution_implies_weak
statement:

    σ.HasQuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution →
      σ.WeakQuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution
proof:
:= by

  unfold WeakQuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution
  rw [← QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.levelPolynomial_eval_one σ.qClosure,
    ← QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.levelPolynomial_eval_one σ.sClosure,

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution_of_bottom_top_four
statement:
theorem quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution_of_bottom_top_four
    (hcard : Nat.card ι ≤ 9)
    (hbottom : ∀ i ≤ 4,
      σ.qClosure.levelCount i = σ.sClosure.levelCount i)
    (htop : ∀ i ≤ 4,
      σ.qClosure.levelCount (Nat.card ι - i) =
        σ.sClosure.levelCount (Nat.card ι - i)) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.map_smul_ground
statement:
theorem map_smul_ground
    {D E : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D →ₗ[B0Model K]
      FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K E)
    (c : K) (v : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D) :
    f (c • v) = c • f v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (B0Model K) c v,
    f.map_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.map_ofV1
statement:
theorem map_ofV1
    {D E : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D →ₗ[B0Model K]
      FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K E)
    (v : D.V₁) :
    f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v) =
      FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E (homV1 K f v)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v) =
        f (e1 K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v) := by
      rw [FiniteB0Rep.e1_smul_ofV₁]
    _ = e1 K • f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v) := by rw [f.map_smul]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E (homV1 K f v) := by
      rw [FiniteB0Rep.e1_smul]
      rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.map_ofV2
statement:
theorem map_ofV2
    {D E : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D →ₗ[B0Model K]
      FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K E)
    (v : D.V₂) :
    f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D v) =
      FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K E (homV2 K f v)
proof:
:= by
  have he2 :
      e2 K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D v =
        FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D v := by
    rw [FiniteB0Rep.e2_smul]
    rfl
  calc
    f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D v) =
        f (e2 K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D v) := by rw [he2]
    _ = e2 K • f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D v) := by rw [f.map_smul]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K E (homV2 K f v) := by
      rw [FiniteB0Rep.e2_smul]
      rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.map_eq_components
statement:
theorem map_eq_components
    {D E : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D →ₗ[B0Model K]
      FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K E)
    (v : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D) :
    f v = FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E
        (homV1 K f (FiniteB0Rep.fst K D v)) +
      FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K E
        (homV2 K f (FiniteB0Rep.snd K D v))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f v = f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D (FiniteB0Rep.fst K D v) +
        FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D (FiniteB0Rep.snd K D v)) :=
      congrArg f (FiniteB0Rep.decompose K D v)
    _ = f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D (FiniteB0Rep.fst K D v)) +
        f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D (FiniteB0Rep.snd K D v)) := by rw [map_add]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E
          (homV1 K f (FiniteB0Rep.fst K D v)) +
        FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K E
          (homV2 K f (FiniteB0Rep.snd K D v)) := by
      rw [map_ofV1 K f, map_ofV2 K f]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  rw [map_eq_components K f v, map_eq_components K g v, h1, h2]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.homV1_loop
statement:
theorem homV1_loop
    {D E : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D →ₗ[B0Model K]
      FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K E)
    (v : D.V₁) :
    homV1 K f (D.loop.hom.hom v) =
      E.loop.hom.hom (homV1 K f v)
proof:
:= by
  have hxD :
      x K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v =
        FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D (D.loop.hom.hom v) := by
    rw [FiniteB0Rep.x_smul]
    rfl
  have hxE :
      x K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E (homV1 K f v) =
        FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E (E.loop.hom.hom (homV1 K f v)) := by
    rw [FiniteB0Rep.x_smul]
    rfl
  calc
    homV1 K f (D.loop.hom.hom v) =
        FiniteB0Rep.fst K E
          (f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D (D.loop.hom.hom v))) := rfl
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.fst K E
          (f (x K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v)) := by rw [hxD]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.fst K E
          (x K • f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v)) := by rw [f.map_smul]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.fst K E
          (x K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E (homV1 K f v)) := by
      rw [map_ofV1 K f]
    _ = E.loop.hom.hom (homV1 K f v) := by
      rw [hxE]
      exact FiniteB0Rep.fst_ofV₁ K E _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.homV2_stem
statement:
theorem homV2_stem
    {D E : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D →ₗ[B0Model K]
      FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K E)
    (v : D.V₁) :
    homV2 K f (D.stem.hom.hom v) =
      E.stem.hom.hom (homV1 K f v)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    homV2 K f (D.stem.hom.hom v) =
        FiniteB0Rep.snd K E
          (f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₂ K D (D.stem.hom.hom v))) := rfl
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.snd K E
          (f (a K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v)) := by
      rw [FiniteB0Rep.a_smul_ofV₁]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.snd K E
          (a K • f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v)) := by rw [f.map_smul]
    _ = FiniteB0Rep.snd K E
          (a K • FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K E (homV1 K f v)) := by
      rw [map_ofV1 K f]
    _ = E.stem.hom.hom (homV1 K f v) := by
      rw [FiniteB0Rep.a_smul_ofV₁]
      rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.linearMap_K_apply
statement:
theorem linearMap_K_apply
    (g : K →ₗ[K] K) (c : K) : g c = c * g 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    g c = g (c • (1 : K)) := by simp
    _ = c • g 1 := by rw [map_smul]
    _ = c * g 1 := rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.homV1_idempotent_apply
statement:
theorem homV1_idempotent_apply
    {D : FiniteB0Rep K}
    (f : Module.End (B0Model K) (FiniteB0Rep.Carrier K D))
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (v : D.V₁) :
    homV1 K f (homV1 K f v) = homV1 K f v
proof:
:= by
  have hff : f (f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v)) =
      f (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v) := by
    simpa [Module.End.mul_apply] using
      DFunLike.congr_fun hf (FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K D v)
  rw [map_ofV1 K f, map_ofV1 K f] at hff
  have h := congrArg (FiniteB0Rep.fst K D) hff
  simpa only [FiniteB0Rep.fst_ofV₁] using h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.S1_indec
statement:
theorem S1_indec :
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule (B0Model K) (S1Module K)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nontrivial (S1Module K) := S1_nontrivial K
  apply QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isIndecomposableModule_of_forall_isIdempotentElem
  intro f hf
  let g : K →ₗ[K] K := homV1 K f
  have hsq : g 1 * g 1 = g 1 := by
    have h := homV1_idempotent_apply K f hf (1 : K)
    change g (g 1) = g 1 at h
    rw [linearMap_K_apply K] at h
    exact h
  have hpow : (g 1) ^ 2 = g 1 := by simpa [pow_two] using hsq
  rcases eq_zero_or_one_of_sq_eq_self hpow with hzero | hone
  · left
    apply hom_ext K
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro c
      simp only [g] at hzero
      rw [linearMap_K_apply K, hzero]
      simp [homV1]
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · right
    apply hom_ext K
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro c
      simp only [g] at hone
      rw [linearMap_K_apply K, hone]
      rw [mul_one]
      change c = (LinearMap.fst K K (Fin 0 → K))
        ((LinearMap.inl K K (Fin 0 → K)) c)
      rfl
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.linearMap_commuting_jordan_formula
statement:
theorem linearMap_commuting_jordan_formula
    (g : K × K →ₗ[K] K × K)
    (hcomm : ∀ p : K × K, g (0, p.1) = (0, (g p).1))
    (u v : K) :
    g (u, v) =
      (u * (g (1, 0)).1,
        u * (g (1, 0)).2 + v * (g (1, 0)).1)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 : g (0, 1) = (0, (g (1, 0)).1) := by
    simpa using hcomm (1, 0)
  have huv : (u, v) = u • (1, 0) + v • (0, 1) := by
    ext <;> simp
  rw [huv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, h01]
  ext <;> simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.jordan_idempotent_eq_zero_or_id
statement:
theorem jordan_idempotent_eq_zero_or_id
    (g : K × K →ₗ[K] K × K)
    (hcomm : ∀ p : K × K, g (0, p.1) = (0, (g p).1))
    (hidem : ∀ p : K × K, g (g p) = g p) :
    g = 0 ∨ g = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  let alpha : K := (g (1, 0)).1
  let beta : K := (g (1, 0)).2
  have hone := hidem (1, 0)
  rw [linearMap_commuting_jordan_formula K g hcomm] at hone
  have halpha : alpha ^ 2 = alpha := by
    have h := congrArg Prod.fst hone
    simpa [alpha, pow_two] using h
  have hbeta : alpha * beta + beta * alpha = beta := by
    have h := congrArg Prod.snd hone
    simpa [alpha, beta] using h
  rcases eq_zero_or_one_of_sq_eq_self halpha with ha | ha
  · have hb : beta = 0 := by simpa [ha] using hbeta.symm
    left
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro p
    rcases p with ⟨u, v⟩
    rw [linearMap_commuting_jordan_formula K g hcomm]
    change (u * alpha, u * beta + v * alpha) = 0
    simp [ha, hb]
  · have hb : beta = 0 := by simpa [ha] using hbeta
    right
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro p
    rcases p with ⟨u, v⟩
    rw [linearMap_commuting_jordan_formula K g hcomm]
    change (u * alpha, u * beta + v * alpha) = (u, v)
    simp [ha, hb]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.X_homV1_commutes_jordan
statement:
theorem X_homV1_commutes_jordan
    (f : Module.End (B0Model K) (XModule K)) (p : K × K) :
    homV1 K f (0, p.1) = (0, (homV1 K f p).1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := homV1_loop K f p
  change homV1 K f (0, p.1) = (0, (homV1 K f p).1) at h
  exact h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.X_indec
statement:
theorem X_indec :
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule (B0Model K) (XModule K)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nontrivial (XModule K) := X_nontrivial K
  apply QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isIndecomposableModule_of_forall_isIdempotentElem
  intro f hf
  let g : K × K →ₗ[K] K × K := homV1 K f
  have hcomm : ∀ p : K × K, g (0, p.1) = (0, (g p).1) := by
    intro p
    exact X_homV1_commutes_jordan K f p
  have hidem : ∀ p : K × K, g (g p) = g p := by
    intro p
    exact homV1_idempotent_apply K f hf p
  rcases jordan_idempotent_eq_zero_or_id K g hcomm hidem with hg | hg
  · left
    apply hom_ext K
    · exact hg.trans (homV1_zero K (D := XData K)).symm
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · right
    apply hom_ext K
    · exact hg.trans (homV1_one K (D := XData K)).symm
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

statement:
theorem P_homV2_eq_homV1_fst

    homV2 K f p.1 = (homV1 K f p).1
proof:
:= by

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.P_indec
statement:
theorem P_indec :
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule (B0Model K) (PModule K)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nontrivial (PModule K) := P_nontrivial K
  apply QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isIndecomposableModule_of_forall_isIdempotentElem
  intro f hf
  let g : K × K →ₗ[K] K × K := homV1 K f
  have hcomm : ∀ p : K × K, g (0, p.1) = (0, (g p).1) := by
    intro p
    exact P_homV1_commutes_jordan K f p
  have hidem : ∀ p : K × K, g (g p) = g p := by
    intro p
    exact homV1_idempotent_apply K f hf p
  rcases jordan_idempotent_eq_zero_or_id K g hcomm hidem with hg | hg
  · left
    apply hom_ext K
    · exact hg.trans (homV1_zero K (D := PData K)).symm
    · have hV2zero : homV2 K f = 0 := by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro c
        rw [P_homV2_eq_homV1_fst K f (c, 0)]
        change (g (c, 0)).1 = 0
        rw [hg]
        rfl
      exact hV2zero.trans (homV2_zero K (D := PData K)).symm
  · right
    apply hom_ext K
    · exact hg.trans (homV1_one K (D := PData K)).symm
    · have hV2one : homV2 K f = LinearMap.id := by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro c
        rw [P_homV2_eq_homV1_fst K f (c, 0)]
        change (g (c, 0)).1 = c
        rw [hg]
        rfl
      exact hV2one.trans (homV2_one K (D := PData K)).symm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.ModuleLayer.NamedModules.S1_not_iso_S2
statement: theorem S1_not_iso_S2 : ¬ Nonempty (S1Module K ≅ S2Module K)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  have hz : e.hom = 0 := hom_S1_S2_eq_zero K e.hom
  let v : S1Module K :=
    FiniteB0Rep.ofV₁ K (S1Data K) (1 : K)
  have hv : (FGModuleCat.isoToLinearEquiv e) v = 0 := by
    change e.hom.hom.hom v = 0
    rw [hz]
    rfl
  have hv0 : (FGModuleCat.isoToLinearEquiv e) v =
      (FGModuleCat.isoToLinearEquiv e) 0 := by
    simpa using hv
  have hvzero : v = 0 :=
    (FGModuleCat.isoToLinearEquiv e).injective hv0
  have hcoord :=
    congrArg (FiniteB0Rep.fst K (S1Data K)) hvzero
  change (1 : K) = 0 at hcoord
  exact one_ne_zero hcoord

statement: theorem X_a_smul_zero (z : XModule K) : a K • z = 0

  apply FiniteB0Rep.carrier_ext K (XData K)
