name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.qCofiniteTwoCount_eq_choose_add_natCard_QIrreducibleBoundaryPair
statement:
theorem qCofiniteTwoCount_eq_choose_add_natCard_QIrreducibleBoundaryPair :
    σ.qClosure.cofiniteTwoCount =
      Nat.choose σ.topSplitProjectiveIndices.card 2 +
        Nat.card σ.QIrreducibleBoundaryPair
proof:
:= by

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedTriangularAlgebra.realized_isIndecomposable_iff
statement:
theorem realized_isIndecomposable_iff
    (D : SeparatedData.{u, v, w} (S := S) (J := J)) :
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule (Algebra S J) (Realized D) ↔
      IsIndecomposableSeparatedData D
proof:
:= by
  let F := realizationFunctor (S := S) (J := J)
  constructor
  · intro hD
    refine ⟨hD.nontrivial, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    have hpmap : F.map p ≫ F.map p = F.map p := by
      rw [← F.map_comp, hp]
    have hpIdem : IsIdempotentElem (F.map p).hom := by
      change (F.map p).hom.comp (F.map p).hom = (F.map p).hom
      exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hpmap
    rcases hD.eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem hpIdem with
      hzero | hone
    · left
      apply F.map_injective
      apply ModuleCat.Hom.ext
      exact hzero
    · right
      apply F.map_injective
      apply ModuleCat.Hom.ext
      exact hone
  · intro hD
    letI : Nontrivial (Realized D) := hD.1
    apply QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isIndecomposableModule_of_forall_isIdempotentElem
    intro f hf
    let fCat : realizedModuleCat D ⟶ realizedModuleCat D :=
      ModuleCat.ofHom f
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := F.map_surjective fCat
    have hpIdem : p ≫ p = p := by
      apply F.map_injective
      rw [F.map_comp, hp]
      apply ModuleCat.Hom.ext
      exact hf
    rcases hD.2 p hpIdem with hzero | hone
    · left
      have hfCat : fCat = 0 := by
        rw [← hp]
        simp [hzero]
        rfl
      exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hfCat
    · right
      have hfCat : fCat = 𝟙 _ := by
        rw [← hp]
        simp [hone]
        rfl
      exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hfCat

theorem ofModule_isIndecomposableSeparatedData

    IsIndecomposableSeparatedData (ofModule (S := S) (J := J) X)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofModule (S := S) (J := J) X
  let e := realizedOfModuleIso (S := S) (J := J) X
  have hRealized : @QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule
      (Algebra S J) (Realized D) _ _ (realizedModule D) :=
    @QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule.of_linearEquiv
      (Algebra S J) X _ _ X.isModule
      (Realized D) _ (realizedModule D)
      hX e.symm.toLinearEquiv
  exact (realized_isIndecomposable_iff D).1 hRealized

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedTriangularAlgebra.top_isIndecomposable_of_radical_subsingleton
statement:
theorem top_isIndecomposable_of_radical_subsingleton
    (D : SeparatedData.{u, v, w} (S := S) (J := J))
    (hD : IsIndecomposableSeparatedData D) [Subsingleton D.radical] :
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule S D.top
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nontrivial D.top := by
    rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]
    intro htop
    letI : Subsingleton D.top := htop
    exact not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mpr hD.1
      (inferInstance : Subsingleton (D.top × D.radical))
  apply QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isIndecomposableModule_of_forall_isIdempotentElem
  intro f hf
  let p : D ⟶ D :=
    ⟨(f, 0), by
      intro j t
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  have hp : p ≫ p = p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hf
    · ext d
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rcases hD.2 p hp with hpzero | hpone
  · left
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.val.1) hpzero
  · right
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.val.1) hpone

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedTriangularAlgebra.radical_isIndecomposable_of_top_subsingleton
statement:
theorem radical_isIndecomposable_of_top_subsingleton
    (D : SeparatedData.{u, v, w} (S := S) (J := J))
    (hD : IsIndecomposableSeparatedData D) [Subsingleton D.top] :
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule S D.radical
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nontrivial D.radical := by
    rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]
    intro hrad
    letI : Subsingleton D.radical := hrad
    exact not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mpr hD.1
      (inferInstance : Subsingleton (D.top × D.radical))
  apply QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isIndecomposableModule_of_forall_isIdempotentElem
  intro f hf
  let p : D ⟶ D :=
    ⟨(0, f), by
      intro j t
      rw [show t = 0 from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
      simp⟩
  have hp : p ≫ p = p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · ext t
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · exact hf
  rcases hD.2 p hp with hpzero | hpone
  · left
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.val.2) hpzero
  · right
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.val.2) hpone

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedTriangularAlgebra.realized_simple_of_top
statement:
theorem realized_simple_of_top
    (D : SeparatedData.{u, v, w} (S := S) (J := J))
    (hTop : IsSimpleModule S D.top) [Subsingleton D.radical] :
    Simple (realizedModuleCat D)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (Algebra S J) D.top :=
    Module.compHom D.top (topAugmentation (S := S) (J := J))
  letI : RingHomSurjective (topAugmentation (S := S) (J := J)) :=
    ⟨topAugmentation_surjective (S := S) (J := J)⟩
  let l : D.top →ₛₗ[topAugmentation (S := S) (J := J)] D.top :=
    { toFun := id
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hl : Function.Bijective l := Function.bijective_id
  have hTopA : IsSimpleModule (Algebra S J) D.top :=
    (l.isSimpleModule_iff_of_bijective hl).2 hTop
  let e : Realized D ≃ₗ[Algebra S J] D.top :=
    { toFun := Prod.fst
      invFun := fun t ↦ (t, 0)
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      left_inv := fun x ↦ Prod.ext rfl (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  have hRealized : IsSimpleModule (Algebra S J) (Realized D) :=
    (e.isSimpleModule_iff).2 hTopA
  exact (simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (realizedModuleCat D)).2 hRealized

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedTriangularAlgebra.realized_simple_of_radical
statement:
theorem realized_simple_of_radical
    (D : SeparatedData.{u, v, w} (S := S) (J := J))
    [Subsingleton D.top]
    (hRadical : IsSimpleModule S D.radical) :
    Simple (realizedModuleCat D)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (Algebra S J) D.radical :=
    Module.compHom D.radical
      (radicalAugmentation (S := S) (J := J))
  letI : RingHomSurjective
      (radicalAugmentation (S := S) (J := J)) :=
    ⟨radicalAugmentation_surjective (S := S) (J := J)⟩
  let l : D.radical →ₛₗ[radicalAugmentation (S := S) (J := J)]
      D.radical :=
    { toFun := id
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hl : Function.Bijective l := Function.bijective_id
  have hRadicalA : IsSimpleModule (Algebra S J) D.radical :=
    (l.isSimpleModule_iff_of_bijective hl).2 hRadical
  let e : Realized D ≃ₗ[Algebra S J] D.radical :=
    { toFun := Prod.snd
      invFun := fun d ↦ (0, d)
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun r x ↦ by
        change r.fst.1 • x.2 + D.action r.snd.val x.1 =
          r.fst.1 • x.2
        rw [show x.1 = 0 from Subsingleton.elim _ _, map_zero, add_zero]
      left_inv := fun x ↦ Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  have hRealized : IsSimpleModule (Algebra S J) (Realized D) :=
    (e.isSimpleModule_iff).2 hRadicalA
  exact (simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (realizedModuleCat D)).2 hRealized

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedTriangularAlgebra.realized_not_simple_of_top_radical_nontrivial
statement:
theorem realized_not_simple_of_top_radical_nontrivial
    (D : SeparatedData.{u, v, w} (S := S) (J := J))
    [Nontrivial D.top] [Nontrivial D.radical] :
    ¬ Simple (realizedModuleCat D)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsimple
  letI : IsSimpleModule (Algebra S J) (Realized D) :=
    (simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (realizedModuleCat D)).1 hsimple
  let N : Submodule (Algebra S J) (Realized D) := {
    carrier := {x | x.1 = 0}
    zero_mem' := rfl
    add_mem' := by
      intro x y hx hy
      change x.1 + y.1 = 0
      rw [hx, hy, add_zero]
    smul_mem' := by
      intro r x hx
      change r.fst.2 • x.1 = 0
      rw [hx, smul_zero] }
  rcases eq_bot_or_eq_top N with hbot | htop
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_ne (0 : D.radical)
    have hm : ((0, d) : Realized D) ∈ N := rfl
    rw [hbot] at hm
    have hz : ((0, d) : Realized D) = 0 := hm
    exact hd (congrArg Prod.snd hz)
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_ne (0 : D.top)
    have hm : ((t, 0) : Realized D) ∈ N := by
      rw [htop]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    exact ht hm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.ActualTwoTopLoewyData.normalizedRadicalSequence_shortExact
proof:
:= by
  let radicalIso :
      ((⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj) :
          ModuleCat.{w} R) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R (sigma.moduleRadical j) :=
    ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi
        (fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj) ≪≫
      (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit R
        (sigma.obj D.radical.1)).toModuleIso ≪≫
      L.radicalEquiv.toModuleIso
  let leftIso :
      ((⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj) :
          ModuleCat.{w} R) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R (sigma.obj D.left.index) :=
    ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi
        (fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj) ≪≫
      (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit R
        (sigma.obj D.left.index)).toModuleIso
  let rightIso :
      ((⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj) :
          ModuleCat.{w} R) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R (sigma.obj D.right.index) :=
    ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi
        (fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj) ≪≫
      (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit R
        (sigma.obj D.right.index)).toModuleIso
  let topIso :
      (((⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj) ⊞
          (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj)) :
          ModuleCat.{w} R) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R (sigma.moduleTop j) :=
    biprod.mapIso leftIso rightIso ≪≫
      ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd
        (ModuleCat.of R (sigma.obj D.left.index))
        (ModuleCat.of R (sigma.obj D.right.index)) ≪≫
      L.topEquiv.toModuleIso
  let eMiddle :
      (sigma.obj j) ≃ₗ[R] (sigma.obj j) :=
    LinearEquiv.refl R (sigma.obj j)
  let radicalInclusion :
      sigma.moduleRadical j →ₗ[R] sigma.obj j :=
    (sigma.moduleRadical j).subtype
  let topProjection :
      sigma.obj j →ₗ[R] sigma.moduleTop j :=
    (sigma.moduleRadical j).mkQ
  have hexact : Function.Exact radicalInclusion topProjection :=
    LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ (sigma.moduleRadical j)
  apply ModuleCat.shortComplexOfConj_shortExact
    radicalIso.toLinearEquiv eMiddle topIso.toLinearEquiv
    radicalInclusion topProjection hexact
    (sigma.moduleRadical j).subtype_injective
    (sigma.moduleRadical j).mkQ_surjective

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaTwoSourceReduction.exists_actualTwoTopLoewyData_of_nonsimple_inFac
statement:
theorem exists_actualTwoTopLoewyData_of_nonsimple_inFac
    (K A : Type x)
    [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [Ring A] [Algebra K A] [FiniteDimensional K A] :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
proof:
:=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K A
    ∀ {iota : Type x} [Finite iota]
      (sigma :
        _root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.{x, x, x}
          Aᵐᵒᵖ iota)
      (apex : sigma.TwoTopQuotientShapeIndex)
      (D : sigma.ActualTwoTopApexData apex)
      {j : iota},
      sigma.InFac (sigma.twoTopQuotientShapeSupport apex)
          (sigma.obj j) →
        (¬ IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j)) →
          Nonempty (sigma.ActualTwoTopLoewyData D j) := by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K A
  intro iota _ sigma apex D j hj hjNonsimple
  letI : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj D.left.index) :=
    (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
      (sigma.obj D.left.index)).mp D.left.simple
  letI : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj D.right.index) :=
    (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
      (sigma.obj D.right.index)).mp D.right.simple
  letI : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj D.radical.1) :=
    (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
      (sigma.obj D.radical.1)).mp D.radical.2
  have hradData :=
    sigma.radical_semisimple_and_isotypic_of_inFac_twoTopSupport D hj
  letI : IsSemisimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleRadical j) :=
    hradData.1
  obtain ⟨k, eRadical, hkLength⟩ :=
    LoewyTwoRankCore.exists_isotypicMultiplicity hradData.2
  letI : IsArtinian Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (sigma.finiteLength j)).2
  have hradNeBot : sigma.moduleRadical j ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    letI : IsSemisimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j) := by
      rw [IsArtinian.isSemisimpleModule_iff_jacobson]
      exact hbot
    exact hjNonsimple
      (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.isSimpleModule_of_semisimple_of_indecomposable
        (sigma.indecomposable j))
  have hradPos :
      0 < Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleRadical j) :=
    Module.length_pos_iff.mpr
      ((Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot).mpr hradNeBot)
  have hk : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hknot
    have hkzero : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hknot
    have hlenzero :
        Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleRadical j) = 0 := by
      rw [← hkLength, hkzero]
      rfl
    exact (ne_of_gt hradPos) hlenzero
  have hquotients :
      ∀ Q : sigma.SimpleQuotient j,
        Q.index = D.left.index ∨ Q.index = D.right.index :=
    fun Q ↦
      sigma.simpleQuotient_index_eq_left_or_right_of_inFac_twoTopSupport
        D hj Q
  letI : IsSemisimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleTop j) :=
    sigma.moduleTop_isSemisimple j
  obtain ⟨n, m, ⟨eTop⟩⟩ :=
    TwoTypeSemisimple.exists_twoTypeDecomposition
      (R := Aᵐᵒᵖ) (M := sigma.moduleTop j)
      (S := sigma.obj D.left.index)
      (T := sigma.obj D.right.index)
      (fun L hL ↦
        sigma.simpleTopSubmodule_type_eq_left_or_right
          hquotients L hL)
  have hnoParallel : NoParallelExtOne sigma K :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.NoParallelExtOne.noParallelExtOne_of_finiteDimensional_of_finiteSkeleton
      K A sigma
  have hbounds :=
    forkMultiplicityBounds_of_threeTypeDecomposition
      sigma K hnoParallel D.left.simple D.right.simple D.radical.2
      k eRadical.symm n m eTop.symm hk
  have hkOne : k = 1 := by omega
  have hradLength :
      Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleRadical j) = 1 := by
    rw [← hkLength, hkOne]
    rfl
  have hjLength : sigma.compositionLength j = 3 :=
    compositionLength_eq_three_of_nonsimple_inFac_actualTwoTopApex
      K A sigma apex D hj hjNonsimple
  have hjLengthModule :
      Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j) = 3 := by
    rw [← sigma.coe_compositionLength, hjLength]
    rfl
  have htopLengthFormula :
      Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleTop j) =
        (n : ℕ∞) + (m : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [eTop.length_eq, Module.length_prod,
      Module.length_pi_of_fintype,
      Module.length_pi_of_fintype]
    simp [Module.length_eq_one]
  have hnmTwo : n + m = 2 := by
    have hadd := Module.length_eq_add_of_exact
      (sigma.moduleRadical j).subtype
      (sigma.moduleRadical j).mkQ
      (sigma.moduleRadical j).subtype_injective
      (sigma.moduleRadical j).mkQ_surjective
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ (sigma.moduleRadical j))
    have hcoe : (3 : ℕ∞) = ((1 + (n + m) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      calc
        (3 : ℕ∞) =
            Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j) :=
          hjLengthModule.symm
        _ = Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleRadical j) +
              Module.length Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.moduleTop j) := hadd
        _ = (1 : ℕ∞) + ((n : ℕ∞) + (m : ℕ∞)) := by
          rw [hradLength, htopLengthFormula]
        _ = ((1 + (n + m) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
          norm_num
    have hnat : 3 = 1 + (n + m) := ENat.coe_inj.mp hcoe
    omega
  have hnOne : n = 1 := by omega
  have hmOne : m = 1 := by omega
  subst k
  subst n
  subst m
  let radicalEquiv :
      sigma.obj D.radical.1 ≃ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] sigma.moduleRadical j :=
    (LinearEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (sigma.obj D.radical.1)).symm.trans eRadical.symm
  let topEquiv :
      (sigma.obj D.left.index × sigma.obj D.right.index) ≃ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ]
        sigma.moduleTop j :=
    ((LinearEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) Aᵐᵒᵖ
        (sigma.obj D.left.index)).symm.prodCongr
      (LinearEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) Aᵐᵒᵖ
        (sigma.obj D.right.index)).symm).trans eTop.symm
  exact ⟨⟨radicalEquiv, topEquiv⟩⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaExtReflection.ext_eq_of_two_scalarizedExtMatrices_eq
statement:
theorem ext_eq_of_two_scalarizedExtMatrices_eq
    {I J L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype L]
    (X X' Y : C)
    (ell : Ext X Y 1 →ₗ[K] K) (hell : Function.Injective ell)
    (ell' : Ext X' Y 1 →ₗ[K] K) (hell' : Function.Injective ell')
    {xi eta :
      Ext
        ((⨁ fun _ : I ↦ X) ⊞ (⨁ fun _ : J ↦ X'))
        (⨁ fun _ : L ↦ Y) 1}
    (hleft :
      scalarizedExtMatrix X Y ell (extBiprodLeft xi) =
        scalarizedExtMatrix X Y ell (extBiprodLeft eta))
    (hright :
      scalarizedExtMatrix X' Y ell' (extBiprodRight xi) =
        scalarizedExtMatrix X' Y ell' (extBiprodRight eta)) :
    xi = eta
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_eq_of_extBiprodLeft_right_eq
  · apply ext_eq_of_biproductExtComponent_eq X Y
    intro i l
    apply hell
    exact congrFun (congrFun hleft l) i
  · apply ext_eq_of_biproductExtComponent_eq X' Y
    intro j l
    apply hell'
    exact congrFun (congrFun hright l) j

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaExtReflection.scalarizedExtMatrix_extBiprodLeft_pre_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem scalarizedExtMatrix_extBiprodLeft_pre_blockDiagonal
    {I J L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype L]
    (X X' Y : C) (ell : Ext X Y 1 →ₗ[K] K)
    (xi :
      Ext
        ((⨁ fun _ : I ↦ X) ⊞ (⨁ fun _ : J ↦ X'))
        (⨁ fun _ : L ↦ Y) 1)
    (P : Matrix I I K) (Q : Matrix J J K) :
    scalarizedExtMatrix X Y ell
        (extBiprodLeft
          ((Ext.mk₀
            (blockDiagonalBiprodEnd
              (scalarBiproductEnd X P)
              (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q))).comp
            xi (zero_add 1))) =
      scalarizedExtMatrix X Y ell (extBiprodLeft xi) * P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrestrict :
      extBiprodLeft
          ((Ext.mk₀
            (blockDiagonalBiprodEnd
              (scalarBiproductEnd X P)
              (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q))).comp
            xi (zero_add 1)) =
        (Ext.mk₀ (scalarBiproductEnd X P)).comp
          (extBiprodLeft xi) (zero_add 1) := by
    unfold extBiprodLeft
    rw [← Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
    simp [blockDiagonalBiprodEnd]
  rw [hrestrict]
  ext l i
  change
    ell
        (biproductExtComponent X Y
          ((Ext.mk₀ (scalarBiproductEnd X P)).comp
            (extBiprodLeft xi) (zero_add 1)) i l) =
      ∑ k,
        ell (biproductExtComponent X Y (extBiprodLeft xi) k l) *
          P k i
  rw [biproductExtComponent_pre_scalarBiproductEnd]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact mul_comm _ _

statement:
theorem scalarizedExtMatrix_extBiprodRight_pre_blockDiagonal
    {I J L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype L]
    (X X' Y : C) (ell' : Ext X' Y 1 →ₗ[K] K)
    (xi :
      Ext
        ((⨁ fun _ : I ↦ X) ⊞ (⨁ fun _ : J ↦ X'))
        (⨁ fun _ : L ↦ Y) 1)
    (P : Matrix I I K) (Q : Matrix J J K) :
    scalarizedExtMatrix X' Y ell'
        (extBiprodRight
          ((Ext.mk₀
            (blockDiagonalBiprodEnd
              (scalarBiproductEnd X P)
              (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q))).comp
            xi (zero_add 1))) =
      scalarizedExtMatrix X' Y ell' (extBiprodRight xi) * Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrestrict :
      extBiprodRight
          ((Ext.mk₀
            (blockDiagonalBiprodEnd
              (scalarBiproductEnd X P)
              (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q))).comp
            xi (zero_add 1)) =
        (Ext.mk₀ (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q)).comp
          (extBiprodRight xi) (zero_add 1) := by
    unfold extBiprodRight
    rw [← Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
    simp [blockDiagonalBiprodEnd]
  rw [hrestrict]
  ext l j
  change
    ell'
        (biproductExtComponent X' Y
          ((Ext.mk₀ (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q)).comp
            (extBiprodRight xi) (zero_add 1)) j l) =
      ∑ k,
        ell' (biproductExtComponent X' Y (extBiprodRight xi) k l) *
          Q k j
  rw [biproductExtComponent_pre_scalarBiproductEnd]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaExtReflection.unitFork_left_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem unitFork_left_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K]
    {V W Z : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
    [Nontrivial V] [Nontrivial Z]
    {f : V →ₗ[K] Z} {g : W →ₗ[K] Z}
    (hfg : IsTwoSourceIdempotentIndecomposable f g) :
    f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hf
  have hcommLeft :
      (0 : Z →ₗ[K] Z).comp f = f.comp LinearMap.id := by
    simp [hf]
  have hcommRight :
      (0 : Z →ₗ[K] Z).comp g =
        g.comp (0 : W →ₗ[K] W) := by
    ext
    simp
  rcases hfg LinearMap.id 0 0 (by ext; simp) (by ext; simp)
      (by ext; simp) hcommLeft hcommRight with hzero | hone
  · have hid : (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_ne (0 : V)
      have hv' := LinearMap.congr_fun h v
      exact hv (by simpa using hv')
    exact hid hzero.1
  · have hid : (LinearMap.id : Z →ₗ[K] Z) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : Z)
      have hz' := LinearMap.congr_fun h z
      exact hz (by simpa using hz')
    exact hid hone.2.2.symm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaExtReflection.unitFork_right_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem unitFork_right_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K]
    {V W Z : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module K Z]
    [Nontrivial W] [Nontrivial Z]
    {f : V →ₗ[K] Z} {g : W →ₗ[K] Z}
    (hfg : IsTwoSourceIdempotentIndecomposable f g) :
    g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hg
  have hcommLeft :
      (0 : Z →ₗ[K] Z).comp f =
        f.comp (0 : V →ₗ[K] V) := by
    ext
    simp
  have hcommRight :
      (0 : Z →ₗ[K] Z).comp g = g.comp LinearMap.id := by
    simp [hg]
  rcases hfg 0 LinearMap.id 0 (by ext; simp) (by ext; simp)
      (by ext; simp) hcommLeft hcommRight with hzero | hone
  · have hid : (LinearMap.id : W →ₗ[K] W) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne (0 : W)
      have hw' := LinearMap.congr_fun h w
      exact hw (by simpa using hw')
    exact hid hzero.2.1
  · have hid : (LinearMap.id : Z →ₗ[K] Z) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : Z)
      have hz' := LinearMap.congr_fun h z
      exact hz (by simpa using hz')
    exact hid hone.2.2.symm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaExtReflection.nonempty_middle_iso_of_unit_twoSource_shortExact
statement:
theorem nonempty_middle_iso_of_unit_twoSource_shortExact
    (K R₀ : Type x) [Field K] [Ring R₀] [Algebra K R₀]
    (X X' Y M N : ModuleCat.{x} R₀)
    (hX : 𝟙 X ≠ 0) (hX' : 𝟙 X' ≠ 0) (hY : 𝟙 Y ≠ 0)
    (fM : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ Y) ⟶ M)
    (gM : M ⟶ ((⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) ⊞
      (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X')))
    (hfgM : fM ≫ gM = 0)
    (hMseq : (ShortComplex.mk fM gM hfgM).ShortExact)
    (fN : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ Y) ⟶ N)
    (gN : N ⟶ ((⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) ⊞
      (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X')))
    (hfgN : fN ≫ gN = 0)
    (hNseq : (ShortComplex.mk fN gN hfgN).ShortExact)
    [IsNoetherian R₀ M] [IsArtinian R₀ M]
    [IsNoetherian R₀ N] [IsArtinian R₀ N]
    (hM : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule R₀ M)
    (hN : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.IsIndecomposableModule R₀ N)
    (ell : Ext X Y 1 →ₗ[K] K) (hell : Function.Injective ell)
    (ell' : Ext X' Y 1 →ₗ[K] K) (hell' : Function.Injective ell') :
    Nonempty (M ≅ N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let SM := ShortComplex.mk fM gM hfgM
  let SN := ShortComplex.mk fN gN hfgN
  have hforkM :
      IsTwoSourceIdempotentIndecomposable
        (scalarizedExtLinearMap X Y ell
          (extBiprodLeft hMseq.extClass))
        (scalarizedExtLinearMap X' Y ell'
          (extBiprodRight hMseq.extClass)) :=
    shortExact_twoSource_scalarizedExtLinearMaps_isIdempotentIndecomposable
      X X' Y M hX hX' hY fM gM hfgM hMseq hM
      ell hell ell' hell'
  have hforkN :
      IsTwoSourceIdempotentIndecomposable
        (scalarizedExtLinearMap X Y ell
          (extBiprodLeft hNseq.extClass))
        (scalarizedExtLinearMap X' Y ell'
          (extBiprodRight hNseq.extClass)) :=
    shortExact_twoSource_scalarizedExtLinearMaps_isIdempotentIndecomposable
      X X' Y N hX hX' hY fN gN hfgN hNseq hN
      ell hell ell' hell'
  let AM : Matrix Unit Unit K :=
    scalarizedExtMatrix X Y ell (extBiprodLeft hMseq.extClass)
  let BM : Matrix Unit Unit K :=
    scalarizedExtMatrix X' Y ell' (extBiprodRight hMseq.extClass)
  let AN : Matrix Unit Unit K :=
    scalarizedExtMatrix X Y ell (extBiprodLeft hNseq.extClass)
  let BN : Matrix Unit Unit K :=
    scalarizedExtMatrix X' Y ell' (extBiprodRight hNseq.extClass)
  have hAM : AM () () ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply unitFork_left_ne_zero hforkM
    have hmatrix : AM = 0 := by
      ext l i
      rcases l with ⟨⟩
      rcases i with ⟨⟩
      simpa using hzero
    simp [scalarizedExtLinearMap, AM, hmatrix]
  have hBM : BM () () ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply unitFork_right_ne_zero hforkM
    have hmatrix : BM = 0 := by
      ext l i
      rcases l with ⟨⟩
      rcases i with ⟨⟩
      simpa using hzero
    simp [scalarizedExtLinearMap, BM, hmatrix]
  have hAN : AN () () ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply unitFork_left_ne_zero hforkN
    have hmatrix : AN = 0 := by
      ext l i
      rcases l with ⟨⟩
      rcases i with ⟨⟩
      simpa using hzero
    simp [scalarizedExtLinearMap, AN, hmatrix]
  have hBN : BN () () ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply unitFork_right_ne_zero hforkN
    have hmatrix : BN = 0 := by
      ext l i
      rcases l with ⟨⟩
      rcases i with ⟨⟩
      simpa using hzero
    simp [scalarizedExtLinearMap, BN, hmatrix]
  let P : Matrix Unit Unit K := fun _ _ ↦ AM () () / AN () ()
  let Q : Matrix Unit Unit K := fun _ _ ↦ BM () () / BN () ()
  let Pinv : Matrix Unit Unit K := fun _ _ ↦ AN () () / AM () ()
  let Qinv : Matrix Unit Unit K := fun _ _ ↦ BN () () / BM () ()
  have hANP : AN * P = AM := by
    funext l i
    rcases l with ⟨⟩
    rcases i with ⟨⟩
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, P] using
      (mul_div_cancel₀ (AM () ()) hAN)
  have hBNQ : BN * Q = BM := by
    funext l i
    rcases l with ⟨⟩
    rcases i with ⟨⟩
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Q] using
      (mul_div_cancel₀ (BM () ()) hBN)
  have hPinvP : Pinv * P = 1 := by
    ext l i
    rcases l with ⟨⟩
    rcases i with ⟨⟩
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Pinv, P, hAM, hAN]
  have hPPinv : P * Pinv = 1 := by
    ext l i
    rcases l with ⟨⟩
    rcases i with ⟨⟩
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Pinv, P, hAM, hAN]
  have hQinvQ : Qinv * Q = 1 := by
    ext l i
    rcases l with ⟨⟩
    rcases i with ⟨⟩
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Qinv, Q, hBM, hBN]
  have hQQinv : Q * Qinv = 1 := by
    ext l i
    rcases l with ⟨⟩
    rcases i with ⟨⟩
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Qinv, Q, hBM, hBN]
  let pEnd : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) :=
    scalarBiproductEnd X P
  let pInv : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) :=
    scalarBiproductEnd X Pinv
  let qEnd : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X') ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X') :=
    scalarBiproductEnd X' Q
  let qInv : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X') ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X') :=
    scalarBiproductEnd X' Qinv
  let pIso : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) ≅ (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X) := {
    hom := pEnd
    inv := pInv
    hom_inv_id := by
      dsimp only [pEnd, pInv]
      rw [scalarBiproductEnd_comp, hPinvP,
        scalarBiproductEnd_one]
    inv_hom_id := by
      dsimp only [pEnd, pInv]
      rw [scalarBiproductEnd_comp, hPPinv,
        scalarBiproductEnd_one] }
  let qIso : (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X') ≅ (⨁ fun _ : Unit ↦ X') := {
    hom := qEnd
    inv := qInv
    hom_inv_id := by
      dsimp only [qEnd, qInv]
      rw [scalarBiproductEnd_comp, hQinvQ,
        scalarBiproductEnd_one]
    inv_hom_id := by
      dsimp only [qEnd, qInv]
      rw [scalarBiproductEnd_comp, hQQinv,
        scalarBiproductEnd_one] }
  let topIso := biprod.mapIso pIso qIso
  have htopHom :
      topIso.hom =
        blockDiagonalBiprodEnd
          (scalarBiproductEnd X P)
          (scalarBiproductEnd X' Q) := by
    rfl
  have hext :
      hMseq.extClass =
        (Ext.mk₀ topIso.hom).comp hNseq.extClass (zero_add 1) := by
    apply ext_eq_of_two_scalarizedExtMatrices_eq
      X X' Y ell hell ell' hell'
    · rw [htopHom,
        scalarizedExtMatrix_extBiprodLeft_pre_blockDiagonal]
      exact hANP.symm
    · rw [htopHom,
        scalarizedExtMatrix_extBiprodRight_pre_blockDiagonal]
      exact hBNQ.symm
  have hcompat :
      hMseq.extClass.comp (Ext.mk₀ (𝟙 _)) (add_zero 1) =
        (Ext.mk₀ topIso.hom).comp hNseq.extClass (zero_add 1) := by
    simpa using hext
  obtain ⟨a₂, ha₁₂, ha₂₃⟩ :=
    exists_middle_morphism_of_extClass_compatibility
      hMseq hNseq (𝟙 _) topIso.hom hcompat
  let phi : SM ⟶ SN := {
    τ₁ := 𝟙 _
    τ₂ := a₂
    τ₃ := topIso.hom
    comm₁₂ := ha₁₂
    comm₂₃ := ha₂₃ }
  haveI : IsIso phi.τ₁ := by
    dsimp [phi]
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso phi.τ₃ := by
    dsimp [phi]
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso phi.τ₂ :=
    ShortComplex.isIso₂_of_shortExact_of_isIso₁₃
      phi hMseq hNseq
  exact ⟨asIso a₂⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaTwoSourceReduction.nonempty_iso_apex_of_nonsimple_inFac_actualTwoTopApex
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_apex_of_nonsimple_inFac_actualTwoTopApex
    (K A : Type x)
    [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [Ring A] [Algebra K A] [FiniteDimensional K A] :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
proof:
:=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K A
    ∀ {iota : Type x} [Finite iota]
      (sigma :
        _root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.{x, x, x}
          Aᵐᵒᵖ iota)
      (apex : sigma.TwoTopQuotientShapeIndex)
      (_D : sigma.ActualTwoTopApexData apex)
      {j : iota},
      sigma.InFac (sigma.twoTopQuotientShapeSupport apex)
          (sigma.obj j) →
        (¬ IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j)) →
          Nonempty (sigma.obj apex.1 ≅ sigma.obj j) := by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K A
  intro iota _ sigma apex D j hj hjNonsimple
  letI : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj D.left.index) :=
    (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
      (sigma.obj D.left.index)).mp D.left.simple
  letI : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj D.right.index) :=
    (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
      (sigma.obj D.right.index)).mp D.right.simple
  letI : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj D.radical.1) :=
    (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
      (sigma.obj D.radical.1)).mp D.radical.2
  letI : Simple (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj :=
    (simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj).mpr
      inferInstance
  letI : Simple (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj :=
    (simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj).mpr
      inferInstance
  letI : Simple (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj :=
    (simple_iff_isSimpleModule' (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj).mpr
      inferInstance
  let LA := D.toLoewyData sigma
  let LJ := Classical.choice
    (exists_actualTwoTopLoewyData_of_nonsimple_inFac
      K A sigma apex D hj hjNonsimple)
  let SA := LA.normalizedRadicalSequence sigma
  let SJ := LJ.normalizedRadicalSequence sigma
  have hSA : SA.ShortExact :=
    LA.normalizedRadicalSequence_shortExact sigma
  have hSJ : SJ.ShortExact :=
    LJ.normalizedRadicalSequence_shortExact sigma
  have hnoParallel : NoParallelExtOne sigma K :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.NoParallelExtOne.noParallelExtOne_of_finiteDimensional_of_finiteSkeleton
      K A sigma
  have hExtLeft := hnoParallel D.left.simple D.radical.2
  have hExtRight := hnoParallel D.right.simple D.radical.2
  letI : FiniteDimensional K
      (Ext (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj
        (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj 1) :=
    hExtLeft.1
  letI : FiniteDimensional K
      (Ext (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj
        (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj 1) :=
    hExtRight.1
  obtain ⟨ell, hell⟩ :=
    YonedaExtReflection.exists_injective_linearMap_to_field_of_finrank_le_one
      hExtLeft.2
  obtain ⟨ell', hell'⟩ :=
    YonedaExtReflection.exists_injective_linearMap_to_field_of_finrank_le_one
      hExtRight.2
  letI : IsNoetherian Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj apex.1) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (sigma.finiteLength apex.1)).1
  letI : IsArtinian Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj apex.1) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (sigma.finiteLength apex.1)).2
  letI : IsNoetherian Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (sigma.finiteLength j)).1
  letI : IsArtinian Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (sigma.finiteLength j)).2
  have hleftNonzero : 𝟙 (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj ≠ 0 :=
    CategoryTheory.id_nonzero _
  have hrightNonzero : 𝟙 (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj ≠ 0 :=
    CategoryTheory.id_nonzero _
  have hradicalNonzero : 𝟙 (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj ≠ 0 :=
    CategoryTheory.id_nonzero _
  obtain ⟨e⟩ :=
    YonedaExtReflection.nonempty_middle_iso_of_unit_twoSource_shortExact
      K Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (sigma.obj D.left.index).obj
      (sigma.obj D.right.index).obj
      (sigma.obj D.radical.1).obj
      (sigma.obj apex.1).obj (sigma.obj j).obj
      hleftNonzero hrightNonzero hradicalNonzero
      SA.f SA.g SA.zero hSA
      SJ.f SJ.g SJ.zero hSJ
      (sigma.indecomposable apex.1) (sigma.indecomposable j)
      ell hell ell' hell'
  exact ⟨e.toLinearEquiv.toFGModuleCatIso⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.YonedaTwoSourceReduction.qClosure_isClosed_twoTopQuotientShapeSupport_actual
statement:
theorem qClosure_isClosed_twoTopQuotientShapeSupport_actual
    (K A : Type x)
    [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [Ring A] [Algebra K A] [FiniteDimensional K A] :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
proof:
:=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K A
    ∀ {iota : Type x} [Finite iota]
      (sigma :
        _root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.{x, x, x}
          Aᵐᵒᵖ iota)
      (apex : sigma.TwoTopQuotientShapeIndex)
      (_D : sigma.ActualTwoTopApexData apex),
      sigma.qClosure.IsClosed
        (sigma.twoTopQuotientShapeSupport apex) := by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ :=
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.isNoetherianRing_op_of_finiteDimensional K A
  intro iota _ sigma apex D
  rw [sigma.qClosure.isClosed_iff]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro j hj
    by_cases hjSimple : IsSimpleModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (sigma.obj j)
    · have hjSimpleCat : Simple (sigma.obj j) :=
        (_root_.QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.simple_iff_isSimpleModule_fg
          (sigma.obj j)).mpr hjSimple
      let Q : sigma.SimpleQuotient j := {
        index := j
        simple := hjSimpleCat
        map := 𝟙 _
        epi := inferInstance }
      have htype :
          j = D.left.index ∨ j = D.right.index :=
        sigma.simpleQuotient_index_eq_left_or_right_of_inFac_twoTopSupport
          D hj Q
      rw [IndecomposableSkeleton.twoTopQuotientShapeSupport]
      right
      rcases htype with hleft | hright
      · exact ⟨D.left, hleft.symm⟩
      · exact ⟨D.right, hright.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ :=
        nonempty_iso_apex_of_nonsimple_inFac_actualTwoTopApex
          K A sigma apex D hj hjSimple
      have heq : apex.1 = j := sigma.eq_of_iso ⟨e⟩
      subst j
      simp [IndecomposableSkeleton.twoTopQuotientShapeSupport]
  · exact sigma.subset_qSet _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.secondOnlyCommonSourceEquiv_sameSuccessorOrbit_iff
statement:
theorem secondOnlyCommonSourceEquiv_sameSuccessorOrbit_iff
    (source_noninjective : ∀ a : sigma.IrreduciblePair,
      Projective (sigma.obj a.1.2) → ¬ Injective (sigma.obj a.1.1))
    (p : AR.SecondOnlySourceCommonSourcePair sigma) :
    let O
proof:
:= (AR.arMeshRotationData sigma).arrowOrbitData sigma
    let E := AR.secondOnlyCommonSourceEquivProjectiveTargetCommonTarget
      sigma source_noninjective
    O.SameSuccessorOrbit (E p).1.1.1 (E p).1.1.2 ↔
      O.SameSuccessorOrbit p.1.1.1.1 p.1.1.1.2 := by
  let O := (AR.arMeshRotationData sigma).arrowOrbitData sigma
  let E := AR.secondOnlyCommonSourceEquivProjectiveTargetCommonTarget
    sigma source_noninjective
  let A₀ := p.1.1.1.1
  let B₀ := p.1.1.1.2
  have hA : ¬ Projective (sigma.obj A₀.1.2) :=
    fun h ↦ p.2 (Or.inl h)
  have hB : ¬ Projective (sigma.obj B₀.1.2) :=
    fun h ↦ p.2 (Or.inr h)
  let A := (O.tau ⟨A₀, hA⟩).1
  let B := (O.tau ⟨B₀, hB⟩).1
  have hAstep : O.successor A = A₀ := by
    have hnotTarget : ¬ (fun a : sigma.IrreduciblePair ↦
        Injective (sigma.obj a.1.1)) A := by
      exact (O.tau ⟨A₀, hA⟩).2
    rw [show O.successor A = (O.tau.symm ⟨A, hnotTarget⟩).1 by
      simp [QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BoundaryTranslationChains.Data.successor,
        hnotTarget]]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (O.tau.symm_apply_apply ⟨A₀, hA⟩)
  have hBstep : O.successor B = B₀ := by
    have hnotTarget : ¬ (fun a : sigma.IrreduciblePair ↦
        Injective (sigma.obj a.1.1)) B := by
      exact (O.tau ⟨B₀, hB⟩).2
    rw [show O.successor B = (O.tau.symm ⟨B, hnotTarget⟩).1 by
      simp [QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BoundaryTranslationChains.Data.successor,
        hnotTarget]]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (O.tau.symm_apply_apply ⟨B₀, hB⟩)
  have hAorbit : O.SameSuccessorOrbit A A₀ := by
    exact ⟨1, 0, by simpa only [Function.iterate_one,
      Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] using hAstep⟩
  have hBorbit : O.SameSuccessorOrbit B B₀ := by
    exact ⟨1, 0, by simpa only [Function.iterate_one,
      Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] using hBstep⟩
  change O.SameSuccessorOrbit A B ↔
    O.SameSuccessorOrbit A₀ B₀
  exact O.sameSuccessorOrbit_congr_of_related hAorbit hBorbit

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.qClosed_iff_all_deleted_have_traceHole
statement:
theorem qClosed_iff_all_deleted_have_traceHole (K : Set ι) :
    σ.qClosure.IsClosed K ↔
      ∀ x : DeletedLabel K, HasTraceHole σ K x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hclosed x htop
    have hclosure : σ.qClosure K = K :=
      σ.qClosure.isClosed_iff.mp hclosed
    have hxcl : x.1 ∈ σ.qClosure K :=
      (mem_qClosure_iff_trace_eq_top σ K x.1).2 htop
    rw [hclosure] at hxcl
    exact x.2 hxcl
  · intro hholes
    apply σ.qClosure.isClosed_iff.2
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro i hi
      by_contra hiK
      exact hholes ⟨i, hiK⟩
        ((mem_qClosure_iff_trace_eq_top σ K i).1 hi)
    · exact σ.qClosure.le_closure K

    rw [hclosure] at hxcl

  · intro hholes

    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro i hi

    (K : Set ι)

    (P : Set (DeletedLabel K))
    (H : HoleFactorHomInput σ K P)
    (I : FactorLadder.IyamaRadicalLayerInput A H.factorHomNonzero) :

      ∀ x : DeletedLabel K,
        A.ReachesBoundary P x
proof:
:= by
  rw [qClosed_iff_all_deleted_have_traceHole σ K]
  constructor
  · intro hholes x
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hhom⟩ :=
      (H.hole_iff_projective_factorHom x).1 (hholes x)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      (I.factorHom_iff_ladder_occurs p x).1 hhom
    exact ⟨n, p, hp, hn⟩
  · intro hreach x
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp, hn⟩ := hreach x
    apply (H.hole_iff_projective_factorHom x).2
    exact
      ⟨p, hp, (I.factorHom_iff_ladder_occurs p x).2 ⟨n, hn⟩⟩

statement:
lemma isIso_one_sub_comp
    {X Y : C} (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsIso (𝟙 X - a ≫ b)] :
    IsIso (𝟙 Y - b ≫ a)
proof:
:=
  CategoricalRadical.isIso_one_sub_comp a b

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.isRadicalMorphism_precomp
statement:
lemma isRadicalMorphism_precomp
    {W X Y : C} (a : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism f) :
    CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism (a ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  haveI :
      IsIso (𝟙 X - (f ≫ g) ≫ a) := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hf (g ≫ a)
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using
    (isIso_one_sub_comp (f ≫ g) a)

statement:
lemma isRadicalMorphism_postcomp
    {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism f) :

proof:
:= by
  intro g

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.isRadicalMorphism_comp
statement:
lemma isRadicalMorphism_comp
    {W X Y Z : C} (a : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism f) :
    CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism (a ≫ f ≫ b)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using
    isRadicalMorphism_postcomp (a ≫ f) b
      (isRadicalMorphism_precomp a f hf)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.radicalMorphism_eq_zero_between_biproducts_of_generatorEnd
statement:
theorem radicalMorphism_eq_zero_between_biproducts_of_generatorEnd
    {P : C}
    (hP : ∀ a : End P,
      CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism a → a = 0)
    {J K : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    (f :
      (⨁ fun _ : J ↦ P) ⟶
        ⨁ fun _ : K ↦ P)
    (hf : CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism f) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc :
      ∀ j k, biproduct.components f j k = 0 := by
    intro j k
    exact hP _ <|
      isRadicalMorphism_comp
        (biproduct.ι (fun _ : J ↦ P) j)
        f
        (biproduct.π (fun _ : K ↦ P) k)
        hf
  rw [← biproduct.components_matrix f]
  simp only [hc]
  ext
  simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.hasZeroRadical_of_isFiniteRetractGeneratedBy
statement:
theorem hasZeroRadical_of_isFiniteRetractGeneratedBy
    {P : C}
    (hP : ∀ a : End P,
      CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism a → a = 0)
    (hgen : IsFiniteRetractGeneratedBy P) :
    CategoricalRadical.HasZeroRadical C
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y f hf
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨rX⟩⟩ := hgen X
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨rY⟩⟩ := hgen Y
  let f' :
      (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ P) ⟶
        ⨁ fun _ : Fin m ↦ P :=
    rX.r ≫ f ≫ rY.i
  have hf' :
      CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism f' :=
    isRadicalMorphism_comp rX.r f rY.i hf
  have hfzero : f' = 0 :=
    radicalMorphism_eq_zero_between_biproducts_of_generatorEnd
      hP f' hf'
  calc
    f = rX.i ≫ f' ≫ rY.r := by
      simp [f', Category.assoc]
    _ = 0 := by simp [hfzero]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.isUnit_one_add_mul_of_corner_isUnit
statement:
theorem isUnit_one_add_mul_of_corner_isUnit
    {p x : R} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p)
    (_hpx : p * x = x) (hxp : x * p = x)
    (y : R)
    (hu :
      IsUnit
        (show hp.Corner from
          ⟨p + p * y * x, by
            apply (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff hp).mpr
            constructor
            · simp only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hp.eq]
            · simp only [add_mul, hp.eq]
              rw [mul_assoc (p * y) x p, hxp]⟩)) :
    IsUnit (1 + y * x)
proof:
:= by
  let u : hp.Corner :=
    ⟨p + p * y * x, by
      apply (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff hp).mpr
      constructor
      · simp only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hp.eq]
      · simp only [add_mul, hp.eq]
        rw [mul_assoc (p * y) x p, hxp]⟩
  obtain ⟨v, huv, hvu⟩ :=
    isUnit_iff_exists.mp (show IsUnit u from hu)
  have huv' :
      (p + p * y * x) * v.1 = p :=
    congrArg Subtype.val huv
  have hvu' :
      v.1 * (p + p * y * x) = p :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hvu
  have hpv : p * v.1 = v.1 :=
    (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff hp).mp v.property |>.1
  have hvp : v.1 * p = v.1 :=
    (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff hp).mp v.property |>.2
  have huv'' :
      v.1 + p * y * x * v.1 = p := by
    simpa only [add_mul, hpv, mul_assoc] using huv'
  have hvu'' :
      v.1 + v.1 * y * x = p := by
    simpa only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hvp] using hvu'
  let q : R := 1 - p
  let t : R := q * y * x
  let u₀ : R := p + p * y * x
  let v₀ : R := v.1
  have hq_sq : q * q = q := by
    dsimp only [q]
    noncomm_ring [hp.eq]
  have hpq : p * q = 0 := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hp.eq, sub_self]
  have hqp : q * p = 0 := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hp.eq, sub_self]
  have hxq : x * q = 0 := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hxp, sub_self]
  have hqv : q * v₀ = 0 := by
    dsimp only [q, v₀]
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hpv, sub_self]
  have hvq : v₀ * q = 0 := by
    dsimp only [q, v₀]
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hvp, sub_self]
  have huq : u₀ * q = 0 := by
    dsimp only [u₀]
    simp only [add_mul, hpq, mul_assoc, hxq,
      mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hqu : q * u₀ = 0 := by
    dsimp only [u₀]
    simp only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hqp,
      zero_mul, zero_add]
  have hqt : q * t = t := by
    dsimp only [t]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, hq_sq]
  have htp : t * p = t := by
    dsimp only [t]
    rw [mul_assoc, hxp]
  have htq : t * q = 0 := by
    dsimp only [t]
    simp only [mul_assoc, hxq, mul_zero]
  have hut : u₀ * t = 0 := by
    dsimp only [t]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, huq, zero_mul]
  have hvt : v₀ * t = 0 := by
    dsimp only [t]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, hvq, zero_mul]
  have htt : t * t = 0 := by
    dsimp only [t]
    calc
      q * y * x * (q * y * x) =
          q * y * (x * q) * y * x := by
            noncomm_ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hxq]; simp
  have htvt : t * v₀ * t = 0 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hvt, mul_zero]
  have hvu₀ : v₀ * u₀ = p := by
    exact hvu'
  have htvu : t * v₀ * u₀ = t := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hvu₀, htp]
  have huv₀ : u₀ * v₀ = p := by
    exact huv'
  have hutv : u₀ * (t * v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hut, zero_mul]
  have httv : t * (t * v₀) = 0 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, htt, zero_mul]
  have hqtv : q * (t * v₀) = t * v₀ := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hqt]
  have htvt' : (t * v₀) * t = 0 := by
    exact htvt
  have htvq : (t * v₀) * q = 0 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hvq, mul_zero]
  have hpqsum : p + q = 1 := by
    dsimp only [q]
    abel
  have hdecomp :
      1 + y * x = u₀ + t + q := by
    dsimp only [u₀, t, q]
    noncomm_ring
  refine isUnit_iff_exists.mpr
    ⟨v₀ + q - t * v₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hdecomp]
    noncomm_ring [huv₀, huq, hut, htq, htt,
      hqv, hq_sq, hqt, hutv, httv, hqtv,
      hpqsum]
  · rw [hdecomp]
    noncomm_ring [hvu₀, hvt, hvq, hqu, hqt,
      hq_sq, htvu, htvt', htvq, hpqsum]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.principalCornerEnd_sub
statement:
theorem principalCornerEnd_sub
    {e : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (c d : he.Corner) :
    principalCornerEnd he (c - d) =
      principalCornerEnd he c -
        principalCornerEnd he d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, principalCornerEnd_add,
    principalCornerEnd_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.map_principalCornerEnd_eq_iff_quotient_eq
statement:
theorem map_principalCornerEnd_eq_iff_quotient_eq
    {e f : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (c d : he.Corner) :
    let P
proof:
:= principalSubcategory he
    let Q := principalSubcategory hf
    let I :=
      CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
        P Q
    let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
    let q :=
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
    F.map (principalCornerEnd he c) =
          F.map (principalCornerEnd he d) ↔
      q c.1 = q d.1 := by
  dsimp only
  let P := principalSubcategory he
  let Q := principalSubcategory hf
  let I :=
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
      P Q
  let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
  let q :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hrel :
        I.rel (principalCornerEnd he c)
          (principalCornerEnd he d) :=
      (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_map_eq_iff
        I.rel _ _).mp h
    have hfac :
        CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.FactorsThrough
          P Q (principalCornerEnd he (c - d)) := by
      change
        principalCornerEnd he (c - d) ∈
          I.hom (principalObject he) (principalObject he)
      rw [principalCornerEnd_sub]
      exact hrel
    have hmem :
        (c - d).1 ∈
          Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f :=
      corner_mem_twoSidedIdeal_of_factorsThrough
        he hf (c - d) hfac
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← map_sub]
    exact
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem
  · intro h
    have hmem :
        (c - d).1 ∈
          Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f := by
      change
        (c - d).1 ∈
          (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
      change q ((c - d).1) = 0
      have hval : (c - d).1 = c.1 - d.1 := rfl
      rw [hval, map_sub, h, sub_self]
    have hfac :=
      factorsThrough_of_corner_mem_twoSidedIdeal
        he hf (c - d) hmem
    apply
      (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_map_eq_iff
        I.rel _ _).mpr
    change
      principalCornerEnd he c -
          principalCornerEnd he d ∈
        I.hom (principalObject he) (principalObject he)
    rw [← principalCornerEnd_sub]
    change
      CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.FactorsThrough
        P Q (principalCornerEnd he (c - d))
    simpa only [P, Q] using hfac

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.quotient_corner_has_inverse_of_map_isIso
statement:
theorem quotient_corner_has_inverse_of_map_isIso
    {e f : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (z : he.Corner) :
    let P
proof:
:= principalSubcategory he
    let Q := principalSubcategory hf
    let I :=
      CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
        P Q
    letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
      I.quotientPreadditive
    letI : (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).Additive :=
      CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_additive I.rel
        (fun {_ _} f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg ↦
          I.add_compatible f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg)
    let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
    let q :=
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
    IsIso (F.map (principalCornerEnd he z)) →
      ∃ w : he.Corner,
        q (z * w).1 = q e ∧
          q (w * z).1 = q e := by
  dsimp only
  let P := principalSubcategory he
  let Q := principalSubcategory hf
  let I :=
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
      P Q
  letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
    I.quotientPreadditive
  letI : (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).Additive :=
    CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_additive I.rel
      (fun {_ _} f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg ↦
        I.add_compatible f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg)
  let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
  let q :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
  intro hzIso
  letI : IsIso (F.map (principalCornerEnd he z)) :=
    hzIso
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ :=
    F.map_surjective
      (inv (F.map (principalCornerEnd he z)))
  let w : he.Corner := cornerOfPrincipalEnd he g₀
  have hw :
      principalCornerEnd he w = g₀ :=
    principalCornerEnd_cornerOfPrincipalEnd he g₀
  have hzwComp :
      principalCornerEnd he (z * w) =
        principalCornerEnd he w ≫
          principalCornerEnd he z := by
    simpa only [End.mul_def] using
      principalCornerEnd_mul he z w
  have hwzComp :
      principalCornerEnd he (w * z) =
        principalCornerEnd he z ≫
          principalCornerEnd he w := by
    simpa only [End.mul_def] using
      principalCornerEnd_mul he w z
  have hzwMap :
      F.map (principalCornerEnd he (z * w)) =
        F.map (principalCornerEnd he (1 : he.Corner)) := by
    rw [hzwComp, F.map_comp, hw, hg₀,
      IsIso.inv_hom_id]
    have honeEnd :
        principalCornerEnd he (1 : he.Corner) =
          (𝟙 (principalObject he) :
            principalObject he ⟶ principalObject he) :=
      principalCornerEnd_one he
    rw [honeEnd]
    exact (F.map_id (principalObject he)).symm
  have hwzMap :
      F.map (principalCornerEnd he (w * z)) =
        F.map (principalCornerEnd he (1 : he.Corner)) := by
    rw [hwzComp, F.map_comp, hw, hg₀,
      IsIso.hom_inv_id]
    have honeEnd :
        principalCornerEnd he (1 : he.Corner) =
          (𝟙 (principalObject he) :
            principalObject he ⟶ principalObject he) :=
      principalCornerEnd_one he
    rw [honeEnd]
    exact (F.map_id (principalObject he)).symm
  refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h :=
      (map_principalCornerEnd_eq_iff_quotient_eq
        he hf (z * w) (1 : he.Corner)).mp hzwMap
    have hone : ((1 : he.Corner).1) = e := rfl
    simpa only [hone] using h
  · have h :=
      (map_principalCornerEnd_eq_iff_quotient_eq
        he hf (w * z) (1 : he.Corner)).mp hwzMap
    have hone : ((1 : he.Corner).1) = e := rfl
    simpa only [hone] using h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.quotient_corner_jacobson_eq_zero_of_radicalSandwichZero
statement:
theorem quotient_corner_jacobson_eq_zero_of_radicalSandwichZero
    {e f : A}
    (hzero :
      Tsukamoto.RadicalSandwichZero
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal e)
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f))
    (a :
      A ⧸
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal)
    (ha :
      a ∈ Ring.jacobson
        (A ⧸
          (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal)) :
    let q
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
    q e * a * q e = 0 := by
  let L := Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f
  let q := Ideal.Quotient.mk L.asIdeal
  let Hbar :=
    Tsukamoto.quotientImage
      (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal e) L
  have himage :
      Hbar =
        Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal (q e) := by
    exact map_principalTwoSidedIdeal q e
  have hqe :
      q e ∈ Hbar.asIdeal := by
    rw [himage]
    exact
      TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span
        (Set.mem_singleton (q e))
  have hmem :
      q e * a * q e ∈
        Hbar.asIdeal *
          Ring.jacobson
            (A ⧸ L.asIdeal) *
          Hbar.asIdeal :=
    Ideal.mul_mem_mul
      (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hqe ha) hqe
  change
    Hbar.asIdeal *
          Ring.jacobson
            (A ⧸ L.asIdeal) *
          Hbar.asIdeal =
        ⊥ at hzero
  rw [hzero] at hmem
  exact Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.quotientGenerator_radical_eq_zero_of_radicalSandwichZero
statement:
theorem quotientGenerator_radical_eq_zero_of_radicalSandwichZero
    {e f : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (hzero :
      Tsukamoto.RadicalSandwichZero
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal e)
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f)) :
    let P
proof:
:= principalSubcategory he
    let Q := principalSubcategory hf
    let I :=
      CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
        P Q
    letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
      I.quotientPreadditive
    letI : (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).Additive :=
      CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_additive I.rel
        (fun {_ _} f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg ↦
          I.add_compatible f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg)
    let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
    ∀ g : End (F.obj (principalObject he)),
      CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism g →
        g = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  let P := principalSubcategory he
  let Q := principalSubcategory hf
  let I :=
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
      P Q
  letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
    I.quotientPreadditive
  letI : (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).Additive :=
    CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_additive I.rel
      (fun {_ _} f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg ↦
        I.add_compatible f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg)
  let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
  let q :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal
  let p := q e
  let hp : IsIdempotentElem p := he.map q
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := F.map_surjective g
  let c : he.Corner := cornerOfPrincipalEnd he g₀
  have hcEnd :
      principalCornerEnd he c = g₀ :=
    principalCornerEnd_cornerOfPrincipalEnd he g₀
  have hgc :
      F.map (principalCornerEnd he c) = g := by
    rw [hcEnd, hg₀]
  let x :
      A ⧸
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal :=
    q c.1
  have hpx : p * x = x := by
    have hcLeft :
        e * c.1 = c.1 :=
      (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff he).mp c.property |>.1
    dsimp only [p, x]
    rw [← map_mul, hcLeft]
  have hxp : x * p = x := by
    have hcRight :
        c.1 * e = c.1 :=
      (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff he).mp c.property |>.2
    dsimp only [p, x]
    rw [← map_mul, hcRight]
  have hxJ :
      x ∈ Ring.jacobson
        (A ⧸
          (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal) := by
    rw [← Ideal.jacobson_bot]
    apply Ideal.mem_jacobson_iff.mpr
    intro y
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    let d : he.Corner :=
      -sandwichedCorner he r
    let z : he.Corner := 1 - d * c
    have hdcComp :
        principalCornerEnd he (d * c) =
          principalCornerEnd he c ≫
            principalCornerEnd he d := by
      simpa only [End.mul_def] using
        principalCornerEnd_mul he d c
    have honeEnd :
        principalCornerEnd he (1 : he.Corner) =
          (𝟙 (principalObject he) :
            principalObject he ⟶ principalObject he) :=
      principalCornerEnd_one he
    have hzEnd :
        principalCornerEnd he z =
          (𝟙 (principalObject he) :
              principalObject he ⟶ principalObject he) -
            principalCornerEnd he c ≫
              principalCornerEnd he d := by
      dsimp only [z]
      rw [principalCornerEnd_sub,
        honeEnd, hdcComp]
      rfl
    have hzMap :
        F.map (principalCornerEnd he z) =
          𝟙 (F.obj (principalObject he)) -
            g ≫ F.map (principalCornerEnd he d) := by
      rw [hzEnd, F.map_sub, F.map_comp, hgc]
      rw [F.map_id]
    have hzIso :
        IsIso (F.map (principalCornerEnd he z)) := by
      rw [hzMap]
      exact hg (F.map (principalCornerEnd he d))
    obtain ⟨w, hzw, hwz⟩ :=
      quotient_corner_has_inverse_of_map_isIso
        he hf z hzIso
    let zbar : hp.Corner := cornerMap q he z
    let wbar : hp.Corner := cornerMap q he w
    have hzbarUnit : IsUnit zbar := by
      apply isUnit_iff_exists.mpr
      refine ⟨wbar, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply Subtype.ext
        change q (z * w).1 = q e
        exact hzw
      · apply Subtype.ext
        change q (w * z).1 = q e
        exact hwz
    have hzbar :
        zbar =
          (show hp.Corner from
            ⟨p + p * y * x, by
              apply
                (Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff hp).mpr
              constructor
              · calc
                  p * (p + p * y * x) =
                      p * p + (p * p) * y * x := by
                        noncomm_ring
                  _ = p + p * y * x := by rw [hp.eq]
              · calc
                  (p + p * y * x) * p =
                      p * p + p * y * (x * p) := by
                        noncomm_ring
                  _ = p + p * y * x := by
                    rw [hp.eq, hxp]⟩) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      dsimp only [zbar, z, d, cornerMap,
        sandwichedCorner, p, x]
      change
        q (e - (-(e * r * e)) * c.1) =
          q e + q e * y * q c.1
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_neg, map_mul,
        map_mul, hr]
      change
        p - -(p * y * p) * x =
          p + p * y * x
      noncomm_ring [hpx]
    rw [hzbar] at hzbarUnit
    have hfullUnit : IsUnit (1 + y * x) :=
      isUnit_one_add_mul_of_corner_isUnit
        hp hpx hxp y hzbarUnit
    obtain ⟨s, hsRight, hsLeft⟩ :=
      isUnit_iff_exists.mp hfullUnit
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    apply Ideal.mem_bot.mpr
    have hs : s * (y * x) + s = 1 := by
      simpa only [mul_add, mul_one, add_comm] using hsLeft
    rw [mul_assoc s y x, hs, sub_self]
  have hcornerZero :
      p * x * p = 0 := by
    exact
      quotient_corner_jacobson_eq_zero_of_radicalSandwichZero
        hzero x hxJ
  have hxZero : x = 0 := by
    calc
      x = p * x * p := by rw [hpx, hxp]
      _ = 0 := hcornerZero
  have hcQuotientZero : q c.1 = q (0 : A) := by
    simpa only [x, map_zero] using hxZero
  have hcMapZero :
      F.map (principalCornerEnd he c) = 0 := by
    have h :=
      (map_principalCornerEnd_eq_iff_quotient_eq
        he hf c (0 : he.Corner)).mpr hcQuotientZero
    have hzeroEnd :
        principalCornerEnd he (0 : he.Corner) =
          (0 :
            principalObject he ⟶ principalObject he) :=
      principalCornerEnd_zero he
    calc
      F.map (principalCornerEnd he c) =
          F.map (principalCornerEnd he (0 : he.Corner)) :=
        h
      _ = F.map
          (0 :
            principalObject he ⟶ principalObject he) := by
        rw [hzeroEnd]
      _ = 0 := F.map_zero _ _
  exact hgc.symm.trans hcMapZero

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.factorIsCosemisimple_of_radicalSandwichZero
statement:
theorem factorIsCosemisimple_of_radicalSandwichZero
    {e f : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (hzero :
      Tsukamoto.RadicalSandwichZero
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal e)
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f)) :
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.FactorIsCosemisimple
      (principalSubcategory he)
      (principalSubcategory hf)
proof:
:= by
  let P := principalSubcategory he
  let Q := principalSubcategory hf
  let I :=
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorThroughIdeal
      P Q
  letI : Preadditive (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
    I.quotientPreadditive
  letI : (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel).Additive :=
    CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_additive I.rel
      (fun {_ _} f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg ↦
        I.add_compatible f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg)
  letI : HasFiniteBiproducts P.FullSubcategory :=
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.fullSubcategoryHasFiniteBiproducts
      P
  letI : HasFiniteBiproducts
      (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel) :=
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.factorQuotientHasFiniteBiproducts
      P Q
  let F := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor I.rel
  change
    CategoricalRadical.HasZeroRadical
      (CategoryTheory.Quotient I.rel)
  apply hasZeroRadical_of_isFiniteRetractGeneratedBy
    (P := F.obj (principalObject he))
  · exact
      quotientGenerator_radical_eq_zero_of_radicalSandwichZero
        he hf hzero
  · intro X
    let X₀ : P.FullSubcategory := X.as
    have hX :
        AuslanderEquivalence.finiteAddClosure
          (principalFiniteProjective he) X₀.obj := by
      exact X₀.property
    obtain ⟨presentation⟩ := hX
    let J := P.carrier.ι
    let eSum :
        J.obj
            (⨁ fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
              principalObject he) ≅
          ⨁ fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
            principalFiniteProjective he :=
      J.mapBiproduct
        (fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
          principalObject he)
    let r :
        Retract X₀
          (⨁ fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
            principalObject he) :=
      { i := ObjectProperty.homMk
          (presentation.retract.i ≫ eSum.inv)
        r := ObjectProperty.homMk
          (eSum.hom ≫ presentation.retract.r)
        retract := by
          apply J.map_injective
          change
            (presentation.retract.i ≫ eSum.inv) ≫
                (eSum.hom ≫ presentation.retract.r) =
              𝟙 X₀.obj
          simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
            presentation.retract.retract] }
    let rMap := r.map F
    let rBiproduct :
        Retract
          (F.obj
            (⨁ fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
              principalObject he))
          (⨁ fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
            F.obj (principalObject he)) :=
      Retract.ofIso
        (F.mapBiproduct
          (fun _ : Fin presentation.n ↦
            principalObject he))
    have hFX : F.obj X₀ = X := by
      apply CategoryTheory.Quotient.ext
      rfl
    let rObject : Retract X (F.obj X₀) :=
      Retract.ofIso (eqToIso hFX.symm)
    exact
      ⟨presentation.n,
        ⟨rObject.trans (rMap.trans rBiproduct)⟩⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TsukamotoRadicalSandwichConverse.factorIsCosemisimple_iff_radicalSandwichZero
statement:
theorem factorIsCosemisimple_iff_radicalSandwichZero
    {e f : A} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    [IsArtinianRing
      (A ⧸
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f).asIdeal)] :
    CategoricalAdditiveSubcategory.Subcategory.FactorIsCosemisimple
        (principalSubcategory he)
        (principalSubcategory hf) ↔
      Tsukamoto.RadicalSandwichZero
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal e)
        (Tsukamoto.principalTwoSidedIdeal f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨radicalSandwichZero_of_factorIsCosemisimple

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.nontrivial_ext_one_of_projective_presentation
statement:
theorem nontrivial_ext_one_of_projective_presentation
    {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) [Projective S.X₂]
    {T : ModuleCat.{u} R}
    (f : S.X₁ ⟶ T) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hvanish : ∀ g : S.X₂ ⟶ T, g = 0) :
    Nontrivial (Ext S.X₃ T 1)
proof:
:= by
  let x : Ext S.X₃ T 1 :=
    hS.extClass.comp (Ext.mk₀ f) (add_zero 1)
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxzero
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
      Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁ hS T (Ext.mk₀ f)
        (add_zero 1) hxzero
    have hzZero : z = 0 := by
      apply (Ext.linearEquiv₀ (R := ℤ)).injective
      simpa using hvanish (Ext.linearEquiv₀ (R := ℤ) z)
    rw [hzZero] at hz
    apply hf
    apply (Ext.mk₀_bijective S.X₁ T).injective
    simpa using hz.symm
  exact ⟨x, 0, hx⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.mul_liftedCoordinate_sub_coordinate_mem_jacobson
statement:
theorem mul_liftedCoordinate_sub_coordinate_mem_jacobson
    (j : I) (b : B) :
    b * D.liftedCoordinate j -
        algebraMap K B (D.coordinateCharacter j b) *
          D.liftedCoordinate j ∈ Ring.jacobson B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  apply D.quotientEquiv.injective
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_zero,
    QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SplitBasicCoordinateSystem.QuotientCoordinateData.quotient_mk_liftedCoordinate]
  simp only [QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SplitBasicCoordinateSystem.QuotientCoordinateData.quotientCoordinate,
    D.quotientEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  ext k
  by_cases hkj : k = j
  · subst k
    simp [coordinateCharacter]
  · simp [hkj]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.exists_cotangent_functional
statement:
theorem exists_cotangent_functional
    {c : B} (hc : c ∉ (Ring.jacobson B) ^ 2) :
    ∃ ℓ : B →ₗ[K] K,
      ℓ c ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ (Ring.jacobson B) ^ 2, ℓ z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Submodule K B :=
    ((Ring.jacobson B) ^ 2 : Submodule B B).restrictScalars K
  have hcQ : c ∉ Q := by
    simpa [Q] using hc
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓc, hmap⟩ :=
    Q.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hcQ inferInstance
  refine ⟨ℓ, hℓc, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzQ : z ∈ Q := by simpa [Q] using hz
  have hmem : ℓ z ∈ Q.map ℓ := ⟨z, hzQ, rfl⟩
  rw [hmap, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.coordinateSimple_isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem coordinateSimple_isSimpleModule (i : I) :
    letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K
proof:
:= D.coordinateSimpleModule i
    IsSimpleModule Bᵐᵒᵖ K := by
  letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K := D.coordinateSimpleModule i
  rw [isSimpleModule_iff_toSpanSingleton_surjective]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y
  let k : K := y * x⁻¹
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := D.coordinateCharacterOp_surjective i k
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  change D.coordinateCharacterOp i b * x = y
  rw [hb]
  simp [k, hx]

    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton Bᵐᵒᵖ K 1)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.vertexTopLinearMap_surjective
statement:
theorem vertexTopLinearMap_surjective (i : I) :
    Function.Surjective (D.vertexTopLinearMap i)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  let e := D.liftedCoordinate i
  let x : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal e :=
    ⟨op (e * algebraMap K B y), by
      rw [show op (e * algebraMap K B y) =
        op (algebraMap K B y) * op e by simp]
      exact (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal e).mul_mem_left _
        (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (op e)))⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  change D.coordinateCharacter i (e * algebraMap K B y) = y
  simp [e]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.unop_mem_jacobson_of_mem_vertexTop_ker
statement:
theorem unop_mem_jacobson_of_mem_vertexTop_ker
    (i : I) (x : D.vertexTopKernel i) :
    unop x.1.1 ∈ Ring.jacobson B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  apply D.quotientEquiv.injective
  ext k
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst k
    have hx := x.property
    change D.coordinateCharacter i (unop x.1.1) = 0 at hx
    simpa [coordinateCharacter] using hx
  · have hfixedOp :
        x.1.1 * op (D.liftedCoordinate i) = x.1.1 :=
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.mul_op_eq_self_of_mem_principalRightIdeal
        (D.liftedCoordinate_complete.idem i) x.1.property
    have hfixed : D.liftedCoordinate i * unop x.1.1 = unop x.1.1 := by
      simpa using congrArg unop hfixedOp
    rw [← hfixed, map_mul,
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SplitBasicCoordinateSystem.QuotientCoordinateData.quotient_mk_liftedCoordinate]
    simp [QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SplitBasicCoordinateSystem.QuotientCoordinateData.quotientCoordinate,
      hki]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.exists_nonzero_kernel_map_of_cross_cotangent
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_kernel_map_of_cross_cotangent
    {i j : I} {r : B}
    (hr : r ∈ Ring.jacobson B)
    (hcorner :
      D.liftedCoordinate i * r * D.liftedCoordinate j ∉
        (Ring.jacobson B) ^ 2) :
    letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K
proof:
:= D.coordinateSimpleModule j
    ∃ f : D.vertexTopKernel i →ₗ[Bᵐᵒᵖ] K, f ≠ 0 := by
  letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K := D.coordinateSimpleModule j
  let eᵢ := D.liftedCoordinate i
  let eⱼ := D.liftedCoordinate j
  let c := eᵢ * r * eⱼ
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓc, hℓzero⟩ :=
    exists_cotangent_functional (K := K) hcorner
  let f : D.vertexTopKernel i →ₗ[Bᵐᵒᵖ] K :=
    D.cotangentKernelLinearMap i j ℓ hℓzero
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  have hcJ : c ∈ Ring.jacobson B := by
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right eⱼ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ eᵢ hr)
  let pₓ : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal eᵢ :=
    ⟨op c, by
      rw [show op c = op (r * eⱼ) * op eᵢ by
        simp [c, eᵢ, eⱼ, mul_assoc]]
      exact (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal eᵢ).mul_mem_left _
        (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (op eᵢ)))⟩
  let kₓ : D.vertexTopKernel i :=
    ⟨pₓ, by
      change D.coordinateCharacter i c = 0
      exact D.coordinateCharacter_eq_zero_of_mem_jacobson i hcJ⟩
  have hcfix : c * eⱼ = c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    calc
      (eᵢ * r * eⱼ) * eⱼ = eᵢ * r * (eⱼ * eⱼ) := by
        simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = eᵢ * r * eⱼ := by
        rw [D.liftedCoordinate_complete.idem j]
  intro hf
  have happly := LinearMap.congr_fun hf kₓ
  change ℓ (c * eⱼ) = 0 at happly
  rw [hcfix] at happly
  exact hℓc happly

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.vertexPresentation_projective_middle
statement:
theorem vertexPresentation_projective_middle (i : I) :
    Projective (D.vertexPresentation i).X₂
proof:
:= by

    (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightModule
      (D.liftedCoordinate i))
  exact
    (IsProjective.iff_projective
      (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.kernelToCoordinateMorphism_ne_zero
statement:
theorem kernelToCoordinateMorphism_ne_zero
    {i j : I} {f : D.KernelToCoordinateLinearMap i j}
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    D.kernelToCoordinateMorphism i j f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K := D.coordinateSimpleModule j
  intro hzero
  apply hf
  have hhom := congrArg
    (fun q : (D.vertexPresentation i).X₁ ⟶ D.coordinateSimple j ↦
      q.hom) hzero
  change f = 0 at hhom
  exact hhom

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.linearMap_vertexProjective_coordinate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem linearMap_vertexProjective_coordinate_eq_zero
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K
proof:
:= D.coordinateSimpleModule j
    ∀ g : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal
          (D.liftedCoordinate i) →ₗ[Bᵐᵒᵖ] K,
      g = 0 := by
  letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K := D.coordinateSimpleModule j
  intro g
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change g x = 0
  exact (Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun y _ ↦ ∀ hy : y ∈
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal (D.liftedCoordinate i),
        g ⟨y, hy⟩ = 0)
    (fun y hy ↦ by
      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy with rfl
      intro hySpan
      let e := D.liftedCoordinate i
      let xₑ : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal e :=
        ⟨op e, Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (op e))⟩
      change g xₑ = 0
      have hfix : (op e) • xₑ = xₑ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change op e * op e = op e
        rw [← op_mul, D.liftedCoordinate_complete.idem i]
      have hm := g.map_smul (op e) xₑ
      have hleft : g ((op e) • xₑ) = g xₑ :=
        congrArg g hfix
      have hm' : g xₑ = (op e) • g xₑ :=
        hleft.symm.trans hm
      change g xₑ = D.coordinateCharacter j e * g xₑ at hm'
      rw [D.coordinateCharacter_liftedCoordinate_ne hij] at hm'
      simpa using hm')
    (by
      intro hzero
      change g (0 : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightIdeal
        (D.liftedCoordinate i)) = 0
      exact map_zero g)
    (fun x y hx hy hxzero hyzero ↦ by
      intro hxy
      change g (⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩) = 0
      rw [map_add, hxzero hx, hyzero hy, add_zero])
    (fun b x hx hxzero ↦ by
      intro hbx
      change g (b • ⟨x, hx⟩) = 0
      rw [map_smul, hxzero hx, smul_zero])
    x.property) x.property

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.hom_vertexProjective_coordinateSimple_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hom_vertexProjective_coordinateSimple_eq_zero
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (g : QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Tsukamoto.principalRightModule
          (D.liftedCoordinate i) ⟶ D.coordinateSimple j) :
    g = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  exact D.linearMap_vertexProjective_coordinate_eq_zero hij g.hom

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.coordinateSimple_not_iso
statement:
theorem coordinateSimple_not_iso
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    IsEmpty (D.coordinateSimple i ≅ D.coordinateSimple j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro e
  letI : Epi (D.vertexTopMap i) := D.vertexTopMap_epi i
  let f := D.vertexTopMap i ≫ e.hom
  have hf : f = 0 :=
    D.hom_vertexProjective_coordinateSimple_eq_zero hij f
  letI : Epi f := by dsimp only [f]; infer_instance
  have hid : 𝟙 (D.coordinateSimple j) = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_epi f).mp
    simp [hf]
  letI : Simple (D.coordinateSimple j) := D.coordinateSimple_simple j
  exact Simple.not_isZero (D.coordinateSimple j)
    ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero (D.coordinateSimple j)).mpr hid)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CotangentExtBridge.CoordinateData.nontrivial_ext_one_of_cross_cotangent
statement:
theorem nontrivial_ext_one_of_cross_cotangent
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {r : B}
    (hr : r ∈ Ring.jacobson B)
    (hcorner :
      D.liftedCoordinate i * r * D.liftedCoordinate j ∉
        (Ring.jacobson B) ^ 2) :
    Nontrivial
      (Ext (D.coordinateSimple i) (D.coordinateSimple j) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ f : D.KernelToCoordinateLinearMap i j, f ≠ 0 := by
    letI : Module Bᵐᵒᵖ K := D.coordinateSimpleModule j
    exact D.exists_nonzero_kernel_map_of_cross_cotangent hr hcorner
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hex
  letI : Projective (D.vertexPresentation i).X₂ :=
    D.vertexPresentation_projective_middle i
  have hExt :=
    nontrivial_ext_one_of_projective_presentation
      (D.vertexPresentation_shortExact i)
      (D.kernelToCoordinateMorphism i j f)
      (D.kernelToCoordinateMorphism_ne_zero hf)
      (fun g ↦ D.hom_vertexProjective_coordinateSimple_eq_zero hij g)
  simpa [vertexPresentation, coordinateSimple] using hExt

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.ThreeVertex.optionAugmentation_ladder
statement:
theorem optionAugmentation_ladder {D : Type*}
    (A : Data D) (x : D) (n : ℕ) :
    (optionAugmentation A).ladder (some x) n =
      optionExtendVector (A.ladder x n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero =>
      funext y
      cases y with
      | none => simp [Data.ladder_zero, FactorLadder.basis,
          optionAugmentation, optionExtendVector]
      | some y =>
          simp only [Data.ladder_zero, optionExtendVector]
          by_cases h : y = x <;> simp [FactorLadder.basis, h]
  | one =>
      rw [Data.ladder_one, Data.ladder_one]
      change optionExtendAddHom A.theta (basis (some x)) =
        optionExtendVector (A.theta (basis x))
      have hbasis : (fun y => basis (some x) (some y)) = basis x := by
        funext y
        by_cases h : y = x <;> simp [basis, h]
      funext y
      cases y with
      | none => rfl
      | some y =>
          change A.theta (fun z => basis (some x) (some z)) y =
            A.theta (basis x) y
          rw [hbasis]
  | more n hn hn1 =>
      rw [show n + 2 = n + 2 by rfl, Data.ladder_add_two,
        Data.ladder_add_two, hn, hn1]
      simp [optionAugmentation]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.ThreeVertex.augmentedEdge_irrefl
proof:
:= by

  | none => simp [augmentedEdge]
  | some x =>
      change ¬ HasIrreducibleMorphism (σ.obj x.1) (σ.obj x.1)
      exact σ.hasNoIrreducibleEndomorphism_obj x.1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.FiniteARTranslationData.ThreeVertex.middleMultiplicity_eq_edgeIndicator
statement:
theorem middleMultiplicity_eq_edgeIndicator
    {K : Set ι}
    (hunit : AR.HasUnitDeletedMiddleMultiplicities σ K)
    (x y : DeletedLabel K) :
    deletedMiddleMultiplicity (σ := σ) (D := AR) K x y =
      if augmentedEdgeBool (σ := σ) (some y) (some x) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : HasIrreducibleMorphism (σ.obj y.1) (σ.obj x.1)
  · simpa [augmentedEdgeBool, augmentedEdge, h] using hunit x y h
  · have hnotpos : ¬ 0 <
        deletedMiddleMultiplicity (σ := σ) (D := AR) K x y :=
      (AR.deletedMiddleMultiplicity_pos_iff_irreducible σ K x y).not.mpr h
