name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.hom_eq_zero_of_not_le
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_not_le (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    {x y : Fin Q.length} (hxy : ¬ x ≤ y)
    (f : obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x ⟶ obj (K := K) G Q hAlt y) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := quotientHom_surjective (K := K) G Q hAlt x y f
  have hg := WordPath.hom_eq_zero_of_not_le G Q hxy g
  subst g
  exact quotientHom_zero G Q hAlt

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.mem_meshIdeal_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_meshIdeal_self_eq_zero
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q) (x : Fin Q.length)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q x}
    (hf : f ∈ (meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom
      (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q x)) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  change f ∈ HomIdeal.generatedHomSubmodule K
    (meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt)
    (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q x) at hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
      rcases hf with ⟨A, B, r, ⟨hAB, hr⟩, a, b, rfl⟩
      by_cases hxA : x ≤ WordPath.position G Q A
      · have hxB : x < WordPath.position G Q B := hxA.trans_lt hAB.1
        have hb : b = 0 :=
          WordPath.hom_eq_zero_of_not_le G Q (not_le_of_gt hxB) b
        simp [hb]
      · have ha : a = 0 :=
          WordPath.hom_eq_zero_of_not_le G Q hxA a
        simp [ha]
  | zero => rfl
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [hf, hg, add_zero]
  | smul k f _ hf => rw [hf, smul_zero]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.quotientHom_self_injective
statement:
theorem quotientHom_self_injective
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q) (x : Fin Q.length) :
    Function.Injective (quotientHom (K := K) G Q hAlt :
      (WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q x) →
        (obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x ⟶ obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  have hmap :
      (quotientFunctor (K := K) G Q hAlt).map f =
        (quotientFunctor (K := K) G Q hAlt).map g :=
    congrArg InducedCategory.Hom.hom hfg
  have hrel :=
    (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor_map_eq_iff
      (meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).rel f g).mp hmap
  have hzero := mem_meshIdeal_self_eq_zero G Q hAlt x hrel
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.selfHomLinearEquiv_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selfHomLinearEquiv_id
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q) (x : Fin Q.length) :
    selfHomLinearEquiv (K := K) G Q hAlt x
      (𝟙 (obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpre :
      (quotientEndLinearEquiv (K := K) G Q hAlt x).symm
        (𝟙 (obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x)) =
          𝟙 (WordPath.obj K G Q x) := by
    apply (quotientEndLinearEquiv (K := K) G Q hAlt x).injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact quotientHom_id G Q hAlt x
  rw [selfHomLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, hpre,
    WordPath.selfHomLinearEquiv_id]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.eq_smul_id_selfHomLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem eq_smul_id_selfHomLinearEquiv
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q) (x : Fin Q.length)
    (f : obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x ⟶ obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x) :
    f = selfHomLinearEquiv (K := K) G Q hAlt x f •
      𝟙 (obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (selfHomLinearEquiv (K := K) G Q hAlt x).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, selfHomLinearEquiv_id,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.selfHomLinearEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem selfHomLinearEquiv_comp
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q) (x : Fin Q.length)
    (f g : obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x ⟶ obj (K := K) G Q hAlt x) :

      selfHomLinearEquiv (K := K) G Q hAlt x f *

  simp [selfHomLinearEquiv_id, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.SegmentReducedness.isReduced_deleteEdge_of_allOccurrencesBefore
statement:
theorem isReduced_deleteEdge_of_allOccurrencesBefore
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (a b : L)
    (_hab : G.Adj a b)
    (hBefore : AllOccurrencesBefore Q a b)
    (hReducedToPositive : ∀ R : List L,
      IsReduced G R → HasPositiveInversionRoots G R)
    (hPositiveToReduced : ∀ R : List L,
      HasPositiveInversionRoots (deleteEdge G a b) R →
        IsReduced (deleteEdge G a b) R)
    (hSignCoherent : ∀ (R : List L) (x : Fin R.length),
      IsNonnegative (inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) R x) ∨
        IsNonpositive (inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) R x))
    (hReduced : IsReduced G Q) :
    IsReduced (deleteEdge G a b) Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hQ, hbU, haV⟩ :=
    exists_append_not_mem_of_allOccurrencesBefore hBefore
  subst Q
  have hPositiveQ : HasPositiveInversionRoots G (u ++ v) :=
    hReducedToPositive (u ++ v) hReduced
  have hReducedV : IsReduced G v := by
    have hDrop := hReduced.drop u.length
    simpa only [SimpleGraphCoxeter.IsReduced, List.drop_left] using hDrop
  have hPositiveV : HasPositiveInversionRoots G v :=
    hReducedToPositive v hReducedV
  apply hPositiveToReduced (u ++ v)
  intro x
  by_cases hxU : x.val < u.length
  · have hTake : (u ++ v).take x.val = u.take x.val :=
      List.take_append_of_le_length hxU.le
    let xu : Fin u.length := ⟨x.val, hxU⟩
    have hLabel : (u ++ v).get x = u.get xu := by
      exact List.getElem_append_left hxU
    have hbTake : b ∉ u.take x.val := by
      intro hb
      apply hbU
      exact List.mem_of_mem_take hb
    have hbLabel : b ≠ (u ++ v).get x := by
      intro h
      apply hbU
      rw [hLabel] at h
      rw [h]
      exact List.get_mem u xu
    have hRootEq :
        inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) (u ++ v) x =
          inversionRoot G (u ++ v) x := by
      rw [inversionRoot_eq_actWord, inversionRoot_eq_actWord, hTake]
      apply actWord_deleteEdge_eq_of_not_mem_of_coord_eq_zero
        G a b (u.take x.val) (simpleRoot ((u ++ v).get x)) hbTake
      exact simpleRoot_apply_of_ne hbLabel
    rw [hRootEq]
    exact hPositiveQ x
  · have hxGe : u.length ≤ x.val := Nat.le_of_not_gt hxU
    let k : ℕ := x.val - u.length
    have hkV : k < v.length := by
      have hxLen := x.isLt
      simp only [List.length_append] at hxLen
      dsimp only [k]
      omega
    let xv : Fin v.length := ⟨k, hkV⟩
    let j : L := v[xv]
    have hLabel : (u ++ v)[x] = j := by
      change (u ++ v)[x.val] = v[k]
      exact List.getElem_append_right hxGe
    have hTake : (u ++ v).take x.val = u ++ v.take k := by
      rw [List.take_append]
      rw [List.take_of_length_le hxGe]
    have haTake : a ∉ v.take k := by
      intro ha
      apply haV
      exact List.mem_of_mem_take ha
    have haLabel : a ≠ j := by
      intro h
      apply haV
      rw [h]
      exact List.getElem_mem hkV
    let gamma : RootLattice L :=
      actWord G (v.take k) (simpleRoot j)
    have hGammaPositive : IsPositive gamma := by
      have h := hPositiveV xv
      rw [inversionRoot_eq_actWord] at h
      change IsPositive gamma at h
      exact h
    have hSplit := actWord_deleteEdge_split
      G a b u (v.take k) (simpleRoot j)
      hbU haTake (simpleRoot_apply_of_ne haLabel)
    have hDeletedRoot :
        inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) (u ++ v) x =
          actWord (deleteEdge G a b) (u ++ v.take k)
            (simpleRoot j) := by
      rw [inversionRoot_eq_actWord, hTake, hLabel]
    have hOriginalRoot :
        inversionRoot G (u ++ v) x =
          actWord G (u ++ v.take k) (simpleRoot j) := by
      rw [inversionRoot_eq_actWord, hTake, hLabel]
    by_cases hGammaB : gamma b = 0
    · have hEq :
          inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) (u ++ v) x =
            inversionRoot G (u ++ v) x := by
        rw [hDeletedRoot, hOriginalRoot]
        exact hSplit.2.1 hGammaB
      rw [hEq]
      exact hPositiveQ x
    · have hGammaBPos : 0 < gamma b :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (hGammaPositive.1 b) (Ne.symm hGammaB)
      have hDeletedB :
          inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) (u ++ v) x b = gamma b := by
        rw [hDeletedRoot]
        exact hSplit.2.2
      rcases hSignCoherent (u ++ v) x with hNonnegative | hNonpositive
      · refine ⟨hNonnegative, ?_⟩
        intro hZero
        apply hGammaB
        rw [← hDeletedB]
        simpa using congrFun hZero b
      · exact False.elim (by
          have hle := hNonpositive b
          rw [hDeletedB] at hle
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hGammaBPos)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.SegmentReducedness.isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated
statement:
theorem isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (a b : L)
    (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (hSeparated : AllOccurrencesBefore Q a b ∨
      AllOccurrencesBefore Q b a)
    (hReducedToPositive : ∀ R : List L,
      IsReduced G R → HasPositiveInversionRoots G R)
    (hPositiveToReduced : ∀ R : List L,
      HasPositiveInversionRoots (deleteEdge G a b) R →
        IsReduced (deleteEdge G a b) R)
    (hSignCoherent : ∀ (R : List L) (x : Fin R.length),
      IsNonnegative (inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) R x) ∨
        IsNonpositive (inversionRoot (deleteEdge G a b) R x))
    (hReduced : IsReduced G Q) :
    IsReduced (deleteEdge G a b) Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases hSeparated with hBefore | hBefore
  · exact isReduced_deleteEdge_of_allOccurrencesBefore G Q a b hab
      hBefore hReducedToPositive hPositiveToReduced hSignCoherent hReduced
  · have h := isReduced_deleteEdge_of_allOccurrencesBefore
      G Q b a hab.symm hBefore hReducedToPositive
      (fun R hR ↦ by
        rw [← deleteEdge_comm G a b]
        apply hPositiveToReduced R
        simpa only [deleteEdge_comm G a b] using hR)
      (fun R x ↦ by
        simpa only [deleteEdge_comm G a b] using hSignCoherent R x)
      hReduced
    simpa only [deleteEdge_comm G a b] using h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.SegmentReducedness.isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated_of_reducedWordsPositive
statement:
theorem isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated_of_reducedWordsPositive
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (a b : L)
    (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (hSeparated : AllOccurrencesBefore Q a b ∨
      AllOccurrencesBefore Q b a)
    (hPositiveG : ReducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots G)
    (hPositiveDeleted :
      ReducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots (deleteEdge G a b))
    (hReduced : IsReduced G Q) :
    IsReduced (deleteEdge G a b) Q
proof:
:= by
  apply isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated G Q a b hab hSeparated
    hPositiveG
  · intro R hRoots
    exact
      (isReduced_iff_hasPositiveInversionRoots_of_rightDescentNegativity
        (deleteEdge G a b) R
        (rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_reducedWordsPositive
          (deleteEdge G a b) hPositiveDeleted)).2 hRoots
  · intro R x
    rcases
        hasRealRootSignDichotomy_of_reducedWordsPositive
          (deleteEdge G a b) hPositiveDeleted
          (prefixElement (deleteEdge G a b) R x) R[x] with hpos | hneg
    · exact Or.inl hpos.1
    · exact Or.inr hneg.1
  · exact hReduced

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.SegmentReducedness.isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated_unconditional
statement:
theorem isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated_unconditional
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (a b : L)
    (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (hSeparated : AllOccurrencesBefore Q a b ∨
      AllOccurrencesBefore Q b a)
    (hReduced : IsReduced G Q) :
    IsReduced (deleteEdge G a b) Q
proof:
:=
  isReduced_deleteEdge_of_separated_of_reducedWordsPositive
    G Q a b hab hSeparated
      (reducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots G)
      (reducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots (deleteEdge G a b))
      hReduced

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.finrank_hom_biproduct
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_biproduct
    {J : Type uJ} [Fintype J] (X : C) (Y : J → C)
    [Module.Finite K (X ⟶ ⨁ Y)]
    [∀ j, Module.Finite K (X ⟶ Y j)] :
    Module.finrank K (X ⟶ ⨁ Y) =
      ∑ j, Module.finrank K (X ⟶ Y j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(homLinearEquivBiproduct X Y).finrank_eq,
    Module.finrank_pi_fintype K]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.homPathBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homPathBasis_apply
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (x y : WordPath.Category K G Q)
    (p : Quiver.Path (WordPath.vertex G Q y) (WordPath.vertex G Q x)) :
    WordPath.homPathBasis G Q x y p = WordPath.pathHom G Q p
proof:
:= by
  apply (WordPath.homPathLinearEquiv G Q x y).injective
  simp [WordPath.homPathBasis, WordPath.pathHom]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.pathHom_eq_id_or_factor_firstMiddle
statement:
theorem pathHom_eq_id_or_factor_firstMiddle
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    {x z : Fin Q.length}
    (p : Quiver.Path (WordPath.vertex G Q z) (WordPath.vertex G Q x)) :
    p.length = 0 ∨
      ∃ (y : Fin Q.length) (hxy : IsMiddle G Q x y)
        (g : WordPath.obj K G Q y ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q z),
        WordPath.pathHom G Q p =
          WordPath.middleArrow (K := K) G Q hxy ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p.length = 0
  · exact Or.inl hp0
  · obtain ⟨c, p', e, hp⟩ :=
      (Quiver.Path.length_ne_zero_iff_eq_cons p).mp hp0
    subst p
    rcases c with ⟨y⟩
    rcases e with ⟨hxy⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨y, hxy, WordPath.pathHom G Q p', by
      rw [WordPath.middleArrow, WordPath.pathHom_comp]
      rfl⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.hasStartingNormalForm_zero
statement:
theorem hasStartingNormalForm_zero
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length) :
    HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, fun _ ↦ 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.zero_mem
  · simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.HasStartingNormalForm.add
statement:
theorem HasStartingNormalForm.add
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    {f₁ f₂ : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (h₁ : HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f₁)
    (h₂ : HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f₂) :
    HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t (f₁ + f₂)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨a₁, g₁, hg₁, rfl⟩
  rcases h₂ with ⟨a₂, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ a₁ b + a₂ b, fun y ↦ g₁ y + g₂ y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.add_mem
      (hg₁ y) (hg₂ y)
  · simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    abel

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.HasStartingNormalForm.smul
statement:
theorem HasStartingNormalForm.smul
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    (k : K)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (hf : HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f) :
    HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t (k • f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨a, g, hg, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ k • a b, fun y ↦ k • g y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    exact HomIdeal.smul_mem (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt) k (hg y)
  · simp only [Linear.comp_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_add]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.startingGenerator_hasStartingNormalForm
statement:
theorem startingGenerator_hasStartingNormalForm
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (hf : f ∈ startingGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt x t) :
    HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hf with ⟨b, hxb, u, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, hxy, g, hg, rfl⟩
  · let b₀ : {c : Fin Q.length // IsPrevious Q x c} := ⟨b, hxb⟩
    let a : ∀ c : {c : Fin Q.length // IsPrevious Q x c},
        WordPath.obj K G Q c.1 ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t :=
      fun c ↦ dite (c = b₀)
        (fun h ↦ by subst c; exact u) (fun _ ↦ 0)
    refine ⟨a, fun _ ↦ 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.zero_mem
    · have hsum :
          (∑ c, WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt c.2 ≫ a c) =
            WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt hxb ≫ u := by
        calc
          _ = WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt b₀.2 ≫ a b₀ := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_single b₀
            · intro c _ hc
              simp [a, hc]
            · intro hb₀
              exact (hb₀ (Finset.mem_univ b₀)).elim
          _ = _ := by simp [a, b₀]
      rw [hsum]
      simp
  · let y₀ : {z : Fin Q.length // IsMiddle G Q x z} := ⟨y, hxy⟩
    let g' : ∀ z : {z : Fin Q.length // IsMiddle G Q x z},
        WordPath.obj K G Q z.1 ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t :=
      fun z ↦ dite (z = y₀)
        (fun h ↦ by subst z; exact g) (fun _ ↦ 0)
    refine ⟨fun _ ↦ 0, g', ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      by_cases hz : z = y₀
      · subst z
        simpa [g', y₀] using hg
      · simp [g', hz]
    · have hsum :
          (∑ z, WordPath.middleArrow (K := K) G Q z.2 ≫ g' z) =
            WordPath.middleArrow (K := K) G Q hxy ≫ g := by
        calc
          _ = WordPath.middleArrow (K := K) G Q y₀.2 ≫ g' y₀ := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_single y₀
            · intro z _ hz
              simp [g', hz]
            · intro hy₀
              exact (hy₀ (Finset.mem_univ y₀)).elim
          _ = _ := by simp [g', y₀]
      rw [hsum]
      simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.startingSubmodule_hasStartingNormalForm
statement:
theorem startingSubmodule_hasStartingNormalForm
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (hf : f ∈ startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t) :
    HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf => exact startingGenerator_hasStartingNormalForm G Q hAlt x t hf
  | zero => exact hasStartingNormalForm_zero G Q hAlt x t
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => exact hf.add G Q hAlt x t hg
  | smul k f _ hf => exact hf.smul G Q hAlt x t k

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.HasStartingNormalForm.mem_meshIdeal
statement:
theorem HasStartingNormalForm.mem_meshIdeal
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (hf : HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f) :
    f ∈ (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom
      (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨a, g, hg, rfl⟩
  apply (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.add_mem
  · apply (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.sum_mem
    intro b hb
    exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).postcomp (a b)
      (HomIdeal.relation_mem_linearSpan
        (WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt)
        (show WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt b.2 ∈
          WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt
            (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q b.1) from
          ⟨b.2, rfl⟩))
  · apply (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.sum_mem
    intro y hy
    exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).precomp
      (WordPath.middleArrow (K := K) G Q y.2) (hg y)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.meshComposite_mem_startingSubmodule
statement:
theorem meshComposite_mem_startingSubmodule
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    {x a b t : Fin Q.length}
    (hab : IsPrevious Q a b)
    (u : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q a)
    (v : WordPath.obj K G Q b ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t) :
    u ≫ WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt hab ≫ v ∈
      startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype
      (Quiver.Path
        (WordPath.vertex G Q (WordPath.obj K G Q a))
        (WordPath.vertex G Q (WordPath.obj K G Q x))) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [← (WordPath.homPathBasis G Q
    (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q a)).sum_repr u]
  simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro p hp
  simp only [Linear.smul_comp]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  rw [homPathBasis_apply]
  rcases pathHom_eq_id_or_factor_firstMiddle (K := K) G Q p with hp0 | hfactor
  · have hav : WordPath.vertex G Q a = WordPath.vertex G Q x :=
      Quiver.Path.eq_of_length_zero p hp0
    have hax : a = x := congrArg WordPath.ReverseWordQuiver.pos hav
    subst a
    have hp : p = Quiver.Path.nil :=
      Quiver.Path.eq_nil_of_length_zero p hp0
    subst p
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact Or.inl ⟨b, hab, v, by simp⟩
  · rcases hfactor with ⟨y, hxy, g, hpath⟩
    rw [hpath]
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine Or.inr ⟨y, hxy,
      g ≫ WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt hab ≫ v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact HomIdeal.composite_mem_linearSpan
        (WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt) g
        (show WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt hab ∈
          WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt
            (WordPath.obj K G Q a) (WordPath.obj K G Q b) from
          ⟨hab, rfl⟩) v
    · rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.startingSubmodule_mem_meshIdeal
statement:
theorem startingSubmodule_mem_meshIdeal
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (hf : f ∈ startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t) :
    f ∈ (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom
      (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q t)
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
      rcases hf with hmesh | hmiddle
      · rcases hmesh with ⟨b, hxb, a, rfl⟩
        simpa using
          (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).postcomp a
            (HomIdeal.relation_mem_linearSpan
              (WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt)
              (show WordPath.meshRelation (K := K) G Q hAlt hxb ∈
                WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt
                  (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q b) from
                ⟨hxb, rfl⟩))
      · rcases hmiddle with ⟨y, hxy, g, hg, rfl⟩
        exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).precomp _ hg
  | zero => exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.zero_mem
  | add f g _ _ hf hg =>
      exact (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom _ _ |>.add_mem hf hg
  | smul k f _ hf =>
      exact HomIdeal.smul_mem (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt) k hf

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.meshIdeal_mem_startingSubmodule
statement:
theorem meshIdeal_mem_startingSubmodule
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    {f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t}
    (hf : f ∈ (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom
      (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q t)) :
    f ∈ startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t
proof:
:= by
  change f ∈ HomIdeal.generatedHomSubmodule K
    (WordMesh.meshGeneratorSet (K := K) G Q hAlt)
    (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q t) at hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
      rcases hf with ⟨a, b, r, hr, u, v, rfl⟩
      rcases hr with ⟨hab, rfl⟩
      exact meshComposite_mem_startingSubmodule G Q hAlt hab u v
  | zero => exact (startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t).zero_mem
  | add f g _ _ hf hg =>
      exact (startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t).add_mem hf hg
  | smul k f _ hf =>
      exact (startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t).smul_mem k hf

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.mem_meshIdeal_iff_mem_startingSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_meshIdeal_iff_mem_startingSubmodule
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    (f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t) :
    f ∈ (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom
        (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q t) ↔
      f ∈ startingSubmodule (K := K) G Q hAlt x t
proof:
:=
  ⟨meshIdeal_mem_startingSubmodule G Q hAlt x t,
    startingSubmodule_mem_meshIdeal G Q hAlt x t⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMeshStartingRecurrence.mem_meshIdeal_iff_hasStartingNormalForm
statement:
theorem mem_meshIdeal_iff_hasStartingNormalForm
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hAlt : HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    (x t : Fin Q.length)
    (f : WordPath.obj K G Q x ⟶ WordPath.obj K G Q t) :
    f ∈ (WordMesh.meshIdeal (K := K) G Q hAlt).hom
        (WordPath.obj K G Q x) (WordPath.obj K G Q t) ↔
      HasStartingNormalForm (K := K) G Q hAlt x t f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    exact startingSubmodule_hasStartingNormalForm G Q hAlt x t
      (meshIdeal_mem_startingSubmodule G Q hAlt x t hf)
  · exact HasStartingNormalForm.mem_meshIdeal G Q hAlt x t

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.FixedWordSubwords.fixedWordElement_set_finite
statement:
theorem fixedWordElement_set_finite (ambient : List B) :
    {w : W | ∃ positions : Finset (Fin ambient.length),
      IsReducedSubwordFor cs ambient w positions}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let productAt : Finset (Fin ambient.length) → W :=
    fun positions => cs.wordProd (subwordAt ambient positions)
  apply (Set.finite_range productAt).subset
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨positions, _hreduced, hprod⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨positions, hprod⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.FixedWordSubwords.reducedPositionCandidates_nonempty

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.FixedWordSubwords.exists_leftmostReducedSubwordFor
statement:
theorem exists_leftmostReducedSubwordFor
    (ambient : List B) (w : FixedWordElement cs ambient) :
    ∃ positions : Finset (Fin ambient.length),
      IsLeftmostReducedSubwordFor cs ambient w.1 positions
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨positions, hpositions, hminimal⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_min_image
      (reducedPositionCandidates cs ambient w.1)
      (fun positions => positions.sort (· ≤ ·))
      (reducedPositionCandidates_nonempty cs ambient w)
  refine ⟨positions,
    (mem_reducedPositionCandidates_iff cs ambient w.1 positions).1 hpositions,
    ?_⟩
  intro other hother hlex
  have hle := hminimal other
    ((mem_reducedPositionCandidates_iff cs ambient w.1 other).2 hother)
  have hlt : other.sort (· ≤ ·) < positions.sort (· ≤ ·) :=
    (List.lt_iff_lex_lt _ _).2 hlex
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hlt

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.FixedWordSubwords.subwordAtFn_reverse
statement:
theorem subwordAtFn_reverse {n : ℕ}
    (word : Fin n → B) (positions : Finset (Fin n)) :
    subwordAtFn (word ∘ Fin.rev) (reversePositions positions) =
      (subwordAtFn word positions).reverse
proof:
:= by
  have hdescending :
      ((positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map Fin.rev).SortedGT := by
    rw [List.sortedGT_iff_pairwise, List.pairwise_map]
    exact positions.sortedLT_sort.pairwise.imp
      fun hij => Fin.rev_lt_rev.mpr hij
  have hmembership :
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        i ∈ (positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map Fin.rev ↔
          i ∈ (reversePositions positions).sort (· ≤ ·) := by
    intro i
    simp only [List.mem_map, Finset.mem_sort,
      mem_reversePositions_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      simpa using ha
    · intro hi
      exact ⟨i.rev, hi, Fin.rev_rev i⟩
  have hmapped :
      (positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map Fin.rev =
        ((reversePositions positions).sort (· ≤ ·)).reverse :=
    hdescending.eq_reverse_of_mem_iff_of_sortedLT
      hmembership (reversePositions positions).sortedLT_sort
  have hsorted :
      (reversePositions positions).sort (· ≤ ·) =
        ((positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map Fin.rev).reverse := by
    simpa using congrArg List.reverse hmapped.symm
  simp [subwordAtFn, hsorted, List.map_reverse, Function.comp_def]

proof:

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.FixedWordSubwords.subwordAt_reverse
statement:
theorem subwordAt_reverse
    (word : List B) (positions : Finset (Fin word.length)) :
    subwordAt word.reverse (reversePositionsIn word positions) =
      (subwordAt word positions).reverse
proof:
:= by
  have hdescending :
      ((positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map
        (reverseIndexEquiv word)).SortedGT := by
    rw [List.sortedGT_iff_pairwise, List.pairwise_map]
    exact positions.sortedLT_sort.pairwise.imp
      fun hij => reverseIndexEquiv_strictAnti word hij
  have hmembership :
      ∀ i : Fin word.reverse.length,
        i ∈ (positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map
            (reverseIndexEquiv word) ↔
          i ∈ (reversePositionsIn word positions).sort (· ≤ ·) := by
    intro i
    simp only [List.mem_map, Finset.mem_sort,
      reversePositionsIn, Finset.mem_map, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding]
  have hmapped :
      (positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map (reverseIndexEquiv word) =
        ((reversePositionsIn word positions).sort (· ≤ ·)).reverse :=
    hdescending.eq_reverse_of_mem_iff_of_sortedLT
      hmembership (reversePositionsIn word positions).sortedLT_sort
  have hsorted :
      (reversePositionsIn word positions).sort (· ≤ ·) =
        ((positions.sort (· ≤ ·)).map
          (reverseIndexEquiv word)).reverse := by
    simpa using congrArg List.reverse hmapped.symm
  have hget :
      word.reverse.get ∘ reverseIndexEquiv word = word.get := by
    funext i
    exact get_reverse_reverseIndexEquiv word i
  simp only [subwordAt, hsorted, List.map_reverse, List.map_map]
  rw [hget]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_simpleRoot
statement:
theorem geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_simpleRoot
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (w : Group G) (i : L) :
    geometricRepresentation G (w * (system G).simple i) (simpleRoot i) =
      -geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, geometricRepresentation_simple]
  change
    geometricRepresentation G w (simpleReflection G i (simpleRoot i)) =
      -geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot i)
  rw [simpleReflection_simpleRoot_self]
  exact map_neg (geometricRepresentation G w) (simpleRoot i)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.eq_simpleRoot_of_positive_of_simpleReflection_negative
statement:
theorem eq_simpleRoot_of_positive_of_simpleReflection_negative
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (w : Group G) (j i : L)
    (hpos :
      IsPositive (geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot j)))
    (hneg :
      IsNegative
        (simpleReflection G i
          (geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot j)))) :
    geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot j) = simpleRoot i
proof:
:= by
  let z : RootLattice L := geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot j)
  have hoff : ∀ h, h ≠ i → z h = 0 := by
    intro h hhi
    have hzle := hneg.1 h
    rw [simpleReflection_apply_of_ne G hhi] at hzle
    exact le_antisymm hzle (hpos.1 h)
  have hzi_ne : z i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzi
    apply hpos.2
    funext h
    by_cases hhi : h = i
    · subst h
      exact hzi
    · exact hoff h hhi
  have hzi_pos : 0 < z i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hpos.1 i) (Ne.symm hzi_ne)
  have hzsmul : z = (z i) • simpleRoot i := by
    funext h
    by_cases hhi : h = i
    · subst h
      simp
    · simp [hoff h hhi, simpleRoot_apply_of_ne hhi]
  have hinv :=
    congrArg (fun y ↦ (geometricRepresentation G w).symm y) hzsmul
  have hmul :
      z i * ((geometricRepresentation G w).symm (simpleRoot i)) j = 1 := by
    have hj := congrFun hinv j
    simpa only [z, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, simpleRoot_apply_self] using hj.symm
  have hdiv : z i ∣ 1 :=
    ⟨((geometricRepresentation G w).symm (simpleRoot i)) j, hmul.symm⟩
  have hzi_one : z i = 1 := Int.eq_one_of_dvd_one hzi_pos.le hdiv
  change z = simpleRoot i
  rw [hzsmul, hzi_one, one_smul]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.geometricRepresentation_wordProd_cons
statement:
theorem geometricRepresentation_wordProd_cons
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (a : L) (Q : List L) (z : RootLattice L) :
    geometricRepresentation G (wordProd G (a :: Q)) z =
      simpleReflection G a (geometricRepresentation G (wordProd G Q) z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SimpleGraphCoxeter.wordProd
  rw [CoxeterSystem.wordProd_cons, map_mul, LinearEquiv.mul_apply,
    geometricRepresentation_simple]
  rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.exists_eraseIdx_of_wordRoot_negative
statement:
theorem exists_eraseIdx_of_wordRoot_negative
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hsign : HasRealRootSignDichotomy G)
    (htransport : RootTransportDeterminesReflection G)
    (Q : List L) (i : L)
    (hnegative :
      IsNegative (geometricRepresentation G (wordProd G Q) (simpleRoot i))) :
    ∃ k, k < Q.length ∧
      wordProd G (Q.concat i) = wordProd G (Q.eraseIdx k)
proof:
:= by
  induction Q with
  | nil =>
      exfalso
      exact simpleRoot_isPositive i |>.not_isNegative
        (by simpa [SimpleGraphCoxeter.wordProd] using hnegative)
  | cons a Q ih =>
      have houter :
          IsNegative
            (simpleReflection G a
              (geometricRepresentation G (wordProd G Q) (simpleRoot i))) := by
        simpa only [geometricRepresentation_wordProd_cons] using hnegative
      rcases hsign (wordProd G Q) i with hpositive | hnegativeTail
      · have hroot :
            geometricRepresentation G (wordProd G Q) (simpleRoot i) =
              simpleRoot a :=
          eq_simpleRoot_of_positive_of_simpleReflection_negative
            G (wordProd G Q) i a hpositive houter
        have hmove := htransport (wordProd G Q) i a hroot
        refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
        simp only [List.concat_cons, List.eraseIdx_zero, List.tail_cons]
        unfold SimpleGraphCoxeter.wordProd
        rw [(system G).wordProd_cons, (system G).wordProd_concat]
        change
          (system G).wordProd Q * (system G).simple i =
            (system G).simple a * (system G).wordProd Q at hmove
        rw [hmove]
        exact (system G).simple_mul_simple_cancel_left a
      · obtain ⟨k, hk, hkprod⟩ := ih hnegativeTail
        refine ⟨k + 1, by simp [hk], ?_⟩
        have hmul :=
          congrArg (fun x ↦ (system G).simple a * x) hkprod
        simpa only [List.concat_cons, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ,
          SimpleGraphCoxeter.wordProd, CoxeterSystem.wordProd_cons] using hmul

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.not_wordRoot_negative_of_isReduced_concat
statement:
theorem not_wordRoot_negative_of_isReduced_concat
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hsign : HasRealRootSignDichotomy G)
    (htransport : RootTransportDeterminesReflection G)
    (Q : List L) (i : L)
    (hred : IsReduced G (Q.concat i)) :
    ¬ IsNegative
      (geometricRepresentation G (wordProd G Q) (simpleRoot i))
proof:
:= by
  intro hnegative
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkprod⟩ :=
    exists_eraseIdx_of_wordRoot_negative G hsign htransport Q i hnegative
  have hle := (system G).length_wordProd_le (Q.eraseIdx k)
  have hredEq := hred.eq
  change
    (system G).length ((system G).wordProd (Q.concat i)) =
      (Q.concat i).length at hredEq
  change
    (system G).wordProd (Q.concat i) =
      (system G).wordProd (Q.eraseIdx k) at hkprod
  rw [hkprod, List.length_concat] at hredEq
  have herase := List.length_eraseIdx_add_one hk
  omega

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.reducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots_of_signDichotomy_of_rootTransport
statement:
theorem reducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots_of_signDichotomy_of_rootTransport
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hsign : HasRealRootSignDichotomy G)
    (htransport : RootTransportDeterminesReflection G) :
    ReducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots G
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hred x
  have htake := hred.take (x + 1)
  have hlist : (Q.take x).concat Q[x] = Q.take (x + 1) :=
    by
      rw [List.concat_eq_append]
      exact List.take_concat_get' Q x x.isLt
  have hconcat : IsReduced G ((Q.take x).concat Q[x]) := by
    unfold SimpleGraphCoxeter.IsReduced
    rw [hlist]
    exact htake
  rcases hsign (wordProd G (Q.take x)) Q[x] with hpositive | hnegative
  · simpa [inversionRoot, prefixElement, SimpleGraphCoxeter.wordProd] using hpositive
  · exact False.elim
      (not_wordRoot_negative_of_isReduced_concat G hsign htransport
        (Q.take x) Q[x] hconcat hnegative)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility_of_rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot
statement:
theorem hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility_of_rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hneg : RightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G) :
    HasGlobalRootSignCompatibility G
proof:
:= by
  intro w i
  constructor
  · intro hpos hdescent
    exact IsPositive.not_isNegative hpos (hneg w i hdescent)
  · intro hnot
    have hdescent :
        (system G).IsRightDescent (w * (system G).simple i) i := by
      rw [(system G).isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul]
      simpa only [(system G).simple_mul_simple_cancel_right] using hnot
    have hnegative := hneg (w * (system G).simple i) i hdescent
    rw [geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_simpleRoot] at hnegative
    simpa using hnegative.neg

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility
statement:
theorem rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hcompat : HasGlobalRootSignCompatibility G) :
    RightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G
proof:
:= by
  intro w i hdescent
  have hnot :
      ¬ (system G).IsRightDescent (w * (system G).simple i) i :=
    ((system G).isRightDescent_iff_not_isRightDescent_mul).mp hdescent
  have hpositive := (hcompat (w * (system G).simple i) i).2 hnot
  rw [geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_simpleRoot] at hpositive
  simpa using hpositive.neg

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_iff_globalCompatibility
statement:
theorem rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_iff_globalCompatibility
    (G : SimpleGraph L) :
    RightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G ↔
      HasGlobalRootSignCompatibility G
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility_of_rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G,
    rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility G⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_reducedWordsPositive
statement:
theorem rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_reducedWordsPositive
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hpositive : ReducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots G) :
    RightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G
proof:
:= by
  intro w i hdescent
  let v : Group G := w * (system G).simple i
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hv⟩ := (system G).exists_isReduced v
  have hlength : (system G).length v + 1 = (system G).length w := by
    simpa only [v] using (system G).isRightDescent_iff.mp hdescent
  have hvsi : v * (system G).simple i = w := by
    dsimp only [v]
    exact (system G).simple_mul_simple_cancel_right i
  have hconcat : IsReduced G (Q.concat i) := by
    unfold SimpleGraphCoxeter.IsReduced CoxeterSystem.IsReduced
    rw [(system G).wordProd_concat, ← hv, hvsi, List.length_concat,
      ← hQ.eq, ← hv]
    exact hlength.symm
  have hlast :=
    hpositive (Q.concat i) hconcat ⟨Q.length, by simp⟩
  rw [inversionRoot_concat_last] at hlast
  change
    IsPositive
      (geometricRepresentation G ((system G).wordProd Q) (simpleRoot i))
    at hlast
  rw [← hv] at hlast
  have hwroot :
      geometricRepresentation G w (simpleRoot i) =
        -geometricRepresentation G v (simpleRoot i) := by
    rw [← hvsi, geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_simpleRoot]
  rw [hwroot]
  exact hlast.neg

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.RootSignStrategy.hasRealRootSignDichotomy_of_reducedWordsPositive
statement:
theorem hasRealRootSignDichotomy_of_reducedWordsPositive
    (G : SimpleGraph L)
    (hpositive : ReducedWordsHavePositiveInversionRoots G) :
    HasRealRootSignDichotomy G
proof:
:= by
  let hneg : RightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G :=
    rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot_of_reducedWordsPositive G hpositive
  let hcompat : HasGlobalRootSignCompatibility G :=
    hasGlobalRootSignCompatibility_of_rightDescentImpliesNegativeRoot G hneg
  intro w i
  by_cases hdescent : (system G).IsRightDescent w i
  · exact Or.inr (hneg w i hdescent)
  · exact Or.inl ((hcompat w i).2 hdescent)

theorem quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution

    {S : Type uS} [Ring S] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (sigma : IndecomposableSkeleton.{uR, uI, uR} R I)
    (tau : IndecomposableSkeleton.{uS, uJ, uS} S J)
    {FSource : Type uR} [Field FSource] [IsAlgClosed FSource]
    [Algebra FSource R] [FiniteDimensional FSource R]

    (Ttau : tau.FiniteARTranslationData)

proof:
:=
  OppositeDirectedProfile.quotientSubmoduleEquidistribution_of_explicitOrderMeshExactness
    (KSource := FSource) (KTarget := FTarget)
    sigma tau B Hsigma Htau Tsigma Ttau E

    (hasUniformMeshExactnessFor FTarget tau Htau Ttau
      (oppositeOrderChoice sigma tau B E))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.nonzeroNonisomorphismReachability_isPartialOrder
statement:
theorem nonzeroNonisomorphismReachability_isPartialOrder
    (H : HasAcyclicNonzeroNonisomorphisms sigma) :
    IsPartialOrder Iota (NonzeroNonisomorphismReachability sigma) where
  refl _
proof:
:= Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  trans _ _ _ := Relation.ReflTransGen.trans
  antisymm := by
    intro i j hij hji
    by_contra hne
    have hij' : Relation.TransGen (NonzeroNonisomorphism sigma) i j :=
      (Relation.reflTransGen_iff_eq_or_transGen.mp hij).resolve_left
        (fun hji' => hne hji'.symm)
    exact H i (hij'.trans_left hji)

proof:
:= directedLinearOrder sigma H
    i ≤ j := by
  letI : IsPartialOrder Iota (NonzeroNonisomorphismReachability sigma) :=
    nonzeroNonisomorphismReachability_isPartialOrder sigma H
  exact (extend_partialOrder
    (NonzeroNonisomorphismReachability sigma)).choose_spec.2 i j h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.directedLinearOrder_homOrderProperty
statement:
theorem directedLinearOrder_homOrderProperty
    (H : HasAcyclicNonzeroNonisomorphisms sigma) :
    letI
proof:
:= directedLinearOrder sigma H
    HomOrderProperty sigma := by
  letI := directedLinearOrder sigma H
  intro i j f hf hij
  have hfnot : ¬ IsIso f := by
    intro hfiso
    letI : IsIso f := hfiso
    exact hij (sigma.eq_of_iso ⟨asIso f⟩)
  have hreach : NonzeroNonisomorphismReachability sigma i j :=
    Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨f, hf, hfnot⟩
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne
    (le_directedLinearOrder_of_reachable sigma H hreach) hij

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.DirectedHomOrder.of_homOrderProperty
statement:
theorem of_homOrderProperty [Preorder Iota]
    (H : HomOrderProperty sigma) : DirectedHomOrder sigma
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { le_of_nonzero := ?_
      lt_of_irreducible := ?_ }
  · intro i j f hf
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      exact le_rfl
    · exact (H f hf hij).le
  · intro i j hij
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hij
    have hlabels : i ≠ j := by
      intro hEq
      subst j
      exact sigma.hasNoIrreducibleEndomorphism_obj i ⟨f, hf⟩
    have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hnotSquare :=
        ((sigma.isIrreducibleMorphism_iff_mem_radical_not_mem_radicalSquare
          f).1 hf).2
      apply hnotSquare
      rw [hzero]
      exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _
    exact H f hf0 hlabels

statement:

proof:

  intro i j f hf hij

  intro hiso
  exact hij (sigma.eq_of_iso hiso)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.IyamaMesh.WordMesh.PreStrictRealization.nakayamaStrictnessRealization
statement:
theorem nakayamaStrictnessRealization
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L)
    (hRuns : HasOnlyBoundaryRepeatedRuns G Q)
    (weight : Fin Q.length → ℤ)
    (hweight : IsPositiveRightAdditive G Q weight) :
    NakayamaStrictnessRealization
      (FiniteTau.finiteTauCategoryData (K := K) G Q hRuns.hasInteriorAlternation
        weight hweight)
      (Word.translationQuiver G Q hRuns weight hweight) where
  projective_iff x
proof:
:= by
    change (¬ Word.HasPrevious Q x) ↔
      IsZero ((rightMesh (K := K) G Q hRuns.hasInteriorAlternation
        (AdditiveHull.vertexObj (K := K) G Q
          hRuns.hasInteriorAlternation x)).X₁)
    exact (rightVertexLeftTerm_isZero_iff
      (K := K) G Q hRuns.hasInteriorAlternation x).symm
  tau_alignment x hx := by
    change Word.tauTo Q
        ((rightBoundaryEquiv (K := K) G Q
          hRuns.hasInteriorAlternation) x) =
      Word.tauTo Q ⟨x.1, hx⟩
    congr 1
  middle_iso x :=
    ⟨thetaPlusMiddleObjectIso (K := K) G Q hRuns weight hweight x⟩

theorem rightAROccurrence_subsingleton_of_finrank_le_one
    {z : Iota}
    (A : sigma.MinimalRightAlmostSplitDecomposition z) (x : Iota)

      ∃ a : K, a • 𝟙 (sigma.obj x) = f)

    (hscalar : ∀ x : Iota, ∀ f : sigma.obj x ⟶ sigma.obj x,
      ∃ a : K, a • 𝟙 (sigma.obj x) = f)
    (hfinrank : ∀ x : Iota,
      Module.finrank K (sigma.irreducibleHomSpace (K := K) x z) ≤ 1) :
    Function.Injective A.label
proof:
:= by
  intro t u htu
  let tx : sigma.RightAROccurrence A (A.label t) := ⟨t, rfl⟩
  let ux : sigma.RightAROccurrence A (A.label t) := ⟨u, htu.symm⟩

      (sigma.RightAROccurrence A (A.label t)) :=
    sigma.rightAROccurrence_subsingleton_of_finrank_le_one
      A (A.label t) (hscalar (A.label t)) (hfinrank (A.label t))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.rightARSummandArrow_irreducible
statement:
theorem rightARSummandArrow_irreducible {z : Iota}
    (A : sigma.MinimalRightAlmostSplitDecomposition z) (t : A.index) :
    IsIrreducibleMorphism
      (biproduct.ι (fun j : A.index ↦ sigma.obj (A.label j)) t ≫
        A.decomposition.inv ≫ A.map)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : A.index → FGModuleCat.{u} R :=
    fun j ↦ sigma.obj (A.label j)
  let inc : F t ⟶ A.middle :=
    biproduct.ι F t ≫ A.decomposition.inv
  let proj : A.middle ⟶ F t :=
    A.decomposition.hom ≫ biproduct.π F t
  let g : F t ⟶ sigma.obj z := inc ≫ A.map
  have hincproj : inc ≫ proj = 𝟙 (F t) := by
    simp [inc, proj, Category.assoc]
  have hnotepi : ¬ IsSplitEpi g := by
    intro hg
    apply A.rightAlmostSplit.not_isSplitEpi
    obtain ⟨se⟩ := hg.exists_splitEpi
    exact IsSplitEpi.mk'
      { section_ := se.section_ ≫ inc
        id := by simpa only [g, Category.assoc] using se.id }
  have hnotmono : ¬ IsSplitMono g := by
    intro hg
    letI : IsSplitMono g := hg
    exact hnotepi (sigma.isSplitEpi_of_isSplitMono_between_obj g)
  change IsIrreducibleMorphism g
  refine ⟨hnotmono, hnotepi, ?_⟩
  intro M a b hab
  by_cases hb : IsSplitEpi b
  · exact Or.inr hb
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := A.rightAlmostSplit.factors b hb
    let e : A.middle ⟶ A.middle :=
      𝟙 A.middle + proj ≫ (a ≫ c - inc)
    have hefix : e ≫ A.map = A.map := by
      dsimp only [e]
      rw [Preadditive.add_comp, Category.id_comp,
        Category.assoc, Preadditive.sub_comp]
      have hac : (a ≫ c) ≫ A.map = g := by
        rw [Category.assoc, hc, hab]
      rw [hac]
      change A.map + proj ≫ (g - g) = A.map
      simp
    have hince : inc ≫ e = a ≫ c := by
      dsimp only [e]
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Category.comp_id,
        ← Category.assoc, hincproj, Category.id_comp]
      abel
    letI : IsIso e := A.rightMinimal e hefix
    exact Or.inl (IsSplitMono.mk'
      { retraction := c ≫ inv e ≫ proj
        id := by
          calc
            a ≫ (c ≫ inv e ≫ proj) =
                (a ≫ c) ≫ inv e ≫ proj := by
                  simp only [Category.assoc]
            _ = (inc ≫ e) ≫ inv e ≫ proj := by rw [hince]
            _ = 𝟙 (F t) := by
                  simp only [Category.assoc,
                    IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, hincproj] })

    IsIrreducibleMorphism (sigma.rightAROccurrenceArrow A x t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨t, rfl⟩
  simpa [rightAROccurrenceArrow] using
    (sigma.rightARSummandArrow_irreducible A t)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.IndecomposableSkeleton.rightAROccurrenceToIrr_single_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rightAROccurrenceToIrr_single_ne_zero {z : Iota}
    (A : sigma.MinimalRightAlmostSplitDecomposition z) (x : Iota)
    (t : sigma.RightAROccurrence A x) :
    sigma.rightAROccurrenceToIrr A x
      (sigma.rightAROccurrenceUnit (K := K) A x t) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (sigma.RightAROccurrence A x) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite (sigma.RightAROccurrence A x)
  intro hzero
  have hirr := sigma.rightAROccurrenceArrow_irreducible A x t
  have hnotSquare :=
    (sigma.isIrreducibleMorphism_iff_mem_radical_not_mem_radicalSquare
      (sigma.rightAROccurrenceArrow A x t)).1 hirr |>.2
  apply hnotSquare
  have hmk :
      (sigma.radicalSquareInRadicalSubmodule (K := K) x z).mkQ
        ((sigma.rightAROccurrenceToRadical A x)
          (sigma.rightAROccurrenceUnit (K := K) A x t)) = 0 := by
    simpa [rightAROccurrenceToIrr] using hzero
  have hmem := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero
    (sigma.radicalSquareInRadicalSubmodule (K := K) x z)).mp hmk
  change (ConcreteCategory.ofHom
      ((sigma.rightAROccurrenceToRadical A x)
        (sigma.rightAROccurrenceUnit (K := K) A x t)).1 :
      sigma.obj x ⟶ sigma.obj z) ∈
    sigma.radicalSquareHomAddSubgroup x z at hmem
  simpa [rightAROccurrenceToRadical, rightAROccurrenceUnit,
    rightAROccurrenceCombinationLinear, rightAROccurrenceCombination,
    rightAROccurrenceArrowLinear] using hmem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.transportedSimpleRoot_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportedSimpleRoot_zero (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (i : L) :
    transportedSimpleRoot G Q i 0 = simpleRoot i
proof:
:= by
  simp [transportedSimpleRoot]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.adjacentContribution_of_adj
statement:
theorem adjacentContribution_of_adj
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (i : L)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n < Q.length) (hadj : G.Adj (Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩) i) :
    adjacentContribution G Q i n = inversionRoot G Q ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold adjacentContribution
  split
  · rename_i hn'
    have heq : (⟨n, hn'⟩ : Fin Q.length) = ⟨n, hn⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    simp [heq]
  · rename_i hn'
    exact False.elim (hn' hn)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.adjacentContribution_of_not_adj

theorem adjacentContribution_of_not_adj
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (i : L)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.transportedSimpleRoot_succ_of_ne
statement:
theorem transportedSimpleRoot_succ_of_ne
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (i : L)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n < Q.length)
    (hne : Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩ ≠ i) :
    transportedSimpleRoot G Q i (n + 1) =
      transportedSimpleRoot G Q i n + adjacentContribution G Q i n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [transportedSimpleRoot, geometricRepresentation_prefix_succ G Q hn]
  change
    geometricRepresentation G (prefixElement G Q n)
        (simpleReflection G (Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩) (simpleRoot i)) =
      transportedSimpleRoot G Q i n + adjacentContribution G Q i n
  by_cases hadj : G.Adj (Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩) i
  · rw [adjacentContribution_of_adj G Q i hn hadj,
      simpleReflection_simpleRoot_of_adj G hadj]
    simp [map_add, transportedSimpleRoot, inversionRoot]
  · rw [adjacentContribution_of_not_adj G Q i hn hadj,
      simpleReflection_simpleRoot_of_ne_of_not_adj G hne hadj]
    simp [transportedSimpleRoot]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.transportedSimpleRoot_eq_add_sum_Ico
statement:
theorem transportedSimpleRoot_eq_add_sum_Ico
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (i : L)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ Q.length)
    (hne : ∀ n, (hn : n < Q.length) → a ≤ n → n < b →
      Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩ ≠ i) :
    transportedSimpleRoot G Q i b =
      transportedSimpleRoot G Q i a +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a b, adjacentContribution G Q i n
proof:
:= by
  induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ b hab ih =>
      have hbLt : b < Q.length := by omega
      have hstep := transportedSimpleRoot_succ_of_ne G Q i hbLt
        (hne b hbLt hab (Nat.lt_succ_self b))
      rw [hstep, ih (by omega)
        (fun n hn han hnb => hne n hn han (by omega))]
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hab]
      simp only [add_assoc]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.transportedSimpleRoot_succ_of_label_eq
statement:
theorem transportedSimpleRoot_succ_of_label_eq
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (i : L)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n < Q.length)
    (heq : Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩ = i) :
    transportedSimpleRoot G Q i (n + 1) =
      -inversionRoot G Q ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [transportedSimpleRoot, geometricRepresentation_prefix_succ G Q hn]
  change
    geometricRepresentation G (prefixElement G Q n)
        (simpleReflection G (Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩) (simpleRoot i)) =
      -inversionRoot G Q ⟨n, hn⟩
  subst i
  rw [simpleReflection_simpleRoot_self]
  simp [inversionRoot]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.isMiddle_iff_between_previous_and_endpoint
statement:
theorem isMiddle_iff_between_previous_and_endpoint
    {G : SimpleGraph L} {Q : List L}
    (hAlt : ARWord.HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    {p x : Fin Q.length} (hpx : ARWord.IsPrevious Q p x)
    (y : Fin Q.length) :
    ARWord.IsMiddle G Q y x ↔
      p < y ∧ y < x ∧ G.Adj (ARWord.label Q y) (ARWord.label Q x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨hy.2.2.1 p hpx, hy.2.1, hy.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpy, hyx, hadj⟩
    have hpAdj : G.Adj (ARWord.label Q p) (ARWord.label Q y) := by
      rw [hpx.2.1]
      exact hadj.symm
    refine ⟨hadj, hyx, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hqx
      rw [ARWord.isPrevious_unique hqx hpx]
      exact hpy
    · intro z hyz hzx hzLabel
      have heq := hAlt hpx hpAdj hpy hyx (hpy.trans hyz) hzx hzLabel
      exact hyz.ne heq.symm

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.middleRootSum_eq_sum_filter
statement:
theorem middleRootSum_eq_sum_filter
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (x : Fin Q.length) :
    middleRootSum G Q x = filteredMiddleRootSum G Q x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold filteredMiddleRootSum
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  unfold middleRootSum
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range Q.length, middleContribution G Q x n) =
        ∑ y : Fin Q.length, middleContribution G Q x y.val :=
      (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun n ↦ middleContribution G Q x n) Q.length).symm
    _ = ∑ y : Fin Q.length,
        if ARWord.IsMiddle G Q y x then inversionRoot G Q y else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      simp [middleContribution, y.isLt]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.adjacentContribution_eq_middleContribution
statement:
theorem adjacentContribution_eq_middleContribution
    {G : SimpleGraph L} {Q : List L}
    (hAlt : ARWord.HasInteriorAlternation G Q)
    {p x : Fin Q.length} (hpx : ARWord.IsPrevious Q p x)
    {n : ℕ} (hnLower : p.val + 1 ≤ n) (hnUpper : n < x.val) :
    adjacentContribution G Q (ARWord.label Q x) n =
      middleContribution G Q x n
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n < Q.length := hnUpper.trans x.isLt
  have hpn : p < (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin Q.length) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show p.val < n by omega)
  have hnx : (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin Q.length) < x := by
    exact_mod_cast hnUpper
  by_cases hadj : G.Adj (Q.get ⟨n, hn⟩) (ARWord.label Q x)
  · have hmiddle : ARWord.IsMiddle G Q ⟨n, hn⟩ x :=
      (isMiddle_iff_between_previous_and_endpoint hAlt hpx ⟨n, hn⟩).2
        ⟨hpn, hnx, hadj⟩
    rw [adjacentContribution_of_adj G Q (ARWord.label Q x) hn hadj,
      middleContribution_of_isMiddle G Q x hn hmiddle]
  · have hmiddle : ¬ ARWord.IsMiddle G Q ⟨n, hn⟩ x := by
      intro h
      exact hadj h.1
    rw [adjacentContribution_of_not_adj G Q (ARWord.label Q x) hn hadj,
      middleContribution_of_not_isMiddle G Q x hn hmiddle]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.sum_Ico_middleContribution_eq_middleRootSum
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_middleContribution_eq_middleRootSum
    {G : SimpleGraph L} {Q : List L}
    {p x : Fin Q.length} (hpx : ARWord.IsPrevious Q p x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (p.val + 1) x.val, middleContribution G Q x n) =
      middleRootSum G Q x
proof:
:= by
  unfold middleRootSum
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hn
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hn.2.trans x.isLt)
  · intro n hnRange hnIco
    have hn : n < Q.length := Finset.mem_range.mp hnRange
    by_cases hmiddle : ARWord.IsMiddle G Q ⟨n, hn⟩ x
    · apply False.elim
      apply hnIco
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
      have hpn : p < (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin Q.length) :=
        hmiddle.2.2.1 p hpx
      have hpnNat : p.val < n := hpn
      have hnxNat : n < x.val := hmiddle.2.1
      exact ⟨Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hpnNat, hnxNat⟩
    · exact middleContribution_of_not_isMiddle G Q x hn hmiddle

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_sum_adjacent_between
statement:
theorem inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_sum_adjacent_between
    {G : SimpleGraph L} {Q : List L}
    {p x : Fin Q.length} (hpx : ARWord.IsPrevious Q p x) :
    inversionRoot G Q p + inversionRoot G Q x =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (p.val + 1) x.val,
        adjacentContribution G Q (ARWord.label Q x) n
proof:
:= by
  have htel := transportedSimpleRoot_eq_add_sum_Ico G Q
    (ARWord.label Q x) (a := p.val + 1) (b := x.val)
    (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hpx.1) (Nat.le_of_lt x.isLt)
    (fun n hn hpn hnx => by
      have hpnFin : p < (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin Q.length) := by
        change p.val < n
        omega
      have hnxFin : (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin Q.length) < x := by
        change n < x.val
        exact hnx
      exact hpx.2.2 ⟨n, hn⟩ hpnFin hnxFin)
  have hpStep := transportedSimpleRoot_succ_of_label_eq G Q
    (ARWord.label Q x) p.isLt hpx.2.1
  change inversionRoot G Q x = _ at htel
  rw [hpStep] at htel
  rw [htel]
  simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_middleRootSum
statement:
theorem inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_middleRootSum
    {G : SimpleGraph L} {Q : List L}
    (hRuns : ARWord.HasOnlyBoundaryRepeatedRuns G Q)
    {p x : Fin Q.length} (hpx : ARWord.IsPrevious Q p x) :
    inversionRoot G Q p + inversionRoot G Q x = middleRootSum G Q x
proof:
:= by
  rw [inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_sum_adjacent_between hpx]
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (p.val + 1) x.val,
        adjacentContribution G Q (ARWord.label Q x) n) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (p.val + 1) x.val,
          middleContribution G Q x n := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hn
      exact adjacentContribution_eq_middleContribution
        hRuns.hasInteriorAlternation hpx (by omega) hn.2
    _ = middleRootSum G Q x :=
      sum_Ico_middleContribution_eq_middleRootSum hpx

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_sum_isMiddle
statement:
theorem inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_sum_isMiddle
    {G : SimpleGraph L} {Q : List L}
    (hRuns : ARWord.HasOnlyBoundaryRepeatedRuns G Q)
    {p x : Fin Q.length} (hpx : ARWord.IsPrevious Q p x) :
    inversionRoot G Q p + inversionRoot G Q x =
      filteredMiddleRootSum G Q x
proof:
:= by
  rw [inversionRoot_add_inversionRoot_eq_middleRootSum hRuns hpx,
    middleRootSum_eq_sum_filter]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.earlierNonLastAdjacentRootSum_eq_sum_filter
statement:
theorem earlierNonLastAdjacentRootSum_eq_sum_filter
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (x : Fin Q.length) :
    earlierNonLastAdjacentRootSum G Q x =
      filteredEarlierNonLastAdjacentRootSum G Q x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold filteredEarlierNonLastAdjacentRootSum
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  unfold earlierNonLastAdjacentRootSum
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range Q.length,
        earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution G Q x n) =
        ∑ y : Fin Q.length,
          earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution G Q x y.val :=
      (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun n ↦ earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution G Q x n) Q.length).symm
    _ = ∑ y : Fin Q.length,
        if IsEarlierNonLastAdjacent G Q y x then
          inversionRoot G Q y else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      simp [earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution, y.isLt]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution_of_property
statement:
theorem earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution_of_property
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (x : Fin Q.length)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n < Q.length)
    (hprop : IsEarlierNonLastAdjacent G Q ⟨n, hn⟩ x) :
    earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution G Q x n =
      inversionRoot G Q ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution
  split
  · rename_i hn'
    have heq : (⟨n, hn'⟩ : Fin Q.length) = ⟨n, hn⟩ := Fin.ext rfl

    exact False.elim (hn' hn)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.WordRootProcess.earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution_of_not_property
statement:
theorem earlierNonLastAdjacentContribution_of_not_property
    (G : SimpleGraph L) (Q : List L) (x : Fin Q.length)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n < Q.length)
    (hprop : ¬ IsEarlierNonLastAdjacent G Q ⟨n, hn⟩ x) :
