name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul?_mk {a b c : Q} (p : _root_.Quiver.Path a b) (q : _root_.Quiver.Path c a) :
    mul? (⟨a, b, p⟩ : TotalPath Q) ⟨c, a, q⟩ = some ⟨c, b, q.comp p⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul?]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_eq_none
statement: theorem mul?_eq_none {x y : TotalPath Q} (h : y.2.1 ≠ x.1) : mul? x y = none
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul?, dif_neg h]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem mul?_eq_none_iff {x y : TotalPath Q} : mul? x y = none ↔ y.2.1 ≠ x.1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h hne => ?_, mul?_eq_none⟩
  rw [mul?, dif_pos hne] at h
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_nil_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul?_nil_left (x : TotalPath Q) :
    mul? (⟨x.2.1, x.2.1, _root_.Quiver.Path.nil⟩ : TotalPath Q) x = some x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, p⟩ := x
  simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_nil_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul?_nil_right (x : TotalPath Q) :
    mul? x (⟨x.1, x.1, _root_.Quiver.Path.nil⟩ : TotalPath Q) = some x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, p⟩ := x
  simp [_root_.Quiver.Path.nil_comp]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_assoc
statement:
theorem mul?_assoc (x y z : TotalPath Q) :
    ((x.mul? y).bind fun w => w.mul? z) = (y.mul? z).bind fun w => x.mul? w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, p⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨c, d, q⟩ := y
  obtain ⟨e, f, r⟩ := z
  by_cases h₁ : d = a
  · subst h₁
    by_cases h₂ : f = c
    · subst h₂
      simp [_root_.Quiver.Path.comp_assoc]
    · rw [mul?_mk, Option.bind_some, mul?_eq_none (by simpa using h₂),
        mul?_eq_none (by simpa using h₂), Option.bind_none]
  · rw [mul?_eq_none (by simpa using h₁), Option.bind_none]
    by_cases h₂ : f = c
    · subst h₂
      rw [mul?_mk, Option.bind_some, mul?_eq_none (by simpa using h₁)]
    · rw [mul?_eq_none (by simpa using h₂), Option.bind_none]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_def
statement:
private theorem single_def (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (c : k) :
    (single x c : pathAlgebra k Q) = Finsupp.single x c
proof: := rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_zero (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) : (single x (0 : k) : pathAlgebra k Q) = 0
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.single_zero x

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_add
statement:
theorem single_add (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (c d : k) :
    (single x (c + d) : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x c + single x d
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.single_add x c d

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.smul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_single (r : k) (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (c : k) :
    r • (single x c : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x (r * c)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.smul_single r x c

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.induction_linear
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_linear {motive : pathAlgebra k Q → Prop} (f : pathAlgebra k Q)
    (zero : motive 0) (add : ∀ f g, motive f → motive g → motive (f + g))
    (single : ∀ x c, motive (PathAlgebra.single x c)) : motive f
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.induction_linear (motive := motive) f zero add single

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.singleOption_none
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem singleOption_none (c : k) : singleOption (Q := Q) none c = 0
proof: := rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.singleOption_some
proof: := rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.singleOption_zero
proof:
:= by
  cases o <;> simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.singleOption_add
statement:
private theorem singleOption_add (o : Option (Quiver.TotalPath Q)) (c d : k) :
    singleOption o (c + d) = singleOption o c + singleOption o d
proof:
:= by
  cases o <;> simp [Finsupp.single_add]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.smul_singleOption
statement:
private theorem smul_singleOption (r : k) (o : Option (Quiver.TotalPath Q)) (c : k) :
    r • singleOption o c = singleOption o (r * c)
proof:
:= by
  cases o <;> simp [Finsupp.smul_single]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_zero_left
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul']

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_zero_right
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul']

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_add_left
statement:
private theorem mul'_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Quiver.TotalPath Q →₀ k) :
    mul' (f₁ + f₂) g = mul' f₁ g + mul' f₂ g
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun x => ?_) fun x a₁ a₂ => ?_
  · simp
  · rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
    exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun y _ => by rw [add_mul, singleOption_add]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_add_right
statement:
private theorem mul'_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Quiver.TotalPath Q →₀ k) :
    mul' f (g₁ + g₂) = mul' f g₁ + mul' f g₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul']
  rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
  exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun x _ =>
    Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun y => by simp) fun y b₁ b₂ => by
      rw [mul_add, singleOption_add]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_single_single
statement:
private theorem mul'_single_single (x y : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (a b : k) :
    mul' (Finsupp.single x a) (Finsupp.single y b) = singleOption (x.mul? y) (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul', Finsupp.sum_single_index (by simp), Finsupp.sum_single_index (by simp)]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_singleOption_single
statement:
private theorem mul'_singleOption_single (o : Option (Quiver.TotalPath Q)) (c : k)
    (y : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (b : k) :
    mul' (singleOption o c) (Finsupp.single y b)
      = singleOption (o.bind fun w => w.mul? y) (c * b)
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => simp
  | some x => rw [singleOption_some, mul'_single_single, Option.bind_some]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_single_singleOption
statement:
private theorem mul'_single_singleOption (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (a : k)
    (o : Option (Quiver.TotalPath Q)) (c : k) :
    mul' (Finsupp.single x a) (singleOption o c)
      = singleOption (o.bind fun w => x.mul? w) (a * c)
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => simp
  | some y => rw [singleOption_some, mul'_single_single, Option.bind_some]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_assoc
statement:
private theorem mul'_assoc (f g t : Quiver.TotalPath Q →₀ k) :
    mul' (mul' f g) t = mul' f (mul' g t)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f₁ f₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [mul'_add_left, ih₁, ih₂]
  | single x a =>
    induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [mul'_add_left, mul'_add_right, ih₁, ih₂]
    | single y b =>
      induction t using Finsupp.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add t₁ t₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [mul'_add_right, ih₁, ih₂]
      | single z c =>
        rw [mul'_single_single, mul'_single_single, mul'_singleOption_single,
          mul'_single_singleOption, Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.smul_mul'
statement:
private theorem smul_mul' (r : k) (f g : Quiver.TotalPath Q →₀ k) :
    mul' (r • f) g = r • mul' f g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f₁ f₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [smul_add, mul'_add_left, ih₁, ih₂]
  | single x a =>
    induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [smul_add, mul'_add_right, ih₁, ih₂]
    | single y b =>
      rw [Finsupp.smul_single, mul'_single_single, mul'_single_single, smul_singleOption,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul_def
statement: private theorem mul_def (f g : pathAlgebra k Q) : f * g = mul' f g
proof: := rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_mul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_mul_single (x y : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (a b : k) :
    (single x a * single y b : pathAlgebra k Q)
      = (x.mul? y).elim 0 fun z => single z (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_def, single_def, single_def, mul'_single_single]
  cases x.mul? y <;> rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_mul_single_of_comp
statement:
theorem single_mul_single_of_comp {a b c : Q} (p : _root_.Quiver.Path a b)
    (q : _root_.Quiver.Path c a) (r s : k) :
    (single (⟨a, b, p⟩ : Quiver.TotalPath Q) r * single ⟨c, a, q⟩ s : pathAlgebra k Q)
      = single ⟨c, b, q.comp p⟩ (r * s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_mul_single, Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_mk]
  rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_mul_single_of_not_composable
statement:
theorem single_mul_single_of_not_composable {x y : Quiver.TotalPath Q} (h : y.2.1 ≠ x.1) (r s : k) :
    (single x r * single y s : pathAlgebra k Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_mul_single, Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_eq_none h]
  rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.ofPath_eq_single
statement:
theorem ofPath_eq_single (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) :
    (ofPath x : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x 1
proof: := (rfl)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.ofPath_mul_ofPath_of_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPath_mul_ofPath_of_comp {a b c : Q} (p : _root_.Quiver.Path a b)
    (q : _root_.Quiver.Path c a) :
    (ofPath (⟨a, b, p⟩ : Quiver.TotalPath Q) * ofPath ⟨c, a, q⟩ : pathAlgebra k Q)
      = ofPath ⟨c, b, q.comp p⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPath_eq_single, ofPath_eq_single, ofPath_eq_single, single_mul_single_of_comp, one_mul]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.ofPath_mul_ofPath_of_not_composable
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPath_mul_ofPath_of_not_composable {x y : Quiver.TotalPath Q} (h : y.2.1 ≠ x.1) :
    (ofPath x * ofPath y : pathAlgebra k Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPath_eq_single, ofPath_eq_single]
  exact single_mul_single_of_not_composable h 1 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.vertexIdempotent_eq_single
statement:
theorem vertexIdempotent_eq_single (v : Q) :
    vertexIdempotent k v
      = single (⟨v, v, _root_.Quiver.Path.nil⟩ : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (1 : k)
proof: := (rfl)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.vertexIdempotent_mul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexIdempotent_mul_single (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (r : k) :
    (vertexIdempotent k x.2.1 * single x r : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexIdempotent_eq_single, single_mul_single, Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_nil_left,
    Option.elim_some, one_mul]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_mul_vertexIdempotent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_mul_vertexIdempotent (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (r : k) :
    (single x r * vertexIdempotent k x.1 : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexIdempotent_eq_single, single_mul_single, Quiver.TotalPath.mul?_nil_right,
    Option.elim_some, mul_one]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.vertexIdempotent_mul_ofPath
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexIdempotent_mul_ofPath {a b : Q} (p : _root_.Quiver.Path a b) :
    (vertexIdempotent k b * ofPath ⟨a, b, p⟩ : pathAlgebra k Q) = ofPath ⟨a, b, p⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact vertexIdempotent_mul_single (k := k) ⟨a, b, p⟩ 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.ofPath_mul_vertexIdempotent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPath_mul_vertexIdempotent {a b : Q} (p : _root_.Quiver.Path a b) :
    (ofPath ⟨a, b, p⟩ * vertexIdempotent k a : pathAlgebra k Q) = ofPath ⟨a, b, p⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact single_mul_vertexIdempotent (k := k) ⟨a, b, p⟩ 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.vertexIdempotent_mul_ofPath_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexIdempotent_mul_ofPath_of_ne {v : Q} (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (h : v ≠ x.2.1) :
    (vertexIdempotent k v * ofPath x : pathAlgebra k Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexIdempotent_eq_single, ofPath_eq_single]
  exact single_mul_single_of_not_composable h.symm 1 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.ofPath_mul_vertexIdempotent_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPath_mul_vertexIdempotent_of_ne {v : Q} (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (h : v ≠ x.1) :
    (ofPath x * vertexIdempotent k v : pathAlgebra k Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPath_eq_single, vertexIdempotent_eq_single]
  exact single_mul_single_of_not_composable h 1 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.vertexIdempotent_mul_vertexIdempotent_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexIdempotent_mul_vertexIdempotent_of_ne {u v : Q} (h : u ≠ v) :
    (vertexIdempotent k u * vertexIdempotent k v : pathAlgebra k Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexIdempotent_eq_single, vertexIdempotent_eq_single]
  exact single_mul_single_of_not_composable h.symm 1 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.vertexIdempotent_mul_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexIdempotent_mul_self (v : Q) :
    (vertexIdempotent k v * vertexIdempotent k v : pathAlgebra k Q) = vertexIdempotent k v
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexIdempotent_eq_single, single_mul_single_of_comp, one_mul, _root_.Quiver.Path.comp_nil]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.one_def
statement: theorem one_def [Fintype Q] : (1 : pathAlgebra k Q) = ∑ v : Q, vertexIdempotent k v
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr (congrArg (@Finset.univ Q) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)) fun _ _ => rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.one_mul_single
statement:
private theorem one_mul_single (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (r : k) :
    ((1 : pathAlgebra k Q) * single x r : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x r
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite Q
  rw [one_def, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single x.2.1]
  · exact vertexIdempotent_mul_single x r
  · intro v _ hv
    exact single_mul_single_of_not_composable (x := ⟨v, v, _root_.Quiver.Path.nil⟩)
      (fun h => hv h.symm) 1 r
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.single_mul_one
statement:
private theorem single_mul_one (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) (r : k) :
    (single x r * (1 : pathAlgebra k Q) : pathAlgebra k Q) = single x r
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite Q
  rw [one_def, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single x.1]
  · exact single_mul_vertexIdempotent x r
  · intro v _ hv
    exact single_mul_single_of_not_composable (y := ⟨v, v, _root_.Quiver.Path.nil⟩) hv r 1
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.mul'_smul
statement:
private theorem mul'_smul (r : k) (f g : Quiver.TotalPath Q →₀ k) :
    mul' f (r • g) = r • mul' f g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f₁ f₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [smul_add, mul'_add_left, ih₁, ih₂]
  | single x a =>
    induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp only [smul_add, mul'_add_right, ih₁, ih₂]
    | single y b =>
      rw [Finsupp.smul_single, mul'_single_single, mul'_single_single, smul_singleOption,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply [Fintype Q] (r : k) :
    algebraMap k (pathAlgebra k Q) r = ∑ v : Q, r • vertexIdempotent k v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, one_def, Finset.smul_sum]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.coe_pathAlgebraBasis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_pathAlgebraBasis :
    ⇑(pathAlgebraBasis k Q)
      = fun x : Quiver.TotalPath Q => (PathAlgebra.ofPath x : pathAlgebra k Q)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.module_finite_pathAlgebra
statement:
theorem module_finite_pathAlgebra [Finite (Quiver.TotalPath Q)] :
    Module.Finite k (pathAlgebra k Q)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_basis (pathAlgebraBasis k Q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finrank_pathAlgebra
statement:
theorem finrank_pathAlgebra [Fintype (Quiver.TotalPath Q)] :
    Module.finrank k (pathAlgebra k Q) = Fintype.card (Quiver.TotalPath Q)
proof:
:=
  Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (pathAlgebraBasis k Q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.ofArrow_eq_ofPath
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofArrow_eq_ofPath {a b : Q} (e : a ⟶ b) :
    (ofArrow e : pathAlgebra k Q) = ofPath ⟨a, b, e.toPath⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofArrow]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.adjoin_vertexIdempotents_union_arrows
statement:
theorem adjoin_vertexIdempotents_union_arrows :
    Algebra.adjoin k
        (Set.range (vertexIdempotent k) ∪
          Set.range fun e : Σ a b : Q, a ⟶ b => ofArrow e.2.2) =
      ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  suffices ∀ f : pathAlgebra k Q,
      f ∈ Algebra.adjoin k
        (Set.range (vertexIdempotent k) ∪
          Set.range fun e : Σ a b : Q, a ⟶ b => ofArrow e.2.2) by
    exact fun f _ => this f
  intro f
  induction f using induction_linear with
  | zero => exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
  | add f g hf hg => exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hf hg
  | single x c =>
      have ofPath_mem (x : Quiver.TotalPath Q) :
          ofPath x ∈
            Algebra.adjoin k
              (Set.range (vertexIdempotent k) ∪
                Set.range fun e : Σ a b : Q, a ⟶ b => ofArrow e.2.2) := by
        obtain ⟨a, b, p⟩ := x
        induction p with
        | nil =>
            exact Algebra.subset_adjoin
              (Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨a, rfl⟩)
        | @cons b c p e ih =>
            rw [← _root_.Quiver.Path.comp_toPath_eq_cons,
              ← ofPath_mul_ofPath_of_comp e.toPath p]
            exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _
              (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_union_right _
                ⟨⟨b, c, e⟩, rfl⟩)) ih
      simpa [ofPath_eq_single] using
        (Algebra.adjoin k
          (Set.range (vertexIdempotent k) ∪
            Set.range fun e : Σ a b : Q, a ⟶ b => ofArrow e.2.2)).smul_mem
          (ofPath_mem x) c

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.oneLoopLinearEquiv_ofPath
proof:
:= by
  have hb : pathAlgebraBasis k Quiver.OneLoop x = ofPath x :=
    congrFun (coe_pathAlgebraBasis k Quiver.OneLoop) x
  rw [← hb]
  simp only [oneLoopLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.oneLoopLinearEquiv_single
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one c, ← smul_single, ← ofPath_eq_single, map_smul,
    oneLoopLinearEquiv_ofPath]
  simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.oneLoopLinearEquiv_map_one
statement:
private theorem oneLoopLinearEquiv_map_one :
    oneLoopLinearEquiv k (1 : pathAlgebra k Quiver.OneLoop) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_def]
  simp [vertexIdempotent_eq_single, oneLoopLinearEquiv_single,
    Quiver.OneLoop.totalPathEquivNat, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.PathAlgebra.oneLoopLinearEquiv_map_mul
statement:
private theorem oneLoopLinearEquiv_map_mul
    (f g : pathAlgebra k Quiver.OneLoop) :
    oneLoopLinearEquiv k (f * g) = oneLoopLinearEquiv k f * oneLoopLinearEquiv k g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f₁ f₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [ih₁, ih₂, add_mul]
  | single x a =>
      induction g using induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add g₁ g₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [ih₁, ih₂, mul_add]
      | single y b =>
          obtain ⟨x₁, x₂, p⟩ := x
          obtain ⟨y₁, y₂, q⟩ := y
          cases x₁
          cases x₂
          cases y₁
          cases y₂
          simp [single_mul_single, Quiver.TotalPath.mul?,
            oneLoopLinearEquiv_single, Quiver.OneLoop.totalPathEquivNat,
            _root_.Quiver.Path.length_comp, Nat.add_comm]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.not_finiteDimensional_pathAlgebra_oneLoop
statement:
theorem not_finiteDimensional_pathAlgebra_oneLoop
    (k : Type w) [DivisionRing k] :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k (pathAlgebra k Quiver.OneLoop)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Infinite (Quiver.TotalPath Quiver.OneLoop) :=
    Quiver.OneLoop.totalPathEquivNat.infinite_iff.mpr inferInstance
  intro h
  letI : Module.Finite k (pathAlgebra k Quiver.OneLoop) := h
  exact Module.Finite.not_linearIndependent_of_infinite
    (⇑(pathAlgebraBasis k Quiver.OneLoop))
    (pathAlgebraBasis k Quiver.OneLoop).linearIndependent

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimVector_apply (M : QuiverRep k Q) (i : Q) :
    dimVector M i = Module.finrank k (M.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i))
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem dimVector_eq_of_iso {M N : QuiverRep k Q} (e : M ≅ N) :
    dimVector M = dimVector N
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [dimVector_apply]
  exact (e.app ((Paths.of Q).obj i)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimVector_zero :
    dimVector (0 : QuiverRep k Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [dimVector_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  have hi : IsZero ((0 : QuiverRep k Q).obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) :=
    Functor.zero_obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)
  letI : Subsingleton ((0 : QuiverRep k Q).obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hi
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_biprod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimVector_biprod (M N : QuiverRep k Q)
    (hM : ∀ i : Q, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)))
    (hN : ∀ i : Q, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i))) :
    dimVector (M ⊞ N) = dimVector M + dimVector N
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  letI := hM i
  letI := hN i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, dimVector_apply]
  let E := (evaluation (Paths Q) (ModuleCat k)).obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproduct M N E :=
    preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct E M N
  let e : (M ⊞ N).obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i) ≅
      ModuleCat.of k (M.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i) × N.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) :=
    E.mapBiprod M N ≪≫
      ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd
        (M.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) (N.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i))
  rw [e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_add_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem dimVector_add_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex (QuiverRep k Q)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : ∀ i : Q, FiniteDimensional k (S.X₁.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)))
    (h₃ : ∀ i : Q, FiniteDimensional k (S.X₃.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i))) :
    dimVector S.X₂ = dimVector S.X₁ + dimVector S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  let E := (evaluation (Paths Q) (ModuleCat k)).obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (S.map E).X₁ := h₁ i
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (S.map E).X₃ := h₃ i
  have hSi : (S.map E).ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact E
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, dimVector_apply]
  have hfin₁ : Module.finrank k (S.map E).X₁ =
      Module.finrank k (S.X₁.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) :=
    congrArg (fun X : ModuleCat k ↦ Module.finrank k X) ((ShortComplex.map_X₁ S E).trans
      (evaluation_obj_obj (Paths Q) (ModuleCat k) ((Paths.of Q).obj i) S.X₁))
  have hfin₂ : Module.finrank k (S.map E).X₂ =
      Module.finrank k (S.X₂.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) :=
    congrArg (fun X : ModuleCat k ↦ Module.finrank k X) ((ShortComplex.map_X₂ S E).trans
      (evaluation_obj_obj (Paths Q) (ModuleCat k) ((Paths.of Q).obj i) S.X₂))
  have hfin₃ : Module.finrank k (S.map E).X₃ =
      Module.finrank k (S.X₃.obj ((Paths.of Q).obj i)) :=
    congrArg (fun X : ModuleCat k ↦ Module.finrank k X) ((ShortComplex.map_X₃ S E).trans
      (evaluation_obj_obj (Paths Q) (ModuleCat k) ((Paths.of Q).obj i) S.X₃))
  exact hfin₂.symm.trans (ModuleCat.free_shortExact_finrank_add hSi hfin₁ hfin₃)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.QuiverRep.map_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem QuiverRep.map_nil {k : Type u} {Q : Type v} [Field k] [Quiver.{w} Q] (M : QuiverRep k Q)
    (a : Q) : M.map (Quiver.Path.nil : Quiver.Path a a) = 𝟙 (M.obj a)
proof:
:=
  M.map_id a

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.simpleRep_obj_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simpleRep_obj_self (i : Q) : (simpleRep k Q i).obj i = ModuleCat.of k k
proof:
:=
  if_pos rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.simpleRep_obj_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simpleRep_obj_of_ne {i a : Q} (h : a ≠ i) : (simpleRep k Q i).obj a = 0
proof:
:=
  if_neg h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.isZero_simpleRep_obj
statement: theorem isZero_simpleRep_obj {i a : Q} (h : a ≠ i) : IsZero ((simpleRep k Q i).obj a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRep_obj_of_ne h]
  exact isZero_zero _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.simpleRep_map_toPath
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simpleRep_map_toPath (i : Q) {a b : Q} (e : a ⟶ b) :
    (simpleRep k Q i).map e.toPath = 0
proof:
:=

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.simpleRep_map_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simpleRep_map_cons (i : Q) {a b c : Q} (p : Quiver.Path a b) (e : b ⟶ c) :
    (simpleRep k Q i).map (p.cons e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRep, Paths.lift_cons]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.simpleRep_map_eq_zero_of_length_ne_zero
statement:
theorem simpleRep_map_eq_zero_of_length_ne_zero (i : Q) {a b : Q} (p : Quiver.Path a b)
    (hp : p.length ≠ 0) : (simpleRep k Q i).map p = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hp
  | cons q e => exact simpleRep_map_cons i q e

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.hom_simpleRep_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_simpleRep_eq_zero_iff {i : Q} {M : QuiverRep k Q} (f : M ⟶ simpleRep k Q i) :
    f = 0 ↔ f.app i = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ by simp [h], fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun a ↦ ?_)
  rcases eq_or_ne a i with rfl | ha
  · exact h
  · exact (isZero_simpleRep_obj (Q := Q) ha).eq_of_tgt _ _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.simpleRep_hom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simpleRep_hom_eq_zero_iff {i : Q} {M : QuiverRep k Q} (f : simpleRep k Q i ⟶ M) :
    f = 0 ↔ f.app i = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ by simp [h], fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun a ↦ ?_)
  rcases eq_or_ne a i with rfl | ha
  · exact h
  · exact (isZero_simpleRep_obj (Q := Q) ha).eq_of_src _ _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_simpleRep
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimVector_simpleRep [DecidableEq Q] (i : Q) :
    dimVector (simpleRep k Q i) = Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rw [dimVector_apply, Paths.of_obj, Pi.single_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne a i with rfl | ha
  · rw [if_pos rfl, simpleRep_obj_self]
    exact Module.finrank_self k
  · rw [if_neg ha]
    have : Subsingleton ((simpleRep k Q i).obj a) :=
      ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (isZero_simpleRep_obj ha)
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.not_nonempty_simpleRep_iso
statement:
theorem not_nonempty_simpleRep_iso {i j : Q} (h : i ≠ j) :
    ¬ Nonempty (simpleRep k Q i ≅ simpleRep k Q j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  have hd := dimVector_eq_of_iso e
  rw [dimVector_simpleRep, dimVector_simpleRep] at hd
  simpa [Pi.single_apply, h] using congrFun hd i

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.isAcyclic_def
statement:
theorem Quiver.isAcyclic_def :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V ↔ ∀ ⦃a : V⦄ (p : Path a a), p = Path.nil
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.eq_nil
statement: theorem eq_nil (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) {a : V} (p : Path a a) : p = Path.nil
proof:
:=
  h p

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.iff_forall_length_eq_zero
statement:
theorem iff_forall_length_eq_zero :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V ↔ ∀ ⦃a : V⦄ (p : Path a a), p.length = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a p
    rw [h.eq_nil p]
    exact Path.length_nil
  · intro h a p
    exact p.eq_nil_of_length_zero (h p)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.length_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_eq_zero (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) {a : V} (p : Path a a) :
    p.length = 0
proof:
:=
  iff_forall_length_eq_zero.mp h p

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.not_length_pos
statement:
theorem not_length_pos (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) {a : V} (p : Path a a) :
    ¬0 < p.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.length_eq_zero p]
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.iff_forall_not_length_pos
statement:
theorem iff_forall_not_length_pos :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V ↔ ∀ ⦃a : V⦄ (p : Path a a), ¬0 < p.length
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h a p ↦ h.not_length_pos p
  · intro h a p
    apply p.eq_nil_of_length_zero
    have hp := h p
    omega

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.iff_not_exists_ne_nil
statement:
theorem iff_not_exists_ne_nil :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V ↔ ¬∃ (a : V) (p : Path a a), p ≠ Path.nil
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hex
    obtain ⟨a, p, hp⟩ := hex
    exact hp (h.eq_nil p)
  · intro h a p
    by_contra hp
    exact h ⟨a, p, hp⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.comp_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_eq_nil (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) {a b : V}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b a) :
    p.comp q = Path.nil
proof:
:=
  h.eq_nil (p.comp q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.length_eq_zero_of_paths_left
proof:
:=
  Path.nil_of_comp_eq_nil_left (h.comp_eq_nil p q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.length_eq_zero_of_paths_right
proof:
:=
  h.length_eq_zero_of_paths_left q p

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.eq_of_paths
proof:
:=
  p.eq_of_length_zero (h.length_eq_zero_of_paths_left p q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.vertices_nodup
statement:
theorem vertices_nodup (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) {a b : V} (p : Path a b) :
    p.vertices.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p e ih =>
    rw [Path.vertices_cons, List.nodup_concat]
    refine ⟨?_, ih⟩
    intro he
    obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, hp⟩ := p.exists_eq_comp_of_mem_vertices he
    have hlength := h.length_eq_zero (p₂.cons e)
    rw [Path.length_cons] at hlength
    omega

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.not_nonempty_path_and_nonempty_path
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨p⟩, ⟨q⟩⟩
  exact hab (h.eq_of_paths p q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.isEmpty_path_of_path
proof:
:=

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.isEmpty_hom_self
statement:
theorem isEmpty_hom_self (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) (a : V) :
    IsEmpty (a ⟶ a)

:=
  ⟨fun e ↦ Path.cons_ne_nil Path.nil e (h e.toPath)⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.isEmpty_hom_of_hom
statement:
theorem isEmpty_hom_of_hom (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) {a b : V}
    (e : a ⟶ b) : IsEmpty (b ⟶ a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun f ↦ by simpa using h.length_eq_zero_of_paths_left e.toPath f.toPath⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.subsingleton_path_self
statement:
theorem subsingleton_path_self (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) (a : V) :
    Subsingleton (Path a a)

:=
  ⟨fun p q ↦ (h.eq_nil p).trans (h.eq_nil q).symm⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.of_isEmpty_hom
statement:
theorem of_isEmpty_hom [∀ a b : V, IsEmpty (a ⟶ b)] :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V
proof:
:= by
  intro a p
  cases p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ e => exact isEmptyElim e

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.of_mapPath_self_injective
statement:
theorem of_mapPath_self_injective {W : Type*} [Quiver W] (F : V ⥤q W)
    (hW : Quiver.IsAcyclic W)
    (hinj : ∀ ⦃a : V⦄, Function.Injective (F.mapPath : Path a a → Path (F.obj a) (F.obj a))) :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V
proof:
:= by
  intro a p
  apply hinj
  rw [hW.eq_nil (F.mapPath p)]
  exact F.mapPath_nil a

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.of_mapPath_injective
statement:
theorem of_mapPath_injective {W : Type*} [Quiver W] (F : V ⥤q W)
    (hW : Quiver.IsAcyclic W)
    (hinj : ∀ ⦃a b : V⦄, Function.Injective (F.mapPath : Path a b → Path (F.obj a) (F.obj b))) :
    Quiver.IsAcyclic V
proof:
:=
  of_mapPath_self_injective F hW fun {_} ↦ @hinj _ _

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finiteDimensional_pathAlgebra_of_isAcyclic
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_pathAlgebra_of_isAcyclic (k : Type w) (Q : Type u) [DivisionRing k]
    [Quiver.{v} Q] [Finite Q] [∀ a b : Q, Finite (a ⟶ b)] (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic Q) :
    FiniteDimensional k (pathAlgebra k Q)
proof:
:=
  letI := finite_paths_of_isAcyclic h
  module_finite_pathAlgebra k Q

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finite_boundedPaths
statement:
private theorem finite_boundedPaths [Finite V] [∀ a b : V, Finite (a ⟶ b)] (n : ℕ) (a b : V) :
    Finite (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a b with
  | zero => exact Finite.of_subsingleton
  | succ n ih =>
    letI : Fintype V := Fintype.ofFinite V
    letI arrowFintype (x y : V) : Fintype (x ⟶ y) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI pathFinite (x y : V) : Finite (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths x y n) := ih _ _
    letI pathFintype (x y : V) : Fintype (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths x y n) :=
      Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI zeroFintype : Fintype (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b 0) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    let f : (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b 0 ⊕
        (Σ c : V, (a ⟶ c) × _root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths c b n)) →
        _root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b (n + 1) := fun x ↦
      match x with
      | .inl p => ⟨p.1, p.2.trans (Nat.zero_le _)⟩
      | .inr ⟨c, e, q⟩ =>
        ⟨e.toPath.comp q.1, by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using Nat.add_le_add_right q.2 1⟩
    letI : Finite (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b 0 ⊕
        (Σ c : V, (a ⟶ c) × _root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths c b n)) :=
      Finite.of_fintype _
    apply Finite.of_surjective f
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p.1.length = 0
    · exact ⟨.inl ⟨p.1, by omega⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨c, e, q, hq, hpq⟩ :=
        p.1.eq_toPath_comp_of_length_eq_succ (n := p.1.length - 1) (by omega)
      have hq_le : q.length ≤ n := by
        have hp_le : p.1.length ≤ n + 1 := p.2
        rw [hq]
        omega
      exact ⟨.inr ⟨c, e, ⟨q, hq_le⟩⟩, Subtype.ext hpq.symm⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.length_lt_card
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le] using List.Nodup.length_le_card (h.vertices_nodup p)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.finite_paths
statement:
private theorem finite_paths [Finite V] [∀ a b : V, Finite (a ⟶ b)] (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) :
    Finite (Σ a b : V, _root_.Quiver.Path a b)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype V := Fintype.ofFinite V
  letI pathFinite (a b : V) : Finite (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b (Fintype.card V - 1)) :=
    finite_boundedPaths _ _ _
  letI pathFintype (a b : V) : Fintype (_root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b (Fintype.card V - 1)) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  let f : (Σ a b : V, _root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b (Fintype.card V - 1)) →
      Σ a b : V, _root_.Quiver.Path a b :=
    fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2.1⟩
  letI : Finite (Σ a b : V, _root_.Quiver.Path.BoundedPaths a b (Fintype.card V - 1)) :=
    Finite.of_fintype _
  apply Finite.of_surjective f
  rintro ⟨a, b, p⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a, b, p, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  have hp := h.length_lt_card p
  omega

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finite_paths_of_isAcyclic
statement:
theorem finite_paths_of_isAcyclic [Finite V] [∀ a b : V, Finite (a ⟶ b)]
    (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic V) : Finite (Σ a b : V, _root_.Quiver.Path a b)
proof:
:=
  h.finite_paths

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finrank_end_indecProjRep_of_isAcyclic
statement:
theorem finrank_end_indecProjRep_of_isAcyclic (h : Quiver.IsAcyclic Q) (i : Q) :
    Module.finrank k (indecProjRep k Q i ⟶ indecProjRep k Q i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Subsingleton (Quiver.Path i i) := h.subsingleton_path_self i
  letI : Unique (Quiver.Path i i) := uniqueOfSubsingleton Quiver.Path.nil
  rw [finrank_hom_indecProjRep_indecProjRep, Nat.card_unique]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRep_map_toPath
proof:
:=
  Paths.lift_toPath _ e

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRep_map_single
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    rw [QuiverRep.map_nil, ModuleCat.id_apply]
    rfl
  | cons p e ih =>
    have hcons : (indecProjRep k Q i).map (p.cons e)
        = (indecProjRep k Q i).map p ≫ (indecProjRep k Q i).map e.toPath :=
      (indecProjRep k Q i).map_comp p e.toPath
    rw [hcons, ModuleCat.comp_apply, ih, indecProjRep_map_toPath]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_single

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRep_map
proof:
:= by
  refine ModuleCat.hom_ext (Finsupp.lhom_ext fun q c ↦ ?_)
  
  
  
  
  change (indecProjRep k Q i).map p (Finsupp.single q c)
      = Finsupp.mapDomain (fun r : Quiver.Path i a ↦ r.comp p) (Finsupp.single q c)
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, indecProjRep_map_single]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRep_map_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indecProjRep_map_basis (i : Q) {a b : Q} (p : Quiver.Path a b) (q : Quiver.Path i a) :
    (indecProjRep k Q i).map p (indecProjRepBasis k i a q) = indecProjRepBasis k i b (q.comp p)
proof:
:=
  indecProjRep_map_single i p q 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.dimVector_indecProjRep
statement:
theorem dimVector_indecProjRep (i j : Q) :
    dimVector (indecProjRep k Q i) j = Nat.card (Quiver.Path i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dimVector_apply, Paths.of_obj, Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (indecProjRepBasis k i j)]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRepHom_app_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indecProjRepHom_app_basis (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q) (x : M.obj i) (j : Q)
    (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
    (indecProjRepHom i M x).app j (indecProjRepBasis k i j p) = M.map p x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (indecProjRepHom i M x).app j (indecProjRepBasis k i j p) = (1 : k) • M.map p x :=
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single k 1 p
  rwa [one_smul] at h

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRepHom_app_nil
statement:
theorem indecProjRepHom_app_nil (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q) (x : M.obj i) :
    (indecProjRepHom i M x).app i (indecProjRepBasis k i i Quiver.Path.nil) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRepHom_app_nil_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indecProjRepHom_app_nil_self {i : Q} {M : QuiverRep k Q} (f : indecProjRep k Q i ⟶ M) :
    indecProjRepHom i M (f.app i (indecProjRepBasis k i i Quiver.Path.nil)) = f
proof:
:= by
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun j ↦ ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ((indecProjRepBasis k i j).ext fun p ↦ ?_))
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (f.naturality p))
    (indecProjRepBasis k i i Quiver.Path.nil)
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    indecProjRep_map_basis, Quiver.Path.nil_comp] at h
  simp only [indecProjRepHom_app_basis, h]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRepHomEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indecProjRepHomEquiv_apply (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q) (f : indecProjRep k Q i ⟶ M) :
    indecProjRepHomEquiv i M f = f.app i (indecProjRepBasis k i i Quiver.Path.nil)
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRepHomEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem indecProjRepHomEquiv_symm_apply (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q) (x : M.obj i) :
    (indecProjRepHomEquiv i M).symm x = indecProjRepHom i M x
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.indecProjRepHomEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem indecProjRepHomEquiv_comp (i : Q) {M N : QuiverRep k Q} (f : indecProjRep k Q i ⟶ M)
    (g : M ⟶ N) :
    indecProjRepHomEquiv i N (f ≫ g) = g.app i (indecProjRepHomEquiv i M f)
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finrank_hom_indecProjRep
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_indecProjRep (i : Q) (M : QuiverRep k Q) :
    Module.finrank k (indecProjRep k Q i ⟶ M) = dimVector M i
proof:
:= by
  rw [dimVector_apply]
  exact (indecProjRepHomEquiv i M).finrank_eq

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.finrank_hom_indecProjRep_indecProjRep
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_indecProjRep_indecProjRep (i j : Q) :
    Module.finrank k (indecProjRep k Q i ⟶ indecProjRep k Q j) = Nat.card (Quiver.Path j i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_hom_indecProjRep, dimVector_indecProjRep]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.not_isZero_indecProjRep
statement: theorem not_isZero_indecProjRep (i : Q) : ¬ IsZero (indecProjRep k Q i)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  letI := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (h.obj i)
  exact (indecProjRepBasis k i i).ne_zero Quiver.Path.nil (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
